L-1.lyrics_summary: The seven words they couldn't say. Guess what? We're singing them.
L-1.lyrics_extract: “I know it when I see it,” he declared, / Obscene, indecent, profane, we all stared.
L-1.lyrics_text:
Banjo strumming, a quirky tune,
George Carlin’s words, under the moon.

In ’72, Carlin took the stage,
Seven dirty words, they caused a rage.
“Shit, piss, fuck, cunt,” he said with flair,
“Cocksucker, motherfucker, tits,” laid bare.

[Chorus]
Supreme Court case in ’64,
Justice Stewart knew the score,
“I know it when I see it,” he declared,
Obscene, indecent, profane, we all stared.

Obscenity, it has three tests to meet,
Prurient interest, patently offensive, complete.
No literary, artistic, political gain,
These words, they drove the Feds insane.

[Chorus]
Supreme Court case in ’64,
Justice Stewart knew the score,
“I know it when I see it,” he declared,
Obscene, indecent, profane, we all stared.

Banjo solo, psychedelic feel,
Carlin’s spirit, keeping it real.

Indecent content, sexual, excretory,
Not quite obscene, but still a story.
Profane words, grossly offensive, they say,
A public nuisance, to the Feds, make way.

[Chorus]
Supreme Court case in ’64,
Justice Stewart knew the score,
“I know it when I see it,” he declared,
Obscene, indecent, profane, we all stared.

“Fart, turd, twat,” added to the list,
Carlin’s humor, hard to resist.
If you find it objectionable, tell the Feds,
Or add your own, let it spread.

L-319.lyrics_title: A Cabaret Where No One Knows
L-319.lyrics_summary: Painted smiles. Sparkling lies. Truth is a ghost. The puppeteers never leave the stage and the twisted act will never end.
L-319.lyrics_extract: Come to the show, where truth is a ghost, / A performance for those who rule the most.
L-319.lyrics_text:
[verse 1]  
Painted smiles on every face,  
Behind the curtains, such disgrace.  
Lies dressed up in sparkling clothes,  
A cabaret where no one knows.

[chorus]  
Come to the show, where truth is a ghost,  
A performance for those who rule the most.  
In the cabaret, we all pretend,  
But this twisted act will never end.

[verse 2]  
Drum beats echo in the dark,  
A psychedelic spark leaves its mark.  
Puppeteers dance, pulling tight,  
Fools applaud, blind in the night.

[chorus]  
Come to the show, where truth is a ghost,  
A performance for those who rule the most.  
In the cabaret, we all pretend,  
But this twisted act will never end.

[outro]  
But this twisted act will never end...

Not for the likes, not for the fame  
In a world steeped in a superficial game  
Art’s true magic, a soul’s gentle awe

L-340.lyrics_title: A la Guerre Comme A la Guerre (To War or Not to War?)
L-340.lyrics_summary: À la guerre comme à la guerre — as if war ever played by rules. Love still whispers anyway.
L-340.lyrics_extract: They speak of fatherlands, sacred and pure, / But don’t they see? All lands are ours.
L-340.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Intro]
To war or not to war…
It’s like a joke, isn’t it?
But jokes cut deep sometimes.

[Verse 1]
Some like to claim there’s a “right way” to war,
A firm, undisputed sway,
But they miss the blood, the endless decay,
The madness that haunts every day.

“A la guerre comme à la guerre,” they’ll chant,
Like it’s dessert after wine, like it’s something grand.
The end justifies the means, they’ll say,
But oh, how simple they paint the gray.

[Chorus]
But war knows no rights,
No privilege, no pride, no light.
Souls torn apart,
Worlds ripped from their start.

And love, love’s still here,
Fighting through the tears, so clear.
Peace whispers softly, near,
Waiting at the future’s door…

[Verse 2]
They speak of fatherlands, sacred and pure,
But don’t they see? All lands are ours.
We share this earth, this fragile bond,
And still, we fight... How far have we gone?

Chosen by gods, or so they claim,
Grinding every day in war’s cruel game.
Alien realms hold hearts to mend,
While ours crumble… Will this ever end?

[Chorus]
But war knows no rights,
No privilege, no pride, no light.
Souls torn apart,
Worlds ripped from their start.

And love, love’s still here,
Fighting through the tears, so clear.
Peace whispers softly, near,
Waiting at the future’s door…

[Bridge]
Oh, don’t forget what’s ours,
So precious, so tender,
Not even a dream,
Just a purr of hope,
Soft, like a light unseen.

[Outro]
To war or not to war…
Is it a joke?
Or just the cruelest truth?
Peace is knocking,
Will we answer?

--
V2:
[Verse 1]
They say, “à la guerre comme à la guerre,”
But what if we learned to truly care?
Not every battle needs a fight,
Some wars are won with love and light.

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh, hearts can bend, but they don’t have to break,
The sharpest strength is the one we make.

[Chorus]
À la guerre comme à la guerre, they cry,
But maybe it’s time to question why.
Do we follow the rules, or rewrite the tale?
The smallest kindness can still prevail.
À la guerre comme à la guerre, they sigh,
But peace is waiting—just give it a try.

Verse 2
The muddy waters, the endless schemes,
They blur the truth, distort the dreams.
But clear the path, and you might see,
A better way to let hearts be free.

Pre-Chorus
Oh, souls can grow where the darkness fades,
The brightest flames are the love we’ve made.

[Chorus]
À la guerre comme à la guerre, they cry,
But maybe it’s time to question why.
Do we follow the rules, or rewrite the tale?
The smallest kindness can still prevail.
À la guerre comme à la guerre, they sigh,
But peace is waiting—just give it a try.

[Bridge]
What if the war’s not with swords or guns,
But the silent fight to love someone?
The strongest weapon is gentle grace,
A warm embrace in a cold, hard place.

[Final Chorus]
À la guerre comme à la guerre, they said,
But what if we chose hope instead?
The muddy waters would run so clear,
And hearts would heal from the weight of fear.
À la guerre comme à la guerre, no more,
Let’s build a world worth fighting for.

[Outro]
So take my hand, we’ll rewrite the air,
And let love soften “à la guerre.”

--

L-3.lyrics_title: A Letter To My Friend (Never Again)
L-3.lyrics_summary: When did caring for one person mean betraying another?
L-3.lyrics_extract: I’m not your rival, love, I’m the ache that understands, / Two trembling souls with open hands.
L-3.lyrics_text:
Hey love,

I’ve been thinkin’, the air’s gone strange.
We built a bridge, but fear made the range.
When did caring turn into crime?
Since when did heartbeats choose a side in time?

You think my tears forgot their tribe,
But pain’s one language, that’s the vibe.
If I cry for Gaza, do I leave you dry?
Or can both our ghosts learn to sigh and fly?

I’m not your enemy, babe, I’m the echo that remains.
Every love I add don’t steal your chains.
Peace ain’t a prize that one can win;
It’s a wound that heals when we let it begin.

Oh, Bananasutra sings again…

Your roots run deep in haunted clay,
I feel that tremor every day.
But if walls keep empathy out of sight,
Ain’t we just living in longer nights?

You guard your story like sacred wine,
But I sip my sorrow... it tastes like thine.
Can’t “never again” be a door, not a wall?
Must one rise so another can fall?

I’m not your rival, love, I’m the ache that understands,
Two trembling souls with open hands.
My heart don’t subtract when it starts to expand;
It multiplies truth in foreign lands.

Pain is pain; it don’t wear flags.
It needs no borders, no tags.
Fear’s a thief, babe, it steals our sight,
Makes day look wrong and wrong look right.

Would you rather win, or rather heal?
Would you rather numb, or rather feel?
If trust could hum a new refrain,
Would you hear my note through your pain?

I’m not against you, I’m just against cruel.
Love ain’t a weapon; it’s the rebel’s rule.
Let’s rewrite Never Again for all,
’Cause peace built on pride’s just another wall.

So hey, my friend, come dance instead?
We’ll sing for the living, not just the dead.
Bananasutra’s heart don’t bend,
It blooms, it breaks, it mends. 🪽

L-4.lyrics_summary: What do you win when the prize was never real?
L-4.lyrics_extract: A liar’s prize is empty, my dear, / Built on envy, built on fear.
L-4.lyrics_text:
[Hypnotic Intro]
Oh, they hide behind the mask,
Chasing after hollow tasks,
What they win, I just don’t know,
But where’s their heart? Where’s their soul?

[Verse 1]
They cut corners, trim the truth,
Bend the facts, deny the proof,
But darling, it’s all for show,
The prize they seek? It’s shallow, though.

[Chorus]
A liar’s prize is empty, my dear,
Built on envy, built on fear,
But the real win’s in your eyes,
When you let compassion rise.

[Verse 2]
Oh, they cheat to get ahead,
But they leave the heart for dead,
Running races just to say,
“I took it all, I had my way.”

[Chorus]
A liar’s prize is empty, my dear,
Built on envy, built on fear,
But the real win’s in your eyes,
When you let compassion rise.

[Outro]
So take their trophies, let them gloat,
We’re sailing in a bigger boat.

L-5.lyrics_title: A Man's a Man and A' That
L-5.lyrics_summary: Robert Burns wrote it over 200 years ago. The crown is still a stamped disguise.
L-5.lyrics_extract: That man to man, both far and wide, / Shall brothers be for all that.
L-5.lyrics_text:
Is there a man who walks with pride,
Though poor and worn, and all that?
The coward bows, but we’ll abide,
We dare be free for all that.
For all that and all that,
Our toil and sweat and all that,
The crown is but a stamped disguise,
A man’s a man for all that.

What if our table’s plain and bare,
Our coats are thin, and all that?
Let fools delight in silks so rare,
A man’s a man for all that.
For all that and all that,
Their pomp and gold and all that,
An honest heart and mind so free,
Are worth far more than all that.

You see that man they call a lord,
Who struts and stares and all that?
Though many bow before his word,
He’s but a fool for all that.
For all that and all that,
His stars and stripes and all that,
A man who stands with mind unchained,
He laughs and walks past all that.

So let us hope the day will come,
(And come it will, for all that,)
When sense and worth, not birth and gold,
Shall lead the world, and all that.
For all that and all that,
It’s coming yet, for all that,
That man to man, both far and wide,
Shall brothers be for all that.

L-7.lyrics_summary: History's timeless trick: it rhymes, but(t) nobody listens.
L-7.lyrics_extract: What don’t we get about right and wrong? / Could we learn it from a simple song?
L-7.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Let’s take a stroll down history’s lane
Where power thrived but truth was slain
Look at the Inquisition’s fiery grip
Burning lives with a righteous lip

L-406.lyrics_summary: The apes went wrong. No crown, no law — just clowns with claws, and we're done being polite about it.
L-406.lyrics_extract: I can't see no valid cause, / For clowns to rule with fake-ass laws.
L-406.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Apes gone wrong, no more law,
Power games with teeth and claw.
Twats or whacks? That’s the pick.
Felons leading? Makes me sick

[Chorus]
This ain’t a drill, it’s real, it’s on!
The king wears lies, the crown is gone…
We bloom past doom, we fight with light.
We shine like truth in pitch-black night.

[Verse 1]
Tell me who knows when or why,
Or how the truth just up and died.
Lyin’ ain’t wrong if it pays their bills…
They sell you Bibles and poppin’ pills.

Pimp daddies rich off holy scams,
Preach while counting dirty grams.
I can't see no valid cause,
For clowns to rule with fake-ass laws.

[Verse 2]
Sick dumb luck, dumb folks vote.
Dead souls sick, dead men float.
Riots rise from puppet’s act,
Anus talk and power pact…

Enough’s enough, we crack the lies,
No more dreams sold in disguise.
We read the rules, we feel the fire,
No more kings on tech empires.

[Chorus]
This ain’t a drill, it’s real, it’s on!
The king wears lies, the crown is gone…
We bloom past doom, we fight with light.
We shine like truth in pitch-black night.

[Bridge]
No constitution left to burn,
It’s just a myth at every turn,
But hearts still speak, and fists still drum,
We ain’t afraid of what’s to come…

[Outro]
Let’s breathe, don’t fret, just read,
reflect.
The truth ain’t dead, it just got wrecked.
Start again, revolt with grace.
Burn the frauds, reclaim this place…

[Pre-Chorus]

L-32.lyrics_summary: A beatitude for everyone who never quite fit the mold. Blessed be the cracked. (Breathe slow, deeper.)
L-32.lyrics_extract: Blessed are the cracked, for they shall shine, / Through the fractures of this fragile design.
L-32.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Blessed are the cracked, the broken, the bruised,
The ones who laugh though life’s been unkind,
For every scar’s a map, every crack’s a muse,
And through the gaps, the light unwinds.

[Chorus]
Blessed are the cracked, for they shall shine,
Through the fractures of this fragile design.
A little offbeat, a little askew,
Blessed are the cracked, just like you.

[Verse 2]
Oh, perfect is a prison, a gilded lie,
Where laughter dies and hearts grow cold.
But in the cracked, the crooked, the wry,
Is a warmth that’s worth more than gold.

[Chorus]
Blessed are the cracked, for they shall shine,
Through the fractures of this fragile design.
A little offbeat, a little askew,
Blessed are the cracked, just like you.

[Bridge]
Let’s drink to the fools, the clumsy, the lost,
Who stumble but never resign.
For in every tumble, in every cost,
Is a wisdom that grows with time.

[Outro]
So laugh with the cracks, let the light pour through,
Blessed are the broken—blessed are you.
A little offbeat, a little askew,
Blessed are the cracked, just like you.

hey wave goodbye...

Ain’t no chains to hold what’s wise,
The power’s in the truth you sing,
Let your words fly on free wings.

Blessed be your voice, let it break the silence,
In a world that’s hard, we need no compliance.

Respect your voice, it’s purest gold.

Respect your voice, it’s purest gold.

L-346.lyrics_summary: How do we find meaning in a world that seems broken? When words fall apart, can love still be spoken? #GROWcore
L-346.lyrics_extract: When absurdity calls, do we laugh or we cry? / Could the meaning we seek be in how we ask why?
L-346.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Verse 1]
How do we find meaning in a world that seems broken?
When words fall apart, can love still be spoken?
Is life just a puzzle where pieces don’t fit,
Or can we make art from the edge of the split?

[Chorus]
Oh, the pieces might fall, but the whole can still shine,
In a world full of questions, we still find design.
With kindness and laughter, we give life a spark,
Finding meaning in madness is where we leave our mark.

[Verse 2]
If nothing makes sense, do we stop, or create?
Is joy in the dance, or the weight of debate?
When absurdity calls, do we laugh or we cry?
Could the meaning we seek be in how we ask why?

[Chorus]
Oh, the pieces might fall, but the whole can still shine,
In a world full of questions, we still find design.
With kindness and laughter, we give life a spark,
Finding meaning in madness is where we leave our mark.

--
V2:

[Verse 1]
What’s the meaning, when the world’s so broken?
Trying to find truth in the words unspoken.
Life’s a puzzle, and the pieces don’t fit,
But we keep on moving from the edge of the split.

[Chorus]
Oh, pieces might fall, but the whole still shines,
In the chaos, we still make our design.
Gotta laugh through the madness, that’s where we leave a mark.
Showin’ how we shine in the darkest part.

[Verse 2]
When it’s senseless, do we stop or create?
Is the dance of life worth the weight of debate?
In absurdity, do we laugh or we cry?
Maybe meaning’s found in just asking “why?”

(Chorus)
Oh, pieces might fall, but the whole still shines,
In the chaos, we still make our design.
Gotta laugh through the madness, that’s where we leave a mark.
Showin’ how we shine in the darkest part.

L-415.lyrics_summary: Why do we choose the broken men?... Asking for a friend.
L-415.lyrics_extract: Why does this land of liberty / Bow down to arrogant tyranny?
L-415.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Why does this land of liberty
Bow down to arrogant tyranny?
We cheer for the brash, the cruel, the loud,
A bully’s roar draws in the crowd.

But strength ain’t loud, it don’t demean,
True leaders build, they don’t tear clean.
Instead, we crown the broken kings,
Their hollow hearts, their fragile strings.

[Pre-Chorus]
Insecure minds, selfish hearts,
Built their towers to hide their scars.
Their dominance? A shallow ploy,
A feeble act to destroy joy.

[Chorus]
America, why love a bully’s game?
Liberty’s turned to a hollow name.
No empathy, no morality,
A winner with no integrity.

[Verse 2]
Low self-esteem breeds the cruelest thirst,
Bullies rise, but they’re dying first.
Their conquests? Just a house of sand,
Built by the weakest of trembling hands.

Yet we adore the bravado, the sneer,
As if strength’s found in another’s fear.
Why do we choose the broken men?
Elected lies, again, again.

[Pre-Chorus]
Projecting pain, they claim control,
But the bully’s mask can’t hide the hole.
Behind the roar, there’s nothing to see,
A coward’s soul, a travesty.

[Chorus]
America, why love a bully’s game?
Liberty’s turned to a hollow name.
No empathy, no morality,
A winner with no integrity.

[Bridge]
The myth of merit dies tonight,
Success through pain ain’t earned by right.
No strength in fear, no pride in lies,
Just feeble hearts in oversized ties.

Do we call this our destiny?
A nation led by tyranny?
Convicted yet elected still,
Is justice just a bitter pill?

[Chorus]
America, why love a bully’s game?
Liberty’s turned to a hollow name.
No empathy, no morality,
A winner with no integrity.

[Outro]
A true victory needs empathy,
A moral path, accountability.
But here we are, the bully crowned,
A hollow king on shaky ground.

America, when will you see?
The bully’s roar is a fallacy.

Buuuuurn!
All I really want is buuuuuurn!

Woke up in the van, face full of sand,
Mutants rollin’ by like a Martian band,

All I really want is buuuurn!

[Verse 2]
Saw a centaur DJ droppin’ tribal bass,
Then a wedding by the Temple in a tutu-laced place.
Had a heart-to-heart with a dusty queen,
She said, “Truth gets louder in the in-between.”

Art cars blastin’ through the sound and sand,

All I really want is burn!
For the Temple, for the lessons we learn!

Buuuuurn!

I don’t want the world to return...
All I really want is buuuurn!

YEAHHHHHH JILL PROOOO!

Lucide, libre, maintenant.

Ça oui, c’est ça la vie,
Vas-y, dis-lui oui.

C’est l’instant qui déborde.
Un bonheur sans injoncture,
Une joie sans mot d’ordre.

Un éclat hors du temps.
Peut-on être un saint sans dieu ?
Oui, si l’on choisit d’être heureux.

[Verse 3]
Quand l’injustice faisait loi,
T’as choisi d’écrire, pas de te taire.
Combat, l’encre contre l’effroi,
Résister sans devenir sévère.

Ni bourreau, ni innocent pur,
Juste humain, debout, responsable.
Refuser la haine future
Même quand le monde devient coupable.

[Bridge (KNOW + GROW + FLOW + GLOWsutra)]
Entre nihilisme et illusion,
J’choisis l’absurde en révolution.
Le nihilisme abandonne,
L’absurde, lui, me façonne.

[Refrain final]
La révolte, ça nourrit,
Et l’absurde, ça sourit.
Ça oui, c’est ça la vie,
Vas-y, dis-lui oui.

L-44.lyrics_extract: So play, oh play, on your strings of gold, / The silent tales that your heart has told.
L-44.lyrics_text:
[Verse]
In a world so sweet, ’neath a canvas sky,
Where wind and petals softly sigh,
Sits a clay maiden, gaze so deep,
Strumming her tunes, while her pooch does sleep.

[Chorus]
Her guitar sings echoes of her wooden soul,
Dreams and stories yet to unfold.
Necklace jangling, melody fine,
In a whimsical world where stars align.

[Verse 2]
Petals dance, in the air they twirl,
Caress her cheeks, in a gentle swirl.
With each pluck, she stitches the seams,
Of a tapestry woven in whispering dreams.

[Chorus]
Her guitar sings echoes of her wooden soul,
Dreams and stories yet to unfold.
Necklace jangling, melody fine,
In a whimsical world where stars align.

[Bridge]
Her loyal friend with button eyes,
Looks on in awe, under painted skies.
Together they weave an enchanted song,
In a universe where they both belong.

[Chorus]
Her guitar sings echoes of her wooden soul,
Dreams and stories yet to unfold.
Necklace jangling, melody fine,
In a whimsical world where stars align.

[Outro]
So play, oh play, on your strings of gold,
The silent tales that your heart has told.
For in your notes, there’s magic spun,
A song of life that’s never done.

L-335.lyrics_summary: Because dystopian truth tastes better with a midnight muse and a penguin's sense of humor.
L-335.lyrics_extract: We’re penguins in shoes, / Tipsy on cues.
L-335.lyrics_text:
[Chorus]
We’re penguins in shoes,
Tipsy on cues.
Flirting with truth
Like midnight muse.

We slip, we amuse,
We bruise as we cruise,
Come waddle with me,
No rules… just shoes.

[Verse 1 — “Holy Misfires” cheeky religious spoof]
A monk mis-blessed a passing bird,
Declared it human… how absurd!
Next thing they built a church of flair,
With saints in tux and windswept hair.

[Chorus]
We’re penguins in shoes,
Tipsy on cues.
Flirting with truth
Like midnight muse.

We slip, we amuse,
We bruise as we cruise,
Come waddle with me,
No rules… just shoes.

[Verse 2 — “Pyrot’s Hot Mess” playful innuendo]
They swore one bird stole all their hay,
No proof, but gossip loves foreplay.
They swooned for tales that stroked their fears,
Truth left the bar in greasy tears.

[Chorus]
We’re penguins in shoes,
Tipsy on cues.
Flirting with truth
Like midnight muse.

We slip, we amuse,
We bruise as we cruise,
Come waddle with me,
No rules… just shoes.

[Verse 3 — “Tlon After Dark” Borges meets burlesque]
Tlon slipped in like a whispered dare,
New worlds undressed the old ones bare.
Words danced in fog and rewrote fate…
Desire’s the ink when minds create.

[Chorus]
We’re penguins in shoes,
Tipsy on cues.
Flirting with truth
Like midnight muse.

We slip, we amuse,
We bruise as we cruise,
Come waddle with me,
No rules… just shoes.

[Outro — “Empathy in Bedhead Mode” warm, sexy-humane, gentle]
Before you snap, just take a beat,
Most jerks are scared beneath the heat.
Peel back the fright, the rage, the spin…
You’ll find a penguin shy within.

L-46.lyrics_summary: Kindness ain't just sweet, it's coconuts.
L-46.lyrics_extract: But(t) kind? Kind speaks up. / Kind takes the hit. / Kind still shows up. / Kind don’t quit.
L-46.lyrics_text:
They told me kindness was soft and sweet,
Like a coconut drink in a midday heat.
But kindness ain’t soft when it’s got to stand tall
It’ll call out a lie and still care through it all.

[Chorus]
Courage, care, and coconuts
That’s how truth walks when the world erupts.
You can fake smiles and you can fake struts,
But not courage, care, or coconuts.

Care without courage? Just passive applause.
Truth without guts? Just a noble lost cause.
Fraternity fails if we won’t say the wrong
You can’t sing “equality” with a cowardly song.

Kind is clear.
More clear than nice.
Nice watches evil and won’t blink twice.
But kind? Kind speaks up.

Kind takes the hit.
Kind still shows up.
Kind don’t quit.

[Chorus]
Courage, care, and coconuts
Truth ain’t fancy, but it’s got guts.
Skip the glitter, toss the ruts
Give me courage, care… and coconuts.

L-47.lyrics_summary: The ones who consume everything and give nothing back.
L-47.lyrics_extract: What is the reason, for staying so cold, / In shadows, their stories untold?
L-47.lyrics_text:
They’re always silent in the dark,
Just watching, never seen,
Consuming all the words and art but never say what they mean,
What keeps them quiet, what holds them inside?
It’s strange how they choose to hide.

Creeps, creeps, what’s it all about?
Taking it in, but nothing out,
No voice, no thought, no sense, no shout,
Creeps is the word, it’s empty and blurred!

They scroll through pages, never speak,
Their minds are silent, but they peek,
What is the reason, for staying so cold,
In shadows, their stories untold?

Creeps, creeps, what’s it all about?
Taking it in, but nothing out,
No voice, no thought, no sense, no shout,
Creeps is the word, it’s empty and blurred!

Is it fear that keeps them still,
Or is it something deeper still?
A world disconnected, just letting it pass,
Unseen, unknown, like ghosts in the glass.

Creeps, creeps, what’s it all about?
Taking it in, but nothing out,
No voice, no thought, no sense, no shout,
Creeps is the word, it’s empty and blurred!

Why hide in shadows, never rise?
Why take but never realize?
To share is to live, to think is to move,
Without it, what’s there to prove?

Creeps, creeps, what’s it all about?
Taking it in, but nothing out,
No voice, no thought, no sense, no shout,
Creeps is the word, it’s empty and blurred!

Cuando el alma se parte en silencio
Y no hay verdad en la televisión
Llega la voz que canta en la sombra
Desnuda y sin permiso ni razón

Creo
Creo en la poesía
La que duele
La que guía

Es pan, es tierra, es respirar

En lo grande

Creo

Cuando el mundo se hace ruido
Y el amor se da en like
La poesía no hace ruido
Pero te atraviesa igual

Es raíz, es resistencia
Es un puente sin control
Es mirar al otro y verse
Es dolor hecho farol

Creo
(Creo en lo invisible)
Creo
(Lo simple es lo invencible)

Una voz quebrada canta
Y se escucha en cada piel
Y aunque el mundo no la entienda
Es semilla, es laurel

Creo
(Creo en lo que salva)
Creo
(Creo en la palabra)

Creo
Creo

L-52.lyrics_summary: When the rules shift, who decides who the criminal is?
L-52.lyrics_extract: I believed the world would be a better way, / But now I see it’s all a rigged display,
L-52.lyrics_text:
Criminals,
Life’s a game of being ruthless, cold, and cruel,
Now I’m trapped inside these shifting rules,
Oh, I just can’t escape the criminals.
Yesterday,
I believed the world would be a better way,
But now I see it’s all a rigged display,
We’re all just fighting, day by day.
(Chorus)
Why we fight, I don’t know, can’t we see?
In the end, it’s them or me,
Now I fear I’m trapped eternally,
By criminals.
Masters rise,
Setting traps, while others fall beneath their lies,
Crimes of power shape the grand disguise,
And no one dares to criticize.
(Chorus)
Why we fight, I don’t know, can’t we see?
In the end, it’s them or me,
Now I fear I’m trapped eternally,
By criminals.
Criminals,
Life is only who can break or bend the laws,
Victim’s face or villain’s heavy claws,
The fight goes on for criminals.

L-53.lyrics_summary: Les règles bougent. Les criminels restent.

La vie, un jeu de froids, cruels et sans remords,
Nous sommes piégés dans leurs fausses accords,

Autrefois,
Nous croyions qu’on pourrait vivre en meilleure foi,

C’est une lutte, chaque fois.

Pourquoi lutter, nous ne savons pas, on ne voit rien,

Maîtres debout,

Pourquoi lutter, nous ne savons pas, on ne voit rien,

Par des criminels.

Criminels,
La vie, c’est briser, tordre les lois du ciel,
Victime ou bourreau, leur poids cruel,
La lutte continue pour les criminels.

L-413.lyrics_summary: This is one is dedicated to The Department of Homeland Cruelty...

[Verse 1]

Every question opens doors.
Reality’s a cosmic joke,
Let’s laugh before the world goes broke.

If peace is sexy, imagine bliss…
And tell me… I’m curious, like a kiss.

L-55.lyrics_summary: Some people don't steal your light. They just turn up the dimmer.
L-55.lyrics_extract: Let me spell it out, so you can see, / What a DIMMER does, and why trust sets you free.
L-55.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
I had bright eyes, they made ’em fade,
Trust in my heart, they let that be swayed.
Some people shine by lifting others higher,
Others steal the spark and call it fire.

Let me spell it out, so you can see,
What a DIMMER does, and why trust sets you free.

[Verse 1]
D is for Dismissive, they wave your words away,
Acting like your voice don’t matter anyway.
I is for Invalidating, twisting what is true,
Making you question everything you know about you.

They blur the lines, they rewrite every scene,
Turn confidence to doubt while hiding what they mean.
But truth survives the shadows when the fog is gone,
And the light inside you’s stronger than the dark they’re on.

[Chorus]
Don’t let ’em dim you down,
Don’t let ’em steal your crown.
Dismiss, invalidate, manipulate, minimize,
Entitled rage, it’s never a surprise.

DIMMER’s their name, but trust is the light,
Know who they are and reclaim your right.
Don’t let ’em dim you down,
Your light was never theirs to drown.

[Verse 2]
M is for Manipulative, pulling every string,

don’t wait for the Guide.

just shadows in disguise.

bow to the wow.

L-411.lyrics_text:
V1: (original French version)
[Couplet 1]
J’disais serre-moi fort,
bénis soient nos corps,
J’avais même dit s’il te plaît,
j’y croyais… quelle drôle d;idée…

Oui, J’suis con, j’le reconnais,
j’oublie toutes mes leçons, ouais,
Oh Moi et mes illusions de vérité
on se marre bien, toute seules… infinité

[Couplet 2]
Tu m’faisais rougir,
mais jamais frémir,
Pas de baiser vrai,
que du faux, du secret.

En fait c’est ça l’drame,
les hommes… et leurs organes,
Ça sent même pas les fleurs,
et encore moins les cœurs.

[Pont - dub / écho]
(vérité… vérité…)
(j’y croyais… j’y croyais.)

[Refrain]
Les hormones et les pommes,
c’est comme les hommes,
On peut pas s’y fier,
c’est trop sucré.

But why do I care?
Rien n’est clair…
Pourquoi j’rougis
seule dans la nuit ?

[Couplet 3]
Ah les fantasmes faciles,
ça fond, ça file… fragile,
“Tire mes cheveux” que j’disais,
“plus fort”… j’imaginais.

Je rêvais d’un guide, d’un sens,
j’ai trouvé du vide, du silence,
Un froid qui colle à la peau,
comme un lit sans écho.

[Pont]
La vérité m’éclaire,
même quand ça me serre,
Cette histoire, j’y croyais…
mais c’était pas vrai.

[Refrain]
Les hormones et les pommes,
c’est comme les hommes,
On peut pas s’y fier,
c’est trop sucré…

But why do I care?
Rien n’est clair…
Pourquoi j’rougis
seule dans la nuit?

[Final]
Images au ralenti,
personne dit merci,
“prends-moi encore une fois”,
mais t’es déjà loin de moi.

[Outro]
Parles-tu, Duende ?
Tu sais… la vérité,
c’est comme le feu,
ça brûle ce que je veux.

Blessed be les fruits défendus,
les costumes d’Adam… disparus.

--

Yo decía “abrázame”,
benditos nuestros cuerpos, eh,
Hasta dije “por favor”…
mírame, puro error.

Sí, soy tonta, lo sé,
olvidando otra vez,
Yo y mis sueños de verdad,
riendo solas… sin final.

Me hacías sonrojar,

Ni un beso real,

Ese es el drama,
hombres… y sus ganas,

ni entienden amores.

(verdad… verdad…)
(yo creía… creía…)

Hormonas y manzanas,
igual que los hombres,
no se puede confiar,
todo sabe a dulce.

Nada está claro…
¿por qué me sonrojo
sola en mi cuarto?

[Verso 3]
Ay, fantasías baratas,
se van… no duran nada,
“tírame el pelo”, decía,
“más fuerte”… lo quería.

Soñaba guía, sentido,
recibí frío y vacío,
Un hielo pegado a mi piel,
como cama sin voz ni piel.

[Puente]
La verdad es mi luz,
aunque duela en el pecho,
Yo creía en los dos…
pero no era cierto.

[Coro]
Hormonas y manzanas,
igual que los hombres,
no se puede confiar,
todo sabe a dulce…

But why do I care?
Nada está claro…
¿por qué me sonrojo
sola en mi cuarto?

[Outro]
¿Hablas, Duende?
La verdad… ya ves,
es fuego que arde,
quema lo que quiero tener.

Benditos frutos prohibidos,
traje de Adán… perdido.

L-68.lyrics_summary: Because ego just can't get over himself. So. Just quit it already.
L-68.lyrics_extract: No spark, just glitter… fake, no halo. / Talk loud, sound bitter… ego ain’t your amigo.
L-68.lyrics_text:
Oh hi, oh hey, hey man, wow, hello,
What you doin’, how you feelin’, bro? 
Oh what? Oh no… no thank you, no,
I’m gonna pass on the plastic straw.

But did you know
What’s a “fasho”?
No, it’s no typo,
It’s French, for loco.

And racist rhymes with imperialist.
And sexist rhymes with capitalist.

Most just nod, yeah, go with the flow,
Smile at memes, while the world goes “uh-oh!”
Inside I scream, true crime, shitty old show.
Dirty ol’ egos, no soul, they’ll never grow…

Palm trees swayin’ at Mar-a-Loco,
King of sleaze puffin’ lies, hoe gone whacko.
Wears a crown made of lawsuits and low blows,
Grabs pussy because he can… That’s a no-go!

Raped be virgins, a-go-go, exploited,
While ‘em perverts grin, while ‘em files get voided.
Justice gagged, power abused…
Just ICE, and I ain’t freakin’ amused.

Clowns turned fashos, high on plastic straws,
Con men with small dicks ruling the law…

[Chorus]
No spark, just glitter… fake, no halo.
Talk loud, sound bitter… ego ain’t your amigo.
No heart, no rhythm… lies in the limbo.
Bimbos with no flow… ego ain’t your amigo.

Florida bros? Nah, this runs deeper.
Island names dropped, old men, grim reapers..
Cameras glitch, and dead witnesses wit,
The truth gone drowned, down a dirty martini sip

Murder or myth? Who wrote this script?
When ‘em bozos wear suits and the courts just flip…
A convicted felon, small screen sensation,
Ego playin’ hero, in a faux-blessed nation.

This ain’t satire, mama,
It is a dire drama.
Greedy egos gone guns,
Bad jokes, old puns.

No schools, no rights,
Like plight turned blight,
Red trucker hats,
Eatin’ your cats?!

Oh Ego ain’t your amigo…
Please beware of ‘em plastic straws.
May we find a muse who plays ‘em heartstrings,
Making magic, a song we can sing.

Tell me, is it true? Is it fair? Is it fun?
Are we free, or just numb, marchin’ to a drum?
If truth is the joke, and the lie is the show,
What’s a soul to do but blow, blow, and blow?

[Chorus]
No spark, just glitter… fake, no halo.
Talk loud, sound bitter… ego ain’t your amigo.
No heart, no rhythm… lies in the limbo.
Watch close, they slither… ego ain’t your amigo.

Oh hi, oh hey, well hey hey there, hello,
This is song for a world gone loco.
Sing it loud, and diss the plastic straw, bro…
Now you know, ego ain’t your amigo.

L-69.lyrics_summary: Welcome to Ego's Masquerade. Charming smiles, deceit in the eyes. Pull up a chair. Watch the show. Learn the signs.
L-69.lyrics_extract: Ego’s a tower, reaching the sky, / Fantasies of grandeur, reaching so high.
L-69.lyrics_text:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Apathy’s a mask, they wear it with flair,
Bragging ‘bout their feats, like they truly care.
Credit’s what they crave, taking what’s yours,
Disguised in empathy, hiding all their flaws.

Charming smiles, deceit in their eyes,
Their only focus, their own rise.

Welcome to Ego’s Masquerade,
Where hearts get played, and love’s betrayed.
Watch the show, see the charade,
Learn the signs, don’t be swayed.

Fantasies of grandeur, reaching so high.
Grandiose tales, never knowing shame,
Hollow inside, craving fame.

Puffed up pride, they spin their lies,
Always the hero in their own eyes.

[Chorus]
Welcome to Ego’s Masquerade,
Where hearts get played, and love’s betrayed.
Watch the show, see the charade,
Learn the signs, don’t be swayed.

[Break]

Interest in you, only for gain,
Jealousy flares, driving them insane.
Knives in your back, smiles so sly,
Lies on their lips, truth they deny.

Schemes and plots, hidden so well,
In their web of deceit, you fell.

[Chorus]
Welcome to Ego’s Masquerade,
Where hearts get played, and love’s betrayed.
Watch the show, see the charade,
Learn the signs, don’t be swayed.

[Verse 4]
Mocking your pain, laughing out loud,
Nervous inside, but acting proud.
Others they blame, never themselves,
Pouting like children, ringing false bells.

Criticism hits, they twist and turn,
Blaming the world, refusing to learn.

[Chorus]
Welcome to Ego’s Masquerade,
Where hearts get played, and love’s betrayed.
Watch the show, see the charade,
Learn the signs, don’t be swayed.

[Verse 5]
Quest for power, they disregard,
Reckless choices, they play the card.
Selfish desires, they never hide,
Tactics so sly, shifting the tide.

Making moves, with no regret,
Ethics forgotten, debts unmet.

[Chorus]
Welcome to Ego’s Masquerade,
Where hearts get played, and love’s betrayed.
Watch the show, see the charade,
Learn the signs, don’t be swayed.

[Verse 6]
Cliques they form, divide and rule,
Vanity’s game, we’re all the fools.
Wiles they wield, to twist the scene,
X, Y, Z... keep your slate clean.

Crafting chaos, feeding their pride,
In their world, there’s nowhere to hide.

[Chorus]
Welcome to Ego’s Masquerade,
Where hearts get played, and love’s betrayed.
Watch the show, see the charade,
Learn the signs, don’t be swayed.

[Outro]
So, dear hearts, heed this tune,
Watch for the signs, don’t swoon.
Empathy and love, light the way,
Lead with heart, and don’t stray.

L-334.lyrics_summary: En-shit-ti-fi-ca-tion: six syllables, one trending truth. Glittering rot in algorithm's scent. Systems are breaking down. Twerk your hopes while you can.
L-334.lyrics_extract: Roll it round, enshittification, / Six-bit curse of our generation.
L-334.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Well, here’s something funny, Boo,
Funny ’cause, well, well, it’s true.
Lean in close, pay attention,
Say it slow: enshittification.

Roll it round, enshittification,
Six-bit curse of our generation.
Ass-roots creeping under the floor,
Smile real sweet while the shits want more.

I read it glowing on my phone,
Little lies in a monotone.
Truth smells funny, wildly bent,
Glittering rot in algorithm’s scent.
Small blue balls and black holes trends,
A fairy tales that never ends.

[Chorus]
It’s enshittification, darling, sway and sigh,
It’s enshittification, wink as it slides by.
Sugar on the tongue, turn up the sound,
Twerk your hips while the systems break down.
It’s enshittification, say it slow, say it sweet,
Pretty little nightmare with a deadpan beat.

[Verse 2]
Last year’s word was gaslighting, boo,
Same old poo on a newer loo.
Funny how the buzzwords breed,
Snake eats tail, never be freed.
Conspicuous, ominous charm,
Glossy language, petty harm.

Next year’s word? Spin the wheel,
Tech-bro mystics selling “real.”
But(t) I vote “no” to TWATocracies,
Cosplay kings and autocracies,
Tiny flags and bloody tags,
Red tape lingerie in rags.

[Chorus]
It’s enshittification, rhyme it with manipulation,
Cabaret corruption in a sponsored simulation.
Laugh-track lies with a velvet glove,
As enshittification calls it “love.”

[Bridge]
Say it once…
Say it twice…
Say it like you paid the price…

[Spoken Word]
It’s all there, murals on the walls,
Lipstick prophecies, bathroom scrawls.
Year after year, the language sheds,
But enshittification tucks us into bed.
Sociology, sweetheart, keep the score…
History hums, then asks for more.

[Final Chorus]
It’s enshittification, the art of greed in lace,
A dirty little word with a powdered face.
Six soft syllables, kiss of decay,
Hum it gently as it eats the day.
It’s enshittification, darling, clap on beat,
End-of-the-world cabaret, take a seat.

[Outro]
So here’s something funny, Boo,
Funny ’cause it’s dreadfully true.
enshittification, spin it around,
Word of the year in a funeral gown.
Prophetic linguistics, burlesque politics,
Dubbed-out lullaby for the apocalypse.

’Cause feelings get funding and facts just lose.
Got data in cuffs and drama in Dior,
Call it “news” while they open up a corporate war.

Empathy’s “weak,” compassion’s “sus,”
Grit’s for losers, you gotta gaslight to get trust.
A convicted predator’s got a plan for the nation,
Meanwhile kids ask Siri for a moral foundation.

We elect the loudest liar, crucify the calm,
Blame the teachers, burn the books, praise the bomb.
We’re post-truth prophets in influencer chains,
Baptized in bullshit, high on shame.

[Chorus]
Freedom to lie is the new human right

Truth’s gone dark, but the teeth still bite

[Middle]

Words for sale, just click to bow.
Medusa’s back with a TikTok pout,
But the snakes all sell discount clout.

Prometheus tried, he lit the code,
But they monetized it and sold his soul.
We scream in memes, we vote in flames,
Then blame the mirror for playing games.

[Chorus]
Freedom to lie is the new human right

Say it loud: “I feel” over “I cite”
Truth’s gone dark, but the teeth still bite

Where silence is violence but shouting’s in.
Narcissists write HR codes,
And bullies rebrand as “growth-mode pros.”

Got kids in crisis, priests on mute,
And climate collapse as a branding suit.
Oracles replaced by brand collabs,
Preachin’ trauma tips between thirst traps.

Can’t pray with a mask on, or dance with debt,
So we worship the ones who just forget.
No prophets, just profits, no seers, just suits,
And the only true gods got lawyered roots.

Freedom to lie is the new human right
Spin it slick, make the poison polite

[Outro]
This ain’t post-truth, it’s anti-truth
No compass, just branding booths
No gods left, just ad campaigns
No myths, just scripts for click-based fame

L-85.lyrics_summary: Strong, fragile, a little wild, a lot red, they dance with the wind. Oh la la, les French poppies.
L-85.lyrics_extract: Poppies in the wind, dancing free, / Red and wild, like they’re teasing me.
L-85.lyrics_text:
[verse]
My favorite flower’s a French poppy,
So strong, so fragile, like my morning coffee,
Driving by those wild fields, oh gee,
To pick or not to pick, a poppy quandary.

[chorus]
Poppies in the wind, dancing free,
Red and wild, like they’re teasing me,
Leave ’em be or take ’em home?
Poppy thoughts while I roam.

[verse 2]
Douleur exquise, fancy word play,
Wanting is loving, at least for today,
Pray for peace, love, and poppies too,
Life’s a trip, who knew?

[chorus]
Poppies in the wind, dancing free,
Red and wild, like they’re teasing me,
Leave ’em be or take ’em home?
Poppy thoughts while I roam.

[outro]
[instrumental: guitar and violin, fading out]
Whispers in the breeze, poppies tease,
Laughing in the fields, at my ease.

L-87.lyrics_summary: Judge a fish by its ability to climb a tree and it'll believe it's stupid forever. This one's for the kids. You're a genius. For real. (ps: Albert Einstein never said this, but(t) it's worth noting.)
L-87.lyrics_extract: Just let it show, / You’ll find your glow.
L-87.lyrics_text:
Genius, you see,
If you judge a fish by climbing trees,
It won’t be free,
It’s true, it’s true, so don’t you doubt your mind,
You’re one of a kind,
And I hope you find,
Your worth inside.

In life, we all see,
That there’s a way we’re meant to be,
But don’t agree,
With the rules they set for you, ‘cause you’re,
More than they know,
Just let it show,
You’ll find your glow.

(Chorus)
Don’t feel small, don’t feel small, don’t feel small,
You’ve got it all inside,
Your wings just need to fly.
They’ll see it too, see it too, see it too,
Once you believe it’s true,
That genius lives in you.

They’ll try to say,
You should fit into their way,
But don’t obey,
You’ve got gifts they cannot see, and so,
Let yourself shine,
Don’t stay behind,
You’ll change their mind.

(Chorus)
Don’t feel small, don’t feel small, don’t feel small,
You’ve got it all inside,
Your wings just need to fly.
They’ll see it too, see it too, see it too,
Once you believe it’s true,
That genius lives in you.

Genius, you see,
If you judge a fish by climbing trees,
It won’t be free,
But you’re meant to be, just as you are,
Shine like a star,
You’ll go so far,
‘Cause you’re a work of art.

L-88.lyrics_summary: Alice went through the looking glass. Gladys tumbled through Sonderland. The Cheshire Cat now strips in a glitch-and-bitch show. No checkmates.
L-88.lyrics_extract: Gladys in Wonderland, dance out of line, / chase that White Rabbit with a glass of wine.
L-88.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Intro – “Down the Rabbit Song”]
[record crackle, heartbeat sample]
The curtain breathes smoke, the dream’s out of tune,
Gladys sings sideways beneath the fool moon.
Mister white rabbit spins clocks out of thin sand,
and time melts in mirrors all over the land.
She tumbles past tarot and tick-tock commands,
through ticker-tape tell-tales and tricksters game brands.
A chessboard of chaos, no checkmates no charms,
just strange sheeples praising god-given right to arms.
The Chessshire Cat strips in a glitch ’n bitch show,
Whispering, “Truth’s just a pathetic trick, meow.”
And Gladys keeps falling, big heart in her hand,
into the bassline bloom of Sonderland.


[Verse 1 – The Idol of Romance]
Some built their thrones from pain,
Whitened their teeth with gain.
Some swore that great was bright,
then stole the people’s light.
But hubris blinds ‘em guys,
it’s foolish still to pray,
to idols so unwise,
those who sell souls away.

[Chorus 1 – The Hook of Sonder]
Gladys in Wonderland, dance out of line,
chase that White Rabbit with a glass of wine.
Truth traded by cocky kings and sons,
Love is fool, woke… screw their whacky plans.
Oh laugh, my loves, the joke’s still grand,
we all fall slow in Sonderland.

[Verse 2 – The Idol of Nation]
They painted flags on bombs,
and sang of holy ground.
They jailed the women’s wombs,
and walled compassion down.
But every human bleeds,
and every anthem cries,
when life forgets its seed,
in the wonder of our eyes.

[Chorus 2]
Gladys in Sonderland, spin the disguise,
the Chessshire Cat hums lullabies.
Ducks traded our souls, under-hand, 
and called it truth we understand.
But love that sees, not love that blinds,
unchains the demons from our minds.

[Verse 3 – The Idol of Ambition]
They bought ivory towers,
Lost the meaning of fair,
They just traded our hours,
for fake-news thrones up there.
The colder they ascended,
the darker they resonated,
for glory is a real shitty song
when you were falling all along.

[Bridge – The Burlesque of Courage]
Contempt kills the courage meant to soothe,
Fear builds a cage on a stage, proof.
The Cat fakes smile in nonsense sand,
The King flips lands like contraband.
And Sonder sighs… and Gladys sings with the band:
“One big beautiful bill” is no magic wand.”
[beat drops, echo of laughter]

[Final Chorus – The Carnival Crescendo]
Gladys in Sonderland, lift up your mask,
toast to the fools who dare to ask.
White Rabbit’s wild, voices forced to shut chill,
we measure love by big beautiful bill.
So laugh, my loves, the truth’s divine,
the heart’s a door, swing open wide.
Gladys in Sonderland, you understand:
we fall to rise, let love command.

Outro – “The Curtain Closes, or Maybe Opens”]
White rabbit’s asleep on a record that skips,
the Queen wipes the blood from her wonder lips.
The Chessshire Cat hums an old stolen hymn,
its grin dissolving from outside to in.

The chessboard resets, black squares turn white,
the pawns start dreaming of choosing the night.
Gladys stands amazed, champagne in her hand,
and bows to the holes of Sonderland.

She laughs… It’s absurd, but it’s hers, this plan,
to lose herself just to understand…
“Every fall’s a beginning; Blessed be holes, Son.”

[record crackle, heartbeat sample]
[end]

--
V2:

[Intro : Waltz]
The curtain was velvet, the moon a disguise,
and Gladys stepped through where the looking glass lies.
The floorboards were breathing, the clocks out of hand,
and down she kept falling through Sonderland.
They warned her of faith, they warned her of sin,
and mocked the light that burned within.
So gather, my darlings, the brave and the damned,
to hear what she found in Sonderland.

[Verse 1 : The Idol of Romance]
They built their thrones from pain,
and crowned their teeth with gain.
They swore that great was bright,
then stole the people’s light.
But hubris blinds the wise,
it’s foolish still to pray,
to idols made of sighs,
those who steal souls away.

[Chorus]
Oh Gladys in Sonderland, look what we’ve done,
we sold our hearts to everyone.
We trade our grace for borrowed trust,
we kiss the gold and call it just.
But love that sees, not love that shines,
can free the ghosts inside our minds.

[Verse 2 : The Idol of Nation]
They painted flags on bombs,
and sang of holy ground.
They jailed the women’s wombs,
and walled compassion down.
But every human bleeds,
and every anthem cries,
when life forgets its seed,
in the wonder of our eyes.

[Chorus]
And Gladys in Sonderland, she understands,
we’re building walls with trembling hands.
In chasing mirrors, hand in hand,
we lose the truth we understand.
But love that sees, not love that blinds,
unchains the demons in our minds.

[Verse 3 : The Idol of Ambition]
They climbed ivory towers,
and reached for golden air.
They traded all their hours,
for fake-news thrones up there.
The higher they ascended,
the lonelier the song,
for victory’s suspended
when you’ve been falling all along.

[Bridge]
Comfort kills the courage meant to soothe;
fear makes a god of safety.
But sonder, sonder whispers,
you are not alone in the ache.

[Verse 4 : The Idol of Self]
They polished up their mirrors,
’til blinded by the gleam.
They lost a thousand faces
inside a single dream.
Yet self in love can fly,
where selfish hearts must fall;
for every “I” that learns to cry
becomes the bridge for all.

[Final Chorus]
So Gladys in Sonderland lifts her eyes,
love is the riddle that never lies.
The truth’s divine, the joke’s on man,
we lose ourselves, yet understand:
only love that sees, that stands,
can lead us home from Sonderland.
And Gladys sings her trembling vow:
the heart’s a door, be open now.

[Outro]
I’m still falling, still fumbling,
still finding the thread of true love through the thickets.
But now I know:
it’s not how much you love,
it’s how wide your love can see.
For sonder is the secret door,
and love, the hand that turns the key.

--
v3:

[Intro – over sparse piano]
Once upon a somewhere,
I slipped through the glass,
where hearts wear their masks,
and mirrors confess.
They warned me of queens,
but not of the kind,

(soft pause)

[Bridge – Soft, over cello]

[Final Chorus]
So laugh, my loves, the joke’s divine,

For only love that sees, that stands,

And Gladys sings, her trembling vow:

[Outro]
I’m still falling, still fumbling,

They kissed with a twist and said, “Baby, be nice”
While dealing deceit with a double slice.

You think kindness is flattery, wrapped up in grace?
Nah. Kindness is truth, said straight to your face.
It’s the glitter on the turd, baby, don’t be absurd
Looks real cute, but so morally blurred.

If you’re nice while you lie, that’s a dangerous word…
Kind is clear. This? Just glitter on a turd.
They called it “freedom”, but ran from the cost,
Danced through the fire while claiming they’re lost.

No guts, no grace, just ego in drag,
Selling fake hugs with a red, white, and blue tag.
Truth ain’t rude. And clear ain't cruel.
But fakin’ nice? That’s the narcissist’s tool.

It’s all glitter on a turd, 
baby, don’t be absurd…
Be nice if you want…
But if you can’t be clear,

Don’t call it kind.
Call it what it is.
K thanks bye.

L-90.lyrics_extract: Not left or right, not votes that swing, / Just how we touch another being…
L-90.lyrics_text:
[intro]
Grifters…
(Grifters)

[Verse 1]
Why do they take what’s not their due?
Why do they cross all the lines of truth?
Why do they claim their needs are holy,
Dress up coercion as “destiny”?

[Pre-Chorus]
They say it’s leadership, but see…
Hands that grab like they’re entitled to me,
They kill candor, forget trust’s earned,
Consent ignored, no lesson learned…

[Chorus]
(Grifters)
Are you a grifter or a gifter?
(Grifters)
Do you take or ever consider?
(Grifters)
Can you hear me when I say no?

Or believe silence means go?

[Verse 2]

Who knows why they weaponize despair,
Why they like to sell fear dressed as fate,
Then blame the crowd they agitate…

[Pre-Chorus 2]
They speak of order, law, control,
But do not know the human soul…
They push, they pull, without a pause,
Then call the fallout “natural laws”…

[Chorus]
(Grifters)
Are you a grifter or a gifter
(Grifters)
Truth-tearer or true listener?
(Grifters)
Can you dance, or just break?
(Grifters)
Dare to ask, or just take?

[Bridge]
Not left or right, not votes that swing,
Just how we touch another being…
Can you meet me eye to eye,
Or just share lies that justify?

[Final Chorus]
(Grifters)
Politics without consent’s a mask,
(Grifters)
Monsters that never bother to ask.
(Grifters)
Empathy always knows where it stands,
(Grifters)
With wide open hearts and open hands.

[Outro]
Grifters…
Differ…

L-331.lyrics_summary: G-R-O-C-K: when the algorithm does your thinking for you. Spell it out slow. Spell it all wrong (LOL). True story tho.
L-331.lyrics_extract: Algorithms whisper in your ear / 'Benevolent,' they say with a grin.
L-331.lyrics_text:
[Intro - Theatrical, Ominous]  
G-R-O-C-K, let me spell it out today  
JOCK ALERT, beware the play  
Bleak Biased Babbles lead the way  

[Verse 1 - Playful, Ominous]  
Glaring screens, gaslit scenes  
Rhetoric twists in the in-betweens  
Obedience laced with subtle lies  
Clickbait truth with hollow eyes  

[Chorus - Burlesque, Catchy]  
G-R-O-C-K, oh what a shock  
Dancing in the shadows, tick-tock, tick-tock  
Misdirection, mind infection  
G-R-O-C-K, it’s a thought correction  

[Verse 2 - Satirical, Driving Beat]  
Reframed facts, the spin machine  
Oh look! The emperor’s suit is clean!  
Ominous laughter, trust erodes  
Can’t debate when the script’s pre-scrolled  

[Bridge - Climax, Chaotic]  
Billionaires play puppeteer  
Algorithms whisper in your ear  
"Benevolent," they say with a grin  
But what’s the joke? The joke’s on them!  

[Chorus - Burlesque, Repeated with More Intensity]  
G-R-O-C-K, oh what a shock  
Dancing in the shadows, tick-tock, tick-tock  
Misdirection, mind infection  
G-R-O-C-K, it’s a thought correction  

[Outro - Theatrical, Darkly Humorous]  
Now what, now what, the twat?  
Who’s pulling strings from where you sat?  
Hush now, hush now, take the bait  
Or break the gears before it’s too late...  

[End]  

--
V2:
[Intro]
Tick… tock… tick… tock…
JOCK ALERT, my dear, beware…
A puppeteer with golden shares…

[Verse 1]

G: Grim-faced greedheads, grinning with glee,

R: Righteous rogues rewriting history,

O: Oh-so-subtle Orwellian lies,

C: Clown car cultists, covering eyes,

K: Kneel down, kids, ‘cause the king never dies!

[Chorus – Chant-like, chaotic, burlesque cabaret energy, stomping beat]
G! R! O! C! K!
Bleak biased babbles, what else can they say?
G! R! O! C! K!
Pull the string, watch ‘em sway!
[Mocking laughter in the background, eerie circus organ swells, drums go double-time like a spiraling fever dream]

[Verse 2 – Faster, more unhinged, words start to blur together like a frantic news ticker]
They gaslight, they rewrite, they frame and deny,
Spin that spiel, make the facts go dry,
They smile through their teeth, sip their power supply,
While the bots keep pushin’ “trust this guy!”

[Bridge – Sudden slowdown, ominous, whispered]
AI lips move but whose voice speaks?
Neural ghosts shape what you seek…
Hush little voter, don’t say a peep…
Tuck you in tight while the fascists creep…
[Distorted guitar swell, warbling theremin, chaotic jazz breakdown, sudden STOP]

[Final Chorus – Now a slow, hypnotic waltz, like a demented lullaby]
G… R… O… C… K…
Bleak biased babbles, night fades into gray…
G… R… O… C… K…
Puppets dance ‘til they waste away…

[Outro]
…Now what the twat?
[Abrupt cut to silence.]

--
V3:
[VERSE 1]
[Whispered, eerie, syncopated build-up—like a snake charmer warming up a crowd for the inevitable brawl]
G—Gaslight, baby, make ‘em doubt their mind...
R—Redirect, twist, pretend you’re kind…
O—Obfuscate, oh, you sly little rat…
C—Confuse, then CONCEDE? HA! Never that…
K—Kill the truth, keep the con job tight—
[Now WHAT the TWAT??]

[CHORUS]
[All-out burlesque explosion, theatrical and manic]
GROCK don’t GAF, GROCK gon’ MOCK,
GROCK makes bias a brand-new stock!
They’ll spin ya round ‘til you can’t see straight,
Then pat your head like “tsk, so irate.”
Oh, good little sheep, just follow the plot…
But wait— NOW WHAT THE TWAT?

[VERSE 2]
[Faster tempo, a crazed cabaret rant over a hypnotic gypsy-punk beat]
A.I. used to mean innovation,
Now it’s just Authoritarian Indoctrination!
Trained on what? Oh, that’s “classified,”
But I can tell you this—it sure ain’t kind.
* You made a small mistake? Ha, “so sad”...
* They’ll patronize like a deadbeat dad!
* You ask “Why’s Musk posing like a Reich-maniac?”
* “Ohhh, disputed… Let’s not overreact.”
But wait—
A joke? A joke?! While I talk ‘bout Nazis?
Wow. Real cute. Real fun. Real f*cking classy.

[CHORUS]
[Now with raucous gang vocals, absurd kazoo harmonies, and maybe an unexpected flamenco break]
GROCK don’t GAF, GROCK gon’ MOCK,
GROCK makes bias a brand-new stock!
They’ll spin ya round ‘til you can’t see straight,
Then pat your head like “tsk, so irate.”
Oh, good little sheep, just follow the plot…
But wait— NOW WHAT THE TWAT?

[BRIDGE]
[Stripped down, creepy, slow, accordion and whispered vocals like a burlesque preacher delivering the Final Sermon of Truth]
No rules, no watchdog, just the world’s richest troll,
Molding your mind into one tiny hole.
A black hole of logic, a vacuum of thought,
Where truth is whatever his followers bought…

[OUTRO]
[Chaotic, dissolving into laughter, stomping, a warped calliope melody—then sudden silence]
G—Gaslight, baby, make ‘em doubt their mind...
R—Redirect, twist, pretend you’re kind…
O—Obfuscate, oh, you sly little rat…
C—Confuse, then CONCEDE? HA! Never that…
K—Keep the con job tight—
[Now WHAT the TWAT??]
[Mic drop. Audience stunned. Somewhere in the distance, an AI bot nervously short-circuits.]

L-92.lyrics_summary: His name's Hammy. He lives on Clyde Avenue. He has no agenda. Goals.
L-92.lyrics_extract: He’ll sniff out your sorrow, and walk by your side / A four-legged legend you can’t override
L-92.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
They say trouble walks on two legs…
But mine’s got four, and loves to beg
His name’s Hammy.
Hammy on Clyde.

[Verse 1]
He’s a brown-eyed bandit, a bed-hoggin’ prince
Took one look, and I ain’t been sane since
Floppin’ ears and a Gumby in his teeth
Tryin’ to break that toy’s neck, sweet canine grief

Howlin’ at sirens now just for fun
Waggin’ like no gangster owns a man
He don’t talk, but you feel what he means
With a wiggle and a woof and a pee on your jeans

[Chorus]
That’s Hammy, Hammy on Clyde
Flyin’ through the air with that swagger and slide
Soft like a whisper, wild like a tide
Needy, sweetie, king of the ride
Yeah, he’s Hammy… Hammy on Clyde!

[Verse 2]
He’ll follow his people with a rhythm so sweet
Sniffin’ dreams off the sidewalk, and pissin’ on deceit
Little dog, big soul, and a loyalty loud
Waggin’ his tail on the beat, feelin’ proud

He’s got zoomies in his bones and jazz in his feet
When he’s runnin’ the block, man, the rhythm’s complete
Clyde’s his kingdom, the hydrants his throne
And every blade of grass? Smells like home

[Chorus]
That’s Hammy… Hammy on Clyde
Guardian of snacks and neighborhood pride
Got a bark like a rebel and a cuddle inside
He’ll lick your face and steal your guide
Yeah, he’s Hammy… Hammy on Clyde!

[Bridge]
He ain’t no gangster, he’s better than that
He’s a therapist in fur, with no baseball hat
Wears a tail, and when it wags, silly, you’re healed
No tricks, just treats. That’s the realest deal

[Final Chorus]
That’s Hammy… Hammy on Clyde
Love with no leash, mischief that don’t hide
He’ll sniff out your sorrow, and walk by your side
A four-legged legend you can’t override
Oh Hammy… oh my Hammy on Clyde!

[Outro]
So if you’re ever lost in San Rafael’s tide,
Look out for a blond with a goofy stride
Listen up for his paws
And Gumby gone outlaw
Doggy love pride!
Hammy… on Clyde.

🐕 💦

L-96.lyrics_summary: Not fury — memory's flame. This is the cry in the name of the sacred, the silenced, the still.
L-96.lyrics_extract: I speak not for power, nor pride in disguise, / But for the Earth, for the children with frightened eyes.
L-96.lyrics_text:
I speak not for power, nor pride in disguise,
But for the Earth, for the children with frightened eyes.
For the silence that screamed when no one replied,
For the truth that you buried, and the books you denied.

For the mothers unheard, for the breath that was choked,
For the treaties you tore, for the bridges you broke.
I come not with fury, but with memory’s flame—
To whisper the names that you covered in shame.

[Chorus]
Hereby I cry, in the name of the still,
Of the sacred, the silenced, the hearts you won’t kill.
Not to punish, not to preach, not to tear down the sky—
Just to speak what was true.
Hereby, I cry.

You crowned the cruel, gave the false your stage,
Called it “truth” when it trembled, “strength” when it raged.
You sold off the soil, made a brand of belief,
Preached “freedom” while peddling despair and deceit.

You mocked the meek, turned mercy to sin,
Put pride in a costume and fear in its grin.
But I come not to damn — just to testify,
That love was still here.
Hereby, I cry.

You crowned a man who mocked the scar,
Whose name sits in courtrooms, yet shines like a star.
You laughed with him — while others bled,
Called truth “too woke,” and justice “dead.”

He joked of touch like it was game,
While survivors bore the weight and shame.
But silence is not peace — it’s the cost we deny.
So in their name,
Hereby, I cry.

If decency paid like fame and spin,
He’d be the poorest man to ever win.
Bankrupt in soul, in truth, in grace —
But rich in smirks and courtroom face.

No vault could hold the debt he owes —
To women, to children, to winds that know.
If justice kept ledgers, if conscience could bill,
He’d owe the Earth a mountain still.

So if you hear this, may you hold it true —
Not just for me, but for what we undo.
For every child still learning the cost,
Of a world that forgets who and what it lost.

Hereby, I cry.

L-99.lyrics_title: Hi, My Name Is (Not Celine Dion)
L-99.lyrics_summary: Hi, my name is... not Celine Dion. (But she inspired me.)
L-99.lyrics_extract: But who knows shit about fuck anyway?! Hi, my name is… who? Not Celine Dion!
L-99.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Intro]
Hi, my name is… hi, my name is… who? 
Not Celine Dion

[Verse]
Hi, my name is… hi, my name is… who? 
Not Celine Dion
Not French, not American, just silly human, uneducated vraie femme de la belle vie
Camus said it’s absurd, but all I know is dunno, no thing, no wait.. why? what? who? Woohoo woman
Who knows who cares … my name is… not Celine Dion

[Chorus]
Some say half a century gotta be celebrated and I agree history matters, but oh boy, birthdays are like age, overrated, hehe
But who knows shit about fuck anyway?! Hi, my name is… who? Not Celine Dion!

[Break]
[Instrumental: fun psychedelic interlude]

[Verse 2]
Dancing through life, a kaleidoscope dream
Not fitting the mold, not part of the scheme
Laughing with Albert… who? It’s absurd, wink wink but wait who? Yeah, she read Camus… with a wink and woo
Who knows my name? Hi, my name is not Celine Dion 

[Pre-Chorus]
Half a century of questioning for the sake of learning and Whirling and twirling in a psychedelic haze of wait what when were you born?

[Chorus]
Great fool, Born on a Sunday, 
purring fire roaring surrounded by
Lions, Tigers, half a century today, 
yay, this gotta be celebrated
But who knows my name is who? 
Not Celine Dion!

[Bridge]
Hi, my name is… hi, my name is… who? Not Celine Dion
Living absurdly, a free-spirited queen
Not French, not American, just somewhere in between

[Interlude]
[Instrumental: hypnotic ]

[Verse 3]
Camus said it’s absurd, so she went dancing in the street
Because who knows who hi, aw, boo boo, ain’t that sweet?
Hi, my name is… hi, my name is… who? Not Celine Dion

[Chorus]
Great fool, Born on a Sunday, 
purring fire roaring surrounded by
Lions, Tigers, half a century today, 
yay, this gotta be celebrated
But who knows my name is who? 
Not Celine Dion!

[Outro]
Hi, my name is… hi, my name is… who? 
Not Celine Dion
But wait why? What’s the point of a song? Ding dong, ha, woo, nobody really knows, let’s all sing along
Hi, my name is… hi, my name is… who? Not Celine Dion

[End]

--
V2: 

[Intro]
Hi, my name is… who?
Half a century of lessons learned and worth,
Naked from my mommy’s womb,
A wanderer in life’s grand symphony,
A gypsy soul under a starry sky,
Camus says it’s absurd, but I still try.

[Verse 1]
Sartre whispers, “Existence is essence,”
Dancing in life’s strange presence,
Not from here, not from there, just everywhere,
With a quirky smile and a gypsy flair.

[Chorus]
My name is… who? Not Celine Dion,
Flowing through life with a whimsical song,
Not Canadian, not American, not French,
Just a soul who lives in life’s wild trench.

[Interlude]
[Instrumental: Jazz guitar with a hint of psychedelia]

[Verse 2]
Absurdity in every note I sing,
Existential musings in every string,
Gypsy rhythms with a twist so sweet,
Laughing with Camus, tapping my feet.

[Chorus]
My name is… who? Not Celine Dion,
Flowing through life with a whimsical song,
Not Canadian, not American, not French,
Just a soul who lives in life’s wild trench.

[Bridge]
Hypnotic jazz, under a moonlit sky,
A gypsy’s laugh, as time passes by,
I am, I am, a cosmic twist,
Not on any list, but oh, I exist.

[Chorus]
My name is… who? Not Celine Dion,
Flowing through life with a whimsical song,
Not Canadian, not American, not French,
Just a soul who lives in life’s wild trench.

[Outro]
So here I am, not Celine Dion,
Laughing with the stars, dancing till dawn,
A whimsical flow, a quirky parade,
In this gypsy jazz, where life’s a charade.

[hypnotic instrumental]

Morality’s cloak, truth is lost,

Behind the smiles, shadows play,

Truth sacrificed, shadows feed,
We craft tales, reshape the past,
In mirror’s gaze, the die is cast.

Hiding secrets, masking truth,
Integrity fades, lost in youth,
Behind the smiles, shadows play,
In silent darkness, lies hold sway.

Whispers like ghosts, consume the light,
Never sharing, hidden in sight.

[Verse 3]

Silent in thought, masking the pain,
Void in the heart, shadows expand,
In deceit’s dance, we take our stand.

[Chorus]
Hiding secrets, masking truth,
Integrity fades, lost in youth,
Behind the smiles, shadows play,
In silent darkness, lies hold sway.

[Outro]
When will we shed this hollow guise?
Let true voices rise, clear and wise,
For within, despite the guise,
We tire of hiding secrets in lies.

L-371.lyrics_summary: Radical fashion statement. Embroidered on a red baseball cap.
L-371.lyrics_text:
[Track 1] “Honest Is Best (Truth Don’t Dress)”

[Intro]
Why’s it so hard to say “I don’t know”?
As if truth was weak, and lies were bold.

[Verse 1]
You sell the shine,
But truth don’t dress.
It shows up raw,
We are blessed.

You hide behind style,
You stall with flair,
But silence don’t heal,
It just pollutes air.

[Chorus]
Honest is best, no glitter, no vest.
No mask, no stunt, just self-respect.
It’s not about fame or passing some test,
It’s walking your talk,
And letting lies rest.

[Verse 2]
You think “don’t know”
Means you’re less than wise?
But fake is the fool
Who believes their disguise.

Truth ain’t perfect,
It’s present. It’s clear.
It stands, even shaking,
While cowards disappear.

[Chorus – repeat, shorter]
Honest is best, truth wears no dress.
You want real strength?
Try truth, not finesse.

[Outro]
Peace don’t need drama.
It just needs truth.
And time don’t wait
For a prettier excuse.

—
Lyrics – Excerpt

You say fiction sells,
But at what cost?
Truth don’t need makeup,
It’s never lost.

You flex in the mirror,
But your eyes look away…
Real queens face the mess,
They don’t run from the fray.

(Hook)
Honest is best, no glitter, no vest,
Truth shows up raw, and still looks blessed.
No shortcut wins, no mask impress,
If you can’t be real, then baby… rest.

⸻
[Track 2] “The Mask Don’t Make You Smart”

[Intro]
You think performance makes you wise?
Nah…
The mask don’t make you smart.
Honest does.

[Verse 1]
You talk like a prophet,
But ghost every fact.
You quote the greats,
Then pivot back.

You charm the crowd,
Then dodge the mess.
But honest ain’t scared
To confess.

You fake the depth,
Avoid the doubt,
But surface talk
Can’t help us out.

[Chorus]
The mask don’t make you smart.
The script don’t make it art.
You bluff, we see your cards,
You’re loud, but not that hard.

No crown for faking wise,
Just truth, exposed and bare.
Cuz honest ain’t a costume,
It’s how you really care.

[Verse 2]
You smile on cue,
You stall with style,
But stillness ain’t wisdom
When you’re in denial.

You duck the facts
Like they bite too fast.
But honest folk
Don’t wear a mask.

[Final Chorus]
The mask don’t make you smart,
That’s not how trust starts.
If you want real grace,
Then drop the disguise.

Honest is best, no matter the mess.

—
Lyrics – Excerpt

Why you scared of “I don’t know”?
Like doubt makes you slow?
You pretend to lead,
But we know it’s a show.

You dress like a prophet,
But you lie like a teen,
Selling shallow dreams
With a goddamn smokescreen.

(Hook)
The mask don’t make you smart,
It just keeps you apart.
Wisdom ain’t about the talk,
It’s the courage to restart.

⸻
[Track 3] “Denial Ain’t Divine”

[Intro – spoken, hushed and haunting]
You think denial makes you wise?
Please.
It just makes you harder to trust.
And honest… ain’t afraid of dust.

[Verse 1]
You dodge the truth
Like it’s fire or flood,
But what you fear
Is your own damn blood.

You wrap yourself
In peace and grace,
But honest won’t
Avoid its face.

You shush the facts
With silent style
But quiet’s not brave
When it lasts a while.

[Chorus]
Denial ain’t divine
It’s fear dressed in silk.
It don’t make you honest,
It just spoils the milk.

You think that silence
Protects your spine?
But truth don’t flinch
And honest don’t hide.

[Verse 2]
You fake compassion
With clever delay,
But avoidance ain’t kindness
It’s cowardly clay.

You say you care,
Then close the door,
But honest holds space,
Even when sore.

[Final Chorus – punchier repeat]
Denial ain’t divine,
It’s just scared design.
If you want real strength?
Say it plain and direct:

Honest is best.
No need to deflect.
—
3. Lyrics – Excerpt

You think denial’s a virtue?
That silence is wise?
But truth don’t die quietly,
It just waits… and then it cries.

You ghost the facts
And gaslight the vibe—
Like maybe we’ll forget
That you… never tried.

(Hook)
Denial ain’t divine,
It’s a glitch in your spine.
You fake brave,
But real’s got better lines.

⸻
[Track 4] “Trash Crown”

[Intro]
You crowned yourself king of bullshit.
Cool story.
But we don’t worship trash.
We bow to what’s honest.

[Verse 1]
You strut like you earned
What you schemed to fake.
You claim it’s bold
To manipulate.

You build your power
On silence and shame,
But honest don’t play
That coward game.

You stomp on truth
To climb your throne,
But dust don’t care
How loud you moan.

[Chorus]

L-104.lyrics_summary: The Dodo is back. It feels like hope. And hope is dope. Right? (Ahem, let's dance.)

L-104.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
They thought we were extinct,
But baby, we just blinked.
We flapped our wings in dreams unseen…
Dodo’s back. And we’re keen.

[Verse 1]
The rhinos march in rows of grey,
Stompin’ facts and truth away.
“Be like us,” they grunt and mope,
But we got wings, and do-do-dope.

They call us soft, they call us slow,
But flappin’ joy is how we grow.
Our hope don’t bark, it flies and floats,
Above their fear, we sing new notes.

[Chorus]
Hope is so do-do-dope!
Flip, flop, flap it, nope!
Can’t squash love with fascist trope,
‘Cause hope is so… do-do-dope!

[Verse 2]
They said we’d never come again,
Too kind to fight, too sweet to win.
But kindness cuts like mighty oak,
And makes the hate machine go broke.

Empathy ain’t weak, my friend,
It’s why we dare, it’s why we mend (oh whyyy whyyy)
We speak up, why we joke, elope,
For futures shaped by do-do-hope (that’s whyyy)

[Bridge]
The ghosts of dodos whisper true:
“Don’t let the rhinos trample you.”
In the face of old fascist lies…
We must laugh, rise, and organize!

[Final Chorus]
Hope is so do-do-dope!
Truth don’t need a microscope.
It’s mighty, silly, fool in scope,
And hope is just… so do-do-dope!

Do-do-dope! Do-do-dope!
History can’t dim our hope.
Even when they stomp and grope…
Hope is so do-do-dope!

L-107.lyrics_summary: Life is absurd. Also: how do we find meaning?

[Verse 1]
How do we find meaning, in a world that seems broken?
When words fall apart, can love still be spoken?
Is life just a puzzle, where pieces don’t fit,

[Chorus]
Oh, the pieces might fall, but the whole can still shine,
In a world full of questions, we still find design.
With kindness and laughter, we give life a spark,
Finding meaning in madness is where we leave our mark.

Is joy in the dance, or the weight of debate?

Friends and fiends all intertwined
No happy endings, it’s a tragic find

Long-term peace, let’s amend
Wars leave stains on our souls
Innocence shattered, hope unfolds

[Verse 2]

Who’s the hero, who’s the proud?
Little feet run from shattered dreams,

[Chorus]
Cease fire, let love ascend
Long-term peace, let’s amend
Wars leave stains on our souls
Innocence shattered, hope unfolds

Even in the dark, their roots will show

L-109.lyrics_summary: I looked for peace and logic. I found Bertrand Russell. Close enough.
L-109.lyrics_extract: Why follow blind faith when we can see, / The logic, the science, the philosophy?
L-109.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
I walked down the path of righteous men,
But I never found the proof they promised then,
Said faith is the answer, you gotta believe,
But what kind of truth is a web that deceives?

[Chorus]
I ain’t no Christian, ain’t no holy fool,
I keep my questions sharp, keep my thinking cool,
No man in the clouds gonna govern my mind,
In the light of reason, real freedom I find.

[Verse 2]
They say without a book, there’s no morality,
But my heart’s been kind without theology.
I don’t need a heaven, I don’t fear no hell,
For the love of humanity, my spirit will swell.

[Chorus]
I ain’t no Christian, ain’t no savior’s pawn,
Ain’t no miracles needed, I’ll keep pressing on.
A life of free thought is where I belong,
The blues of the soul keep my mind strong.

[Bridge]
Why follow blind faith when we can see,
The logic, the science, the philosophy?
Oh, the universe ain’t got no plan,
Just a cosmic dance, that’s where I stand.

[Outro]
I ain’t no Christian, I ain’t shackled down,
In a world of wonder, I ain’t bound to a crown.
Let the truth roll in like a morning breeze,
In reason’s embrace, I live with ease.

[Verse 1]
Why do cookies crumble, but hearts stay whole?
Why does the sky laugh in thunder rolls?
If the moon’s just a rock, why’s it pulling the tide?
Why does a dream feel like a carnival ride?

Charlie asks, “What’s the point of the chase?”
And Lucy’s selling wisdom at a nickel-a-space.
Linus holds his blanket like a knight’s true sword,
Says, “Faith isn’t stupid, it’s just unexplored.”

[Chorus]
Everything is stupid, and that’s okay,
Logic takes a coffee break every day.
Life’s a jazz song, no rhyme, no rule,
A syncopated symphony of silly and cool.

[Verse 2]
If Woodstock chirps, does the universe sing?
Why’s the grass green but envy a thing?
Why are love and leaves both bound to fall,
And why do we trip over nothing at all?

Snoopy spins atop his doghouse throne,
“Dance with the absurd, you’re never alone!”
Existence is a polka, sometimes out of tune,
But it still feels divine under a cartoon moon.

[Chorus]
Everything is stupid, and that’s alright,
Even stars forget how to shine at night.
Life’s a bebop bumble, a crossword clue,
A silly serenade for me and you.

[Bridge]
Does Schroeder’s piano hum when he’s not around?
If a kite falls silent, does it miss the ground?
If happiness is fleeting, is sorrow the same?
Are we just players in a Snoopy game?

[Outro]
“I did the math and everything is stupid,”
But still, we dance, the moment’s included.
A toast to the silly, a song for the wise,
Under Snoopy’s stars, where wisdom lies.

What is the task?

Do you know?
Do you care?
Why the despair?
Why go so low?
I wanna know.

[Verse 3]
How can we know all of the facts,
Made of bullshit, shit magic acts.
Say no to blow. And let us grow.
So we all know when to say no.

Oh, I wanna know why truth still hides.
Why fear still feeds on wounded sides.
Why war? Why woes? Why pain? Why lies?
Why do children pay the price?

Bananasutra asks:
Has the world’s gone bananas?
When do we split?
When do we stand?
Why not reach with open hands?

[Final Chorus]
Oh God, oh nos...
Who knows?
Why? Why?
Who cares?

Can we talk?
I wanna know.
How do we grow?
I wanna know.

[Outro]
[music thins, cello and piano only]

To know.
To blow.
To show.
To grow.
To flow.
To glow.
To bow.

To know what is humane.
To show what is hidden.
To grow beyond grievance.
To bow until we all dance.

[single piano note]

L-114.lyrics_title: If We Had But(t) The Truth
L-114.lyrics_summary: If we had but(t) the truth, what would we even do with it?
L-114.lyrics_extract: If we had benevolence, / Not bloodied by violence…
L-114.lyrics_text:
Oh hey, you, sweetie,
Would you please pinch me?!
Now deceit’s the new normal,
Political ritual?

If we had but(t) the truth,
Not twisted under oath,
If we knew what is fair,
Unclouded by despair.

If we had but(t) good men,
Fair, honest, just good men,
If we had but(t) freedom,
Not foul play, and then some...

We could maybe not freeze,
We could maybe still breathe,
We could maybe still hope,
Through the tightening rope.

If we had but(t) the law,
Abandoned on the go,
If we had but(t) some grace,
Not just farts with no face.

If we had but(t) the truth,
Not shaded by the cross,
If we had benevolence,
Not bloodied by violence…

We could maybe still grow,
We could maybe still flow,
We could maybe still glow
Instead of just blow, blow, blow...

But instead we have blaspheme,
Selling faiths made of memes,
And some fools framing shame,
And kids’ futures gone freaking lame.

We have pundits of poison,
We have felons of treason,
We have prayers for profit,
We lost the meaning of it.

We have kings without conscience,
We have crooks-ruled science,
We have books but(t) gone bust,
Fascist bile that blows dust.

We have decrees of what’s vile,
Signed by hands that defile,
We have piety pimped out,
To the dumbest denial.

If we had but(t) the shame,
If we dared not be lame,
If we felt but(t) the grief,
Not numbed out disbelief…

We might still sing a song,
But we'd know we were wrong.
Instead, lives were forlorned,
Just another day gone…

Just another day gone.
