L-329.lyrics_summary: Step right up. Watch the clown crown himself king of the corrupt. Ignoramus Divine: a title, a verdict, and one hell of a rap sheet.
L-329.lyrics_extract: Moron, imbecile, idiot fool, / Gold-sick ghoul breakin’ every rule.
L-329.lyrics_text:
V1 (gipsy jazz requiem version): tracks 1-2
[Intro]
Mm… look at him strut.
Gold watch, tin crown.
King of the mirrors…
Court jester of the lost and found.

[Verse 1]
He starves the children, blames the mother,
Sells his sins, then buys another.
Calls it “greatness,” calls it “fine,”
But baby, rot don’t age like wine.

Oh, he grins while the truth gets small,
Spray-tan halo, ready to fall.
Fake-saint swagger, velvet crime,
He’s my little Ignoramus Divine.

[Chorus]
Ignoramus Divine, you shine like fool’s gold,
Sweet-tongued serpent, your lies are cold.
You dance like a prophet, you preach like a mime,

Sing hallelujah to your own decline.
Ignoramus… Ignoramus Divine.

[Verse 2]
Diet Coke crown, fast-food faith,
Planet burns, you just tempt fate.
Silver spoon sermons, a lover’s fraud,
Kissing the mirror, calling it God.

Your empire’s trembling, your court’s on loan,
You built your kingdom out of styrofoam.
Every dollar’s just dust in time,
Oh, Ignoramus Divine.

[Bridge]
Orange glow in a crystal frame,
Whispered charm, a shady shame.
Crowds still cheer while truth unwinds,
The circus leaves the fool behind.

[Chorus]
Ignoramus Divine, with your gilded rage,
Sweet decay on the world’s last stage.
Dance while the ruins play their chime,
Sing hallelujah to your own decline.

Yeah… Ignoramus…
Ignoramus Divine.

[Outro]
Here’s to the jesters, the ghouls, the clowns,
To the empire falling without a sound.
The curtain drops, the lights resign,
Goodnight, Ignoramus Divine.

--
V2: track 3-8
[Intro]
Goof on the stage, 
Mad clown is no sage,
Doofus likes ‘em cages, 
And tantrums and rages.

Junior likes gold, story retold,
Duck is a dick of old age.

[Verse 1]
Starve the kids, blame the mom, ruthless.
Call it one big beautiful bill, shameless
Dunce with ‘em straws made of plastic and lies,
Dickhead grins while democracy dies.

[Chorus]
Moron, imbecile, idiot fool,
Gold-sick ghoul breaking every rule.
Ignoramus bragging like he’s divine,
But the rapture’s coming, oh donnie, it’s time.

[Verse 2]
Simpleton tweets with Diet Coke and fries,
Tends to cheer when the planet cries.
Bankrupt racist felon on file,
Psycho high on denial’s smile.

[Bridge]
Orange twat with a spray-tan vein,
Gold-drunk king in a crypto chain.
Cringe crowds may chant, the cult may cheer,
But truth keeps knocking: duck doom is near.

[Chorus]
Moron, imbecile, idiot fool,
Gold-sick ghoul breaking every rule.
Ignoramus bragging like he’s divine,
But the rapture’s coming, oh donnie, it’s time.

[Outro]
Here’s to the ghouls, the dunces, the clowns,
Let us rewrite how the empire drowns…
Orange balloon, deflating fast,
Shady Ducky just cannot last…

--
V3 (Rap Circus Version):
[Intro]
Yeah...
Step right up, step right up…
Watch the clown crown himself king of the corrupt...
Ayo... Ignoramus Divine, huh.

[Verse 1]
Goof on the stage, rage in a cage,
Fake sage tweetin’ out hate on a page.
Talk tough, but his backbone bend,
Got gold for days but no real friends.

Starve the kids, blame the mother,
Greed so cold, it don’t need cover.
“Beautiful bill,” yeah, liar deluxe,
He’s the type to sue God if heaven won’t cut the bucks.

[Beat drops harder]
Plastic straws, plastic souls,
Plastic crowns for the mind-control.
Dickhead grin, democracy dies,
Whole damn world see the truth in his eyes.

[Chorus]
Orange man with a spray-tan vein,
Crypto crown, paper chain.
Chants so loud, the cult might cheer,
But truth still whisperin’: “your end is near.”

[Bridge]
No halo, no grace,
Just a brand name face in a gold-plated case.
Every lie you told, engraved in time,
Signed sincerely: Ignoramus Divine.

[Chorus]
Moron, imbecile, idiot fool,
Gold-sick ghoul breakin’ every rule.
Ignoramus, think he’s divine,
But the rapture’s comin’, oh baby, it’s time.

Yeah, Ignoramus Divine...
Your greed’s your only shrine.

[Outro, cinematic fade]
Toast to the jesters, the ghouls, the clowns,
Watch the gold towers crumble down.
Orange balloon, deflatin’ fast,
History’s echo gon’ make it last.
Ignoramus Divine... the fall’s by design.

L-116.lyrics_summary: Step right up to the paradox parade. Morals, double-edged, coming on up.
L-116.lyrics_extract: It’s an ethical paradox, an oxymoron maze, / They shame what they need, still demand it gets praise.
L-116.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Step right up to the paradox parade,
Where the morals they sell come double-edged blade.
They wag their fingers, legislate laws,
Then break ’em in private to polite applause.

It’s a sugar-spun circus, bananas on stage,
Where yes means no and restraint’s just a phrase.
Marriage or market, they blur the scene,
Stamp it “righteous”, don’t ask what it means.

[Chorus]
It’s an ethical paradox, an oxymoron maze,
They shame what they need, still demand it gets praise.
They swear it’s love, then they pay for the kiss,
Condemn the same trade they refuse to resist.

[Verse 2]
In the chapel it’s sacred, divinely endowed,
In the alley it’s vulgar, condemned out loud.
One buys a mattress, one buys a ring,
Different costumes, same bargaining.

They preach purity, polish the lie,
While need’s the product they monetize.
Suit and tie or a scarlet brand,
Same old hustle… supply, demand.

[Chorus]
It’s an ethical paradox, an oxymoron maze,
They shame what they need, still demand it gets praise.
They swear it’s love, then they pay for the kiss,
Condemn the same trade they refuse to resist.

[Bridge]
Here’s a riddle, let logic stew:
Who makes the crime, then blames it on you?
They build the cage, lock the lid,
Then curse the creature they forbid.

[Verse 3]
Russell saw it, cut clean through the fog,
Truth gets strangled by moral smog.
Love’s not a contract, priced or policed,
It’s a living thing begging for release.

Burn the scripts that barter the heart,
Let freedom finish what law couldn’t start.
No paradox, no moral sleight,
Just justice breathing in open light.

[Chorus]
It’s an ethical paradox, an oxymoron maze,
They shame what they need, still demand it gets praise.
They swear it’s love, then they pay for the kiss,
Condemn the same trade they refuse to resist.

[Outro]
Fold up the map, walk out the maze,
No room for riddles in love’s next phase.
The ethical circus packs up its tent,
Let truth be simple, that’s how it’s meant.
• • •

L-391.lyrics_summary: Enshittification: say it sweet, say it neat. When platforms rot from the inside, someone should at least make it rhyme.
L-391.lyrics_extract:
It’s enshittification, say it sweet, say it neat,  
I make ruin feel good in a deadpan beat.
L-391.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]  
Well here’s something funny, boo, lean in, let me tutor ya,  
Honeyed little horror story, bananasutra’s sutra.  
Roll it slow… EN-SHITTI-FICATION, savor syllables,  
I make ruin sound rhythmic, make collapse feel kissable.  

Low-rent curse of a code-fed generation,  
I lace rot in rhythm, call it reputational.  
Smile real sweet while decay screams “encore,”  
I sell you the stage while it eats through the floor.  

Perfume the truth ‘til it pays my rent,  
Glitter on rot, algorithmic scent.  
Blue-dot dopamine, black-hole trends,  
Fairy-tail feeds that never end.  

Sip that feed, little lies go down neat,  
I make bitter taste better with a backbeat.

[Chorus]  
It’s enshittification, darling, sway to the slide,  
Bananasutra whisper while the systems divide.  
I drip-feed sugar, let it stick, let it seep,  
Pretty little nightmare in a slow, dirty sweep.  

It’s enshittification, say it sweet, say it neat,  
I make ruin feel good in a deadpan beat.

[Verse 2]  
Last year “gaslight,” same flame, new wick,  
Same old sin, just rebranded slick.  
Buzzwords breed in a closed-loop creed,  
Snake eats tail while I teach it to feed.  

Sell you chaos dressed up as peace,  
Charm what clings and won’t release.  
Tech-bro mystics buying what I feel,  
I manufacture meaning, mark it “real.”  

Spin that wheel, next term, next spell,  
Silk on the surface, stitched from hell.  
I dance through your twat-ocracies,  
Power strips slow on its knees.

[Chorus]  
It’s enshittification, curated decay,  
Cabaret corruption in a soft-lit display.  
I lace those lies in a caring glove,  
Whisper “trust me” while I redefine love.

[Bridge]  
Say it once… now it’s yours to keep…  
Say it twice… now it runs that deep…  
Say it like I named the price…  
Say it like it sounds too nice…

[Spoken Word]  
Scribbled truths in the bathroom stalls,  
Lipstick prophecies on the walls.  
Same old beast in a fresh disguise,  
I sing it softly while it eats you alive.  

Sociology, sweetheart, who keeps the score?  
I’ve danced this decline a thousand times before…

[Final Chorus]  
It’s enshittification, dressed up in lace,  
I powder the word, put a smile on its face.  
Six slow syllables, sweet decay,  
I hum it softly while it eats your day.  

It’s enshittification, clap on cue,  
I make collapse feel intimate, tailored to you.

[Outro]  
So here’s something funny, boo, spin it again,  
A joke that gets sharper each cycle you’re in.  
Bananasutra, turn it ‘round, let it drown,  
Word of the year in a funeral gown.  

Prophetic linguistics, I put politics in eclipse,  
My dubbed-out lullaby on your apocalypse.  
If it all falls apart… you know what I’ll do?  
I’ll make it feel good… just for you.

L-117.lyrics_summary: The Better Bananas Bureau of Peace Asks: WTH "Maximum Lethality, Not Tepid Legality" actually means?
L-117.lyrics_extract: It’s not defense, it’s war, my friend, / No truth to guard, no rules defend.
L-117.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
“Maximum lethality…
not tepid legality…” (*)
They changed the name,
but not the game…

[Verse 1]
The shield became a sharpened blade,
The dove was shot, the deal betrayed.
They smiled and switched the words they use,
Then blamed the blood on evening news.

[Chorus]
It’s not defense, it’s war, my friend,
No truth to guard, no rules defend.
They paint the crime in red, white, blue,
And sell it back as brave and true.

[Verse 2]
They built the tanks on stolen dreams,
Then fed us fear in silent streams.
The court was blind, the laws grew thin,
So violence marched its power in.

[Verse 3]
They stripped the schools to fund the fight,
Then prayed for peace beneath the blight.
They called it strength, I call it fraud,
A wolf that hides behind the law.

[Bridge]
When war gets dressed in Sunday best,
Who dares to ask, “Who cleans the mess?”
When war is peace and law is bent,
The truth is just a false pretense.

[Repeat Chorus]
It’s not defense, it’s war, my friend,
No truth to guard, no rules defend.
They paint the crime in red, white, blue,
And sell it back as brave and true.

L-118.lyrics_summary: Pour Jacques Brel, qui nous a appris que les larmes pouvaient danser.
L-118.lyrics_extract: Une valse à mille temps / Une quête sans suivant.
L-118.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Dans les ports où la pluie s’enivre,
Tes chansons font pleurer les ivrognes,
Un rire amer, un cri qui délivre,
Ton âme danse, nue, dans la pogne.

[Chorus]
Oh cher Jacques Brel
Votre voix, c’est du miel
Une valse à mille temps
Une quête sans suivant

[Verse 2]
Tu chantais l’amour comme une blessure,
Une flamme qui brûle jusqu’au dernier,
Les poètes crachent mais toi tu murmures,
Que la tendresse est plus forte que prier.

[Chorus]
Oh cher Jacques Brel
Votre voix, c’est du miel
Une valse à mille temps
Une quête sans suivant

[Bridge – parlé, cello tremolo]
“Ne me quitte pas”… ce n’est pas prière,
Mais un couteau d’honneur dans la chair.
Et dans chaque mot,
Une larme qui s’avoue.

[Verse 3]
Aux marins perdus, aux femmes oubliées,
Tu donnais des ailes aux vérités pliées.
Et nous, tes enfants, dans l’ombre des fous,
On chante encore, contre vents et bourreaux.

L-119.lyrics_summary: Jealousy smells like fear. Your joy doesn't take away my path. EPx22 of love languages, and the math is soft.
L-119.lyrics_extract: Jealousy? / No, not for me. / I like my love with liberty.
L-119.lyrics_text:
Some folks grow green when the sun don’t shine
Peek through curtains, whisper “mine”
But darling, I was never taught that way.
If you’ve got joy, I say: hooray!

[Chorus]
Jealousy?
No, not for me.
I like my love with liberty.
You can dance, flirt, wander free,
Just come back honest, come back true to we.

Some guard hearts like dragon gold
Count each glance like stories told
But I believe in softer math:
Your joy don’t take away my path.

[Chorus]
Jealousy?
It smells like fear.
I’d rather hold you close than own you, dear.
Let’s be brave, not small, not sly,
If you need the sky, I won’t ask why.

They told me love was mine to keep 
But I know better.
It’s not a lock.
It’s not a leash.
It’s not a race.
It’s not a war.
It’s grace.

So if you’re kissed by someone’s light
I won’t shrink. I’ll still shine bright.
I wish them well, I wish you peace 

Love ain’t real if it needs a lease.

[Chorus]
Jealousy?
Nah, not my thing.
I’ve got better songs to sing.
I want your truth, not your cage.
Let’s love with kindness. Let’s turn the page.

If you’re mine, then you’re still you.
And that’s what makes this whole thing true.
No fear. No fuss. No need to spy.
Just open arms, and a winkin’ eye.

L-342.lyrics_summary: Jackboots too tight. Books too banned. God complex too loud. Jingoism 101: the curriculum nobody asked for, now mandatory.
L-342.lyrics_extract: Still stompin’ in boots that don’t quite fit, / But the crowd still cheers, so I won’t quit.
L-342.lyrics_text:
[Start - Radio static] 
Got my jackboots laced, too tight to feel,
Marchin’ through mud like it’s no big deal.
Got a flag in my truck, and spite in my soul,
Burnin’ bridges just to feel in control.

[Verse]
I banned some books that made me blink,
Called ‘em poison from the commie sink.
Pray to a steak-scented holy text,
Then rage when Starbucks don’t serve “X.”

[Chorus]
I’m a red-white-wrecker with a God complex,
Making memes outta fear and complex flex.
March to the beat of a Facebook lie,
(Still) screamin’ freedom while you question why.

[Verse]
Got a drone above with LED lights,
And a bunker full of canceled rights.
I wave my torch like it’s Fourth of July,
While fact-checkers sigh and historians cry.

[Outro] 
Still stompin’ in boots that don’t quite fit,
But the crowd still cheers, so I won’t quit.
With ketchup-smeared truth and fake electors too,
I sell you (freedom), red, white, and skewed.
[vinyl crackle]

Who knew you bite, bark so dark,

But the dog’s just wicked,

Faking jolly boy faces.

Core four snare, drinking snake oil.

Sorry that dog’s just wicked,

Hush hush on reasons, why’s not clear,

[interlude]
[psychedelic rhythm, hypnotic cello loops]

[verse] [intimate acoustic psychedelic]
Jolly snarls, shady, oh so cruel,
Crazy fool, covert, acting cool,
Bastard schemes, projecting smack,
Cowards stab in the back.

[chorus]  [subdued]
Sorry that dog’s just wicked,

Deep dissonance of deceit (a mess)

Boy gone mad, lost in paranoid delusion,
Make believe case of cognitive confusion,
Silent farts linger on, like hot air,
But Shallow twats don’t care what is fair.

[chorus] [raw hypnotic banjo loop]
Sorry that dog’s just wicked,
I mean, just so, so wicked.
Muted players, truth gone loose
There’s no winner in lose-lose!

L-121.lyrics_summary: The hardest thing you'll ever do: just be.
L-121.lyrics_extract:
Stop the chase, and simply unwind
Leave the noise of the world behind.
L-121.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Just stop thinking, worrying, looking over your shoulder
Wondering, doubting, fearing, a world growing colder
Hurting and hoping for some easy way out
Struggling, grasping, filled with shadows of doubt

[Chorus]
Stop it and just be, feel the rhythm slow
In the calm of this moment, let your soul flow
Stop it and just breathe, let the worries go
In the hush of the night, find your inner glow

[Verse 2]
Itching, scratching, mumbling under your breath
Grumbling, humbling, stumbling close to death
Rambling, gambling, tumbling down the street
Hands reaching, heart bleeding, feeling incomplete

[Chorus]
Stop it and just be, feel the rhythm slow
In the calm of this moment, let your soul flow
Stop it and just breathe, let the worries go
In the hush of the night, find your inner glow

[Bridge]
Grinding, grinding, grinding away at yourself
Searching, perching, reaching for something else
Let it go, let it fall, no need to hold tight
Sway to the silence, fade into the light

[Chorus]
Stop it and just be, feel the rhythm slow
In the calm of this moment, let your soul flow
Stop it and just breathe, let the worries go
In the hush of the night, find your inner glow

[Outro]
Stop the chase, and simply unwind
Leave the noise of the world behind
In the warmth of this sultry embrace
Just be here, in this timeless space

[Fade Out and End]

L-124.lyrics_summary: The kids are asking about the double standards. Nobody has a good answer.
L-124.lyrics_extract: And maybe one day they’ll change this world / To one that’ll actually care.
L-124.lyrics_text:
They’re asking ‘bout double standards, kids,
They're asking ‘bout what is fair,
While people in power break all of the rules,
And no one seems to care.

Corporations hold the power high,
No conscience, no check in place,
While leaders make promises they never keep,
Just lies that we have to face.

[Chorus]
And the kids ask:

"Why don’t they pay for their wrongs?
If we can’t lie, then why can they?
Why do they break what’s been promised?
Why should we listen to what they say?”

They’re asking ‘bout the right from wrong, now,
They’re asking what matters most,
Is it truth, or greed, or power games,
And who’s held accountable?

Well, kids, it’s hard to explain this world,
Where honesty isn’t praised,
When promises break like fallen glass,
And fairness gets erased.

[Chorus]
So they’re asking:
“Why don’t they pay for their wrongs?
If we can’t lie, then why can they?
Why do they break what’s been promised?
Why should we listen to what they say?”

‘Cause children see what’s real and true,
They wonder why lies get a pass,
And they’re told to be good, to follow rules,
When others shatter trust like glass.

They’re asking about double standards, kids,
They’re asking for what is fair,
And maybe one day they’ll change this world
To one that’ll actually care.

[Outro]
Yes, maybe one day they’ll change this world
To one that’ll actually care.

L-126.lyrics_summary: You don't know the weight of kindness until you've needed it.
L-126.lyrics_extract: Kindness whispers in the dark, / When sorrow grips your hand...
L-126.lyrics_text:
[intro]

[verse 1]
Before you learn the gravity of kindness,
You must travel where sorrow lies,
See the body beneath the white poncho,
Feel the weight of all goodbyes.

[chorus]
[soulful hum, echoing strings]
Kindness whispers in the dark,
When sorrow grips your hand,
You wake to hear the echo,
That kindness understands.

[break]

[verse 2]
Before kindness fills the deepest part,
Sorrow lingers like a thread,
Tugging at the seams of your heart,
Till kindness lifts its head.

[chorus]
Kindness whispers in the dark,
When sorrow grips your hand,
You wake to hear the echo,
That kindness understands.

[bridge]
In every breath, in every step,
Kindness follows, never left.

[outro]
It’s kindness, only kindness,
That walks with you till the end.

L-129.lyrics_summary: Poetry isn't a hat you wear. It's a pulse you kiss.
L-129.lyrics_extract: Who writes the rain, or signs the sky? / Who dreams needing a reason why?

So many dream of poet’s fame,
Celebrate names like some lame game,
Wearing words like ego prizes…
But joy is awe, not disguises.

[Chorus]
Who writes the rain, or signs the sky?
Who dreams needing a reason why?
Blush deep, kiss a pulse, hum a song,
Feel the flavors roll off your tongue.

[Verse 2]
To want a name is not enough,
To love your life, breathe in the rough.
It can’t be faked, to live the beat,
Taste the rhythm, embrace the sweet.

[Chorus]
Who writes the rain, or signs the sky?
Who dreams needing a reason why?
Blush deep, kiss a pulse, hum a song,
Feel the flavors roll off your tongue.

[Bridge]
Why claim titles, rather than dance?
Seek magic truths, imagine chance…
Each breath’s a rhyme, each stumble, art,
Nurture ‘em sparkles in your heart.

[Outro]
Be the poem, feel its grace,
Explore shadows, shine in space,
Forget titles, laughing at thrones…
Blessed be the song in our bones.

L-130.lyrics_summary: Un canard sans conscience qui joue des peurs et divise. Avec un accordéon. Et l'ignorance en refrain.
L-130.lyrics_extract: L’accordéon de l’ignorance, / Didn’t give love a chance.
L-130.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Il sourit bien, le canard, sans vérité,
Les machoires tendues, le cœur glacé,
Il parle fort, sans âme, de l’air,
Grands discours, comme en guerre...
Un renard sans foi, loi, ou conscience,
un vieux canard sans substance,
Un félon sans honte, ni respect,
Que des menaces mal éclairées.

[Chorus]
L’accordéon de l’ignorance,
Didn’t give love a chance,
Les hommes, dans ce pays,
Se mesurent, au mépris.

[Verse 2]
Il joue des peurs, des airs de haine,
Canard sans coeurs, ça fait d’la peine…
Il parle d’eux, sans se connaitre,
Pour diviser, bon à rien, 
Il ne sait rien, que des histoires,
La vérité, c’est nos déboires,
Les canards, ils s’en foutent,
Ils gagneront, coûte que coûte.

[Chorus]
L’accordéon de l’ignorance,
Didn’t give love a chance,
Les hommes, dans ce pays,
Se mesurent, au mépris.

[Bridge]
Alors moi, je pense,
Putain con, c’est dense,
La vérité, la voix de raison,
Non, non, rien—ni plan, ni vision.

[Verse 3]
Et l’accordéon, il tourne encore,
Avec des rires, des cris, sans pleurs,
Car ils l’ont choisi, ils l’ont suivi,
Comme un faux espoir, vieux et terni.
C’est la danse des canards, sans fin,
Jeux de mots remplis de rien de bien,
Alors, huh, bonne chance,
C’est l’accordéon de l’ignorance.

[Chorus]
L’accordéon d’ignorance,
Didn’t give love a chance
Les hommes, dans ce pays,
Se mesurent, au mépris.

[Outro]
Dans l’accordéon de l’ignorance,
Le monde tourne, et nous on danse,
Souhaitons-nous bonne chance,
Avec l’accordéon de l’ignorance…

L’accordéon de l’ignorance,
Didn’t give love a chance
Les hommes, dans ce pays,
Se mesurent, au mépris.

L-131.lyrics_summary: Carl Sagan said: the saddest truth is how long we've been bamboozled.
L-131.lyrics_extract: Difficile de reconnaître, / Que nous avons été dupés
L-131.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Une des leçons les plus tristes de l’histoire,
Est celle-ci, Carl Sagan nous a dit,
Embobinés depuis longtemps, c’est illusoire,
Chercher la vérité, c’est si troublant,

[Chorus]
L’embobinage nous a pris,
Trop douloureux, la vérité,
Nous avons été trahis,
Le charlatan a pris pied.

[Verse 2]
Difficile de reconnaître,
Que nous avons été dupés,
Le pouvoir au charlatan,
Jamais récupéré.

[Chorus]
L’embobinage nous a pris,
Trop douloureux, la vérité,
Nous avons été trahis,
Le charlatan a pris pied.

[Outro]
La vérité, toujours elusive,
Nous sommes capturés, l’embobinage nous tient,
Le charlatan règne, et nous restons perdus.

L-132.lyrics_summary: Rivers cut stone without lifting a hand. La force douce: choosing love when everything crumbles around you.
L-132.lyrics_extract: Ils disent que la bonté c’est faible, / moi je dis c’est divin.
L-132.lyrics_text:
[Couplet 1]
Il faut être bien malheureux
pour semer la douleur sans raison,
pour étouffer la lumière d’un cœur
par simple trahison.

Mais moi j’ai vu que la paix,
c’est pas la fuite ni la peur,
c’est un feu tranquille,
un courage qui guérit nos rancœurs.

[Pré-refrain]
Ils disent que la bonté c’est faible,
moi je dis c’est divin,
regarde les rivières:
elles creusent la pierre,
sans jamais lever la main.

[Refrain]
Bananasutra
chante la force douce,
celle qui choisit d’aimer
quand tout s’écroule autour.

Bananasutra,
les âmes justes avancent nues,
intègres, vulnérables,
mais debout jusqu’au bout.

[Couplet 2]
Il faut être bien audacieux
pour parler vrai sans armure,
montrer ses cicatrices
comme des fleurs sous la blessure.

Justice, ce n’est pas la vengeance,
c’est l’équilibre des vents,
où chacun gagne en donnant,
où l’humain devient vivant.

[Pont]
Quand le monde crie “gagne seul”,
je réponds “gagnons ensemble”,
le futur n’est pas une guerre,
c’est un chant qu’on assemble.

L’amour n’est pas dangereux,
c’est la seule loi qui sauve,
et la tendresse,
c’est l’arme des braves.

[Refrain]
Bananasutra, dans le feu des jours,
tu gardes la foi, tu redonnes l’amour.
Bananasutra, même au bord du monde,
ta paix rayonne, et jamais ne succombe.

[Outro]
Il faut être bien pernicieux
pour punir sans comprendre,
mais il faut être divinement fou
pour continuer d’aimer tendre.

—

"The Gentle Force” lyrics in English (unedited AI translation, for the curious :)

[Verse 1]
You have to be very unhappy
To sow pain for no reason,
To stifle the light of a heart
By simple betrayal.

But I saw that peace,
It's not flight or fear,
It's a quiet fire,
A courage that heals our grudges.

[Pre-crorus]
They say that goodness is weak,
I say it's divine,
Look at the rivers:
They dig the stone,
Without ever raising your hand.

[Chorus]
Bananasutra
Sings the gentle force,
The one who chooses to love
When everything collapses around.

Bananasutra,
The righteous souls advance naked,
Honest, vulnerable,
But standing until the end.

[Verse 2]
You have to be very bold
To speak the truth without armor,
Show your scars
Like flowers under the wound.

Justice is not revenge,
It's the balance of the winds,
Where everyone wins by giving,
Where the human becomes alive.

[Bridge]
When the world shouts "win alone",
I answer "we win together",
The future is not a war,
It's a song that we put together.

Love is not dangerous,
It's the only law that saves,
And tenderness,
It's the weapon of the brave.

[Chorus]
Bananasutra, in the fire of days,
You keep the faith, you give back the love.
Bananasutra, even at the edge of the world,
Your peace radiates, and never succumbs.

[Outro]
You have to be very pernicious
To punish without understanding,
But you have to be divinely crazy
To continue to love tender.

L-133.lyrics_summary: ¿La poesía importa? Sí. Y si lo dudas, esta canción es para ti.
L-133.lyrics_extract: No hay templo más sagrado / Que una voz que se confiesa.
L-133.lyrics_text:
Cuestiona mi empatía si quieres
Si me atrevo a decir que la poesía es esencial
Es mensajera de una chispa original
Que sólo en la individualidad es real

Ahora es trabajo esencial, en tiempos de incertidumbre
Un acto humano que no se puede suplantar
Explorar, compartir lo que es vivir,
Cuando lo viral se vuelve mercancía al azar

(Creo) La poesía importa, como comer o sembrar
Hoy más que nunca, la necesitas para conectar (ajá)
Más allá del narcisismo estandarizado
Contra el capital global uniformado

Con todo respeto a iglesias y pirámides,
El credo cristiano y la pirámide de Maslow
Y todo lo que se dice que necesitamos,
(Creo) que es en la vulnerabilidad donde florece el alma

Sin certeza, sin suelo, sin red ni seguridad
La poesía respira frágil y sagrada verdad
Testigo desnudo de lo humano,
Una voz humilde, que nos tiende la mano

(Creo) Se trata de contrarrestar la deshumanización
Fomentar empatía, celebrar la alteridad
Aprender desde voces ajenas
Confiar en el poder de transformar nuestra identidad

(Creo) Es denunciar manipulación narcisista
Resistir las fuerzas que dividen y corrompen
Existir por encima del olvido tóxico
Compartir sentido, abrir la conversación

(Creo) Se trata de acabar con ciclos de odio y venganza
Vivir sin pruebas, sin ego, sin balanza
Construir puentes sobre grietas falsas
Y ver magia en cada paso de esperanza

Lo sabes cuando la ves, cuando fluye
Esa voz poética, cruda, que influye
Canta sentido, conexión y asombro
Y a veces hasta hace vibrar el corazón hondo

(Creo) Porque capta texturas humanas profundas
Pinta belleza en diferencias fecundas
Más allá de cañones y culturas
No es disfraz, es verdad sin censura

Es lenguaje humilde hecho de lo diario
Que demuestra ser sagrado y necesario
Llena el vacío de una voz que abraza
Como que amar es dios, y cantar no se rechaza

(Creo) Por eso la poesía es necesidad
Un medio, un lenguaje para esta nueva edad
Un camino al alma, la dignidad
Un canto de vida, belleza y verdad

L-134.lyrics_summary: Bienvenue au bal. Les salauds ont réservé la meilleure table.
L-134.lyrics_extract:
Trois types de salauds, faut l’dire clair:
Les politiques, les patrons, les faiseurs d’prières.
L-134.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Bienvenue, mesdames et messieurs,
Au grand bal des vertus douteuses.
Ici, les salauds dansent heureux,
Les cœurs vendus, les mains soyeuses.

Leur morale est bien repassée,
Mais toujours un peu tachée.

[Refrain]
C’est le temps, le temps des salauds,
Des faux héros, des pantins d’ego,
Qui dansent, qui dansent sous les drapeaux,
Au bal, au bal des salauds!

C’est le temps des salauds, oh-oh,
Des beaux parleurs, des faux normaux,
Qui rient très haut… pour mentir plus beau.

[Couplet 1 : Le délire raisonnable]
Le nouveau réalisme, c’est l’art des salauds,
Un délirium sobre, cynisme en costard chaud.
Ils vendent la peur sous cellophane,

Et t’appellent “extrême” si tu dis “humain”.
Ils posent des questions de sages,
Mais répondent comme des mirages sauvages.
Ils jouent à la raison... mais raisonnent faux,
C’est la saison, la moisson des salauds.

[Refrain]
C’est le temps, le temps des salauds,
Des faux héros, des cerveaux trop clos,
Qui dansent, qui dansent sous les drapeaux,
Au bal, au bal des salauds!

[Couplet 2 : Les alliances du vide]
Trois types de salauds, faut l’dire clair:
Les politiques, les patrons, les faiseurs d’prières.
Ceux qui savent mais trahissent,

Eux les lâches, qui profitent.
Le p’tit Jupiter, Machiavel au moral,
Fait valser les foules dans son bal libéral.
Il pactise, il nuance, tord le vrai,
Pour qu’le faux paraisse sensé.

[Pont]
Forts avec les faibles, faibles avec les forts,
Ils vendent la paix pendant qu’ils signent la mort.
“Bon courage”, qu’ils disent, le sourire faux,
Mais c’est un orage… on danse, salauds?

[Couplet 3 : Les fous et les faux]
Les fous aboient, les salauds cadrent,
Et les cons signent tous les contrats.
Les uns hurlent, les autres calculent,
Et les lucides… se taisent, s’annulent.

Les idoles changent, les valeurs se vendent,
La foule like, la vérité s’attend.
Les héros sont devenus salauds,
Nous, figurants d’un online show.

[Refrain Final]
C’est le temps, le temps des salauds,
Des faux héros, des gros egos,
Qui valsent au rythme des fiascos,
Au bal, au bal des salauds!
(oh-oh)
Au bal… des salauds.

[Outro]
J’en ai aimé, des salauds, c’est vrai,
Leurs mots brillants, leurs airs parfaits.
Mais minuit sonne, le bal s’oublie,
Ces salauds-là ne dansent plus… avec ma vie.

L-135.lyrics_summary: Dans les ombres du scrutin, ils dansent. Mais on les voit.
L-135.lyrics_extract: Promesses creuses, des espoirs détournés, / Dans ce théâtre, on refuse de jouer.
L-135.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
[Spoken] “Écoute bien, ici commence la révolution.”

[Verse 1]
Dans les ombres, ils avancent, mépris en silence,
Sous leurs sourires, des mensonges en cadence,
Ils promettent des rêves, des illusions vaines,
Dans cette élection, tout n’est que peine.

[Chorus] [soft] [acoustic]
Ils murmurent des connexions sincères,
Marionnettes dans ce bal électoral,
On perçoit leurs intentions éphémères,
Dans cette lutte, on se fait radical.

[Verse 2]
Slogans brillants, vérité déformée,
Masques et rires, tout est maquillé,
Promesses creuses, des espoirs détournés,
Dans ce théâtre, on refuse de jouer.

[Chorus] [soft] [acoustic]
Ils murmurent des connexions sincères,
Marionnettes dans ce bal électoral,
On perçoit leurs intentions éphémères,
Dans cette lutte, on se fait radical.

[Bridge]
Sous les étoiles, la vérité brille,
Dans cette obscurité, on dévoile leurs filles,
Liberté, justice, nos armes de guerre,
Révolte, on éclaire cette terre.

[Chorus] [soft] [acoustic]
Ils murmurent des connexions sincères,
Marionnettes dans ce bal électoral,
On perçoit leurs intentions éphémères,
Dans cette lutte, on se fait radical.

[Outro]
[Spoken] “La révolution éclate, écoute la vérité.”

L-137.lyrics_summary: Je vous parle d'un temps où Macron mentait avec éclat. Ah, le bon vieux temps.
L-137.lyrics_extract: La liberté ? Elle s’efface dans ses bras, / Et sous sa loi, tout ça ne compte plus, voilà.
L-137.lyrics_text:
Je vous parle d’un temps
Que les moins de vingt ans
Ne peuvent pas connaître
Macron en ce temps-là
Mentait avec éclat
On croyait à ses lettres
Et sous les beaux discours
S’élevait sans détour
Son grand mépris funeste
L’égalité, la paix,
Il en riait en secret,
Son égo seul l’atteste.
Le système, ça voulait dire on est foutu,
On croyait à la justice, mais c’est perdu,
La liberté ? Elle s’efface dans ses bras,
Et sous sa loi, tout ça ne compte plus, voilà.

L-143.lyrics_summary: An ode to Liberty. Written when she needed reminding of herself. Inspired by Victor Hugo.
L-143.lyrics_extract: Glory to you, O Liberty, your boundless temple.
L-143.lyrics_text:
Glory to you, O Liberty, your boundless temple
Rises in the heavens, built on eternal law!
Man was made to serve you, and in his mighty heart
You must reign as a god, in awe.
Glory to you! Already the shadows flee the sunrise,
Already under distant skies the lightning glows,
And the future, crowned with roaring light,
Rises from the grave where darkness grows.
Rise up, ye naked peoples, slaves of tyrant masters!
Break your chains! The day is bright!
People! To your butchers, to their wicked laws,
Oppose but justice and the sky’s clear light!
Let the storm’s fire ignite your brow with fury!
Let the tempest open your eyes at last!
That in this righteous battle, beneath honest thunder,
Your cry be noble, fierce, and vast!
Ah! What do I see? They rise! O sublime army!
They stand beneath the living flag once more!
And I, standing proud, my soul aflame,
Shall tell the tyrants of the earth... farewell forevermore!

L-384.lyrics_extract: Lolita in Pensacola, singin’ hallelujah it’s all absurd, / Askin’ in tongues nobody’s heard.
L-384.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
I invite you to join me in this lucid dream,
Butterflies spin in our bloodstream.
Breathe slow, Gulf of Mexico’s gone,
Let’s cheer to stories from a millennium that’s done.

[Pre-Chorus]
Sunburnt lips and a half-priced beer,
Lost in a jukebox atmosphere,
She don’t know yet, but the heat gon’ teach
Down here, "beach" don’t rhyme with "bitch".

[Chorus]
Lolita in Pensacola, singin’ hallelujah in a southern bar room,
Jukebox went poof, wrong time, wrong tune.
She asked out loud, silence, they stared at her speech,
Didn’t know "beach" don’t sound like "bitch".

[Verse 2]
Alligators grin like green kings belong,
Triple K ghosts, Confederate songs...
A postcard world with bigots inside,
Where color dictates who gets to ride.

[Bridge]
She knows it now, the fears, the divide,
The hush that stares when the jukebox dies.
She hums her truth through a bourbon haze,
"Why can’t love be the law these days?"

[Chorus]
Lolita in Pensacola, singin’ hallelujah it’s all absurd,
Askin’ in tongues nobody’s heard.
Trippin’ through prejudice, sweet and strange,
Singin’ "brave hearts don’t see no fear, let’s change." 

[Outro]
Under neon crosses and hurricane lights,
She learns what freedom costs at night.
And somewhere deep, her accent still drips 
With wonder, whiskey… please bite my lips.

Didn’t know "beach" don’t sound like "bitch".

⸻
French Version (psychédélique gipsy blues du sud)

[Couplet 1]
Je t’invite à plonger dans ce rêve lucide,
Des papillons dans le ventre, c’est si candide.
Respirons ensemble, la brise est salée,
Je te murmure l’ancien monde oublié.

[Pré-Refrain]
Mes lèvres brûlées, un verre en main,
Les airs du Sud tournent en refrain.
Elle ne sait pas encore, mais la vie l’enseigne
Ici “beach” ne rime pas avec "b!tch", ma reine.

[Refrain — Hook]
Lolita à Pensacola, chante à la lune soda,
Pieds nus, perdue, dans un bar d’autrefois.
Elle rit des accents, les gens se figent,
Ne savait pas qu’ici les mots foudroient. 

[Couplet 2]
Les alligators rient sous le soleil pâle,
Les fantômes du Sud fredonnent leurs râles.
Des drapeaux fanés, des regards de glace,
Les couleurs séparent plus que les classes.

[Pont]
Elle comprend, ce silence, ce froid,
Quand la musique s’arrête, tout se voit.
Elle chante encore, d’une voix troublée,
“Pourquoi l’amour n’est pas la loi sacrée ?”

[Refrain reprise]
Lolita à Pensacola, prophète des mirages doux,
Danse sur la frontière, entre peur et bijou.
Trébuche dans les préjugés, cœur étrange,
Chante “les âmes n’ont pas de teinte qui change.”

[Outro]
Sous les néons saints et les vents d’orage,
Elle découvre le prix du voyage.
Son accent pleure, mais reste fier,
Un rêve bleu sur une terre amère.

L-327.lyrics_title: Love from the Future (The Hesse Song)
L-327.lyrics_summary: A letter from the future, in two languages: you were never broken. You were always the melody.
L-327.lyrics_extract: You were never broken / only wide open / Tu étais déjà / la mélodie...
L-327.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Intro]
A letter sent across the stars  
Carried by time, sealed in light  

[Verse 1]
You didn’t know what you were reading  
Pas vraiment, pas encore  
But your bones knew the meaning  
Un frisson dans le corps  
There were no words, just glowing hush  
Silence thick with golden dust  
A book that whispered to the dark  
Stars shine brighter in the dusk  

[Chorus]
From the future  
je t’écris  
Avec tendresse et mélancolie  
You were never broken  
only wide open  
Tu étais déjà  
la mélodie  

[Verse 2]
You thought you were too soft, too much  
Mais tu étais juste vivante  
Tears spilled quietly at touch  
You loved like time was urgent  
They called it fragile, called it phase  
But love that lingers through the haze  
Even unspoken, even still  
Is not afraid, and always stays  

[Chorus]
From the future  
je t’écris  
Pas pour guérir  
mais pour bénir  
You were never wrong to feel so deep  
Tu es la preuve  
qu’on peut guérir  

[Bridge]
You are the plot, ma douce  
Pas une erreur, une étoile filante  
Don’t dim. Don’t fold.  
Keep that heart defiant  
You weren’t made for cages  
You are the song that plays  
when the world forgets its pages  
and silence starts to sway  

[Chorus]
From the future  
I see you  
And I still cry,
but now I do it  
for you, too  
Tu es la chanson  
qui m’a sauvée  

[Outro]
Love from the future  
Je te promets  
—

L-149.lyrics_summary: Make America Humane Again. It's not a radical idea. It should not be.
L-149.lyrics_extract: If hate makes you great, then what’s freedom for? / Ain’t justice meant to open doors?
L-149.lyrics_text:
They said kindness is weak, that care don’t pay,
Till the tide rolls in and sweeps their way.
Funny how fast they start to cry,
When the big bad wolf eats their piece of the pie.

They preach greed like it’s heaven’s plan,
But tell me, who’s got blood on their hands?
They call it strength when they kick you down,
Till the tables turn, now who wears the crown?

[Chorus]
If hate makes you great, then what’s freedom for?
Ain’t justice meant to open doors?
If “strong” means cruel, then count me out,
It’s time to flip this thing around!
So say it loud, say it plain:
Make America Humane Again! (MAHA! MAHA!)

They yell ‘fake news!’ when the truth feels tight,
But the facts don’t care ‘bout their spotlight.
Build up walls, but the cracks run deep,
House of cards ain’t built to keep.

They call love soft, but fear’s their game,
Selling power wrapped in shame.
But look real close at the mess they made...
If that’s “winning,” I’ll take last place!

[Chorus]
If hate makes you great, then what’s freedom for?
Is it boots on necks or feeding the poor?
Is it fear and lies, or lending a hand?
C’mon now, time to take a stand!
Say it loud, say it plain:
Make America Humane Again! (MAHA! MAHA!)

Liberty’s more than a flag you wave,
Justice ain’t real if it don’t save.
If “great” means leaving the weak behind,
Buddy, you’re buyin’ a hell of a lie…

[Outro… Call to Action]
Let’s flip this script, set things right,
Put the heart back in stars and stripes.
It ain’t that hard, just start today,
Make America Humane Again! HEY HEY! (MAHA! MAHA!)

L-150.lyrics_summary: MAKA: Make America Kind Again. (The harder acronym. The better one.)
L-150.lyrics_extract: Kindness kickin’ up some dust   / Laughin’ louder’s a must.
L-150.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Intro]
(Well hey now, MAKA MAKA, let’s make a little ruckus!)

[Verse 1]  
Make a move, make a smile  
Make it stick, make it wild  
Make a pie, share a slice  
Make it twice if it’s that nice  

[Pre-Chorus]  
Kindness kickin’ up some dust  
Laughin’ louder’s a must  
Let the bitter hearts go bust  
While we’re MAKA-dancin’ on the rust  

[Chorus]  
MAKA MAKA, make it right  
Make a friend in morning light  
MAKA MAKA, plant the seed  
Grow a world that’s built on need  

MAKA MAKA, sing it loud  
Kindness wears the boldest shroud  
MAKA MAKA, yes indeed  
It’s the only thing we really need  

[Verse 2]  
Make a joke, make it true  
Make ‘em blush, then smile too  
Make a mess of grumpy glares  
Kindness don’t play solitaire  

[Bridge]  
What makes a country grand?  
A million kind and calloused hands  
MAKA hearts and banjo strings  
That’s the song a true soul sings  

[Chorus]  
MAKA MAKA, make it right  
Make a friend in morning light  
MAKA MAKA, plant the seed  
Grow a world that’s built on need  

MAKA MAKA, sing it loud  
Kindness wears the boldest shroud  
MAKA MAKA, yes indeed  
It’s the only thing we really need  

[Outro]  
(Make a pie, share a slice...)  
(MAKA MAKA, baby, be nice!)
--
V2: CIRCUS: 

[Intro]  
(Welcome to the show... and the kindness cabaret!)

[Verse 1]  
Make a scene, make ‘em stare  
Make ‘em laugh with loving flair  
Make a quip, make it kind  
MAKA truth that twists the mind  

[Pre-Chorus - Vaudeville Wink]  
Kindness in a feathered hat  
Struts the stage, imagine that  
Twirlin' past the cynical  
With a grin that’s clinical  

[Chorus]  
MAKA MAKA, make ‘em feel  
That kindness walks in heels of steel  
MAKA MAKA, what a tease  
She’ll hug you down onto your knees  

MAKA MAKA, red balloon  
Pop the hate, and sing in tune  
MAKA MAKA, what a ride  
We’re swingin’ sweet with arms open wide  

[Verse 2]  
Make a mess, mop it proud  
Make a wish, then shout it loud  
Make a toast to circus grace  
Where kindness paints a clown’s own face  

[Bridge]  
Before you hiss, before you boo  
Ask what kindness sees in you  
Glittered tears and gentle might  
It’s kindness twirling through the night  

[Chorus]  
MAKA MAKA, make ‘em feel  
That kindness walks in heels of steel  
MAKA MAKA, what a tease  
She’ll hug you down onto your knees  

MAKA MAKA, red balloon  
Pop the hate, and sing in tune  
MAKA MAKA, what a ride  
We’re swingin’ sweet with arms open wide  

[Outro]  
(MAKA MAKA... make it kind...)  
(Oh baby, kindness is divine...)

—
V4:
[Verse 1]
MAKA MAKA, what’s the fuss?
Was it hugs that made you cuss?
Did a stranger smile too wide?
Now your soul feels verified?

[Chorus]
Kindness ain't weak, it’s the fire in the fight,
It’s a soft-spoken rebel with a torch in the night.
MAKA MAKA, make it loud, make it proud,
Make America Kind Already, say it out loud.

[Verse 2]
MAKA MAKA, bless your bark,
But honey, kindness leaves a mark.
It ain’t preachy, it ain’t fake,
It’s the hand you hold when you break.

[Bridge]
You got a right to rage, yeah, that’s true
But what if kindness got there too?
What if strength was soft and sly
And built you wings instead of why?

[Final Chorus]
Kindness, sweet sass, it’s a revolutionary creed,
It’s a punk rock prayer for a world in need.
MAKA MAKA, let it start with you and me
A little wild, a little weird, and radically free.

--
V5:
[Verse 1]
Step right up to the kindness parade,
Where confetti falls and debts get paid.
MAKA MAKA, can you hear that tune?
It’s the sound of a softer, sassier moon.

[Chorus]
Kindness, oh darling, kindness, strip away the mean,
Let’s toss the spite in the washing machine.
MAKA MAKA, dance it slow, kiss your ego, let it go,
Make America Kind Already, curtain show!

[Verse 2]
MAKA MAKA, don’t be shy,
Even lions purr and clowns can cry.
It’s the velvet rope of grace and grit,
A kiss, a laugh, and a candle lit.

[Bridge]
Kindness ain’t quiet, it taps in heels,
It shouts with jazz, it spins its wheels.
It paints the world in rouge and blue
And winks at pain, then pulls you through.

[Final Chorus]
Kindness, sweet sugar, it’s a glamorous flair,
Like a fox in pearls or truth in a dare.
MAKA MAKA, let it swing, let it sting,
Make America Kind Already... let freedom sing.

L-151.lyrics_summary: Not an opinion. A fact. Forty-five billion for cages, not doctors. The land of the free has the most in a pen. This is not a drill.
L-151.lyrics_extract: They say power, But mean despair. / Say you’re safe, Till you’re not there.
L-151.lyrics_text:
Fascism ain’t my opinion.
It’s a fact.
And I’m done pretending
this is still politics.
It’s a prison plan.
It’s a profit scam.
And I’m not playing dumb
to keep anybody comfortable.

[Verse 1]
He ain’t pro freedom to govern,
He’s the new old prove to control.
Wrap the flag ’round chains,
Lock up every soul.

Act like’ law and order,
But facts all pretend.
Profit off obedience,
Make America Gulag Again.

Forty-five billion dollars
To build more walls and beds,
Not for kids or doctors,
But more caged-up heads.

The land of the free
Got the most in a pen.
And still they’re building more?
Make America Gulag Again.

[Chorus ]
They say justice,
They mean control.
They say freedom,
They mean patrol.
They say safe,
They mean prisoner.
They say peace,
But they mean war.

Ask who the cages for,
Teachers? Protest signs?
Mamas with abortions?
Books that free your mind?

Ask who profits off it,
Ask who bought the pen,
Follow the pipeline
From GOP to Gulag, friend.

[Chorus]
They say order,
But want revenge.
They say greatness,
But it’s no end.
They say power,
But mean despair.
Say you’re safe,
Till you’re not there.

So what now?
That we know
Those bozos
Ain’t heroes

All bandits
Who dunnit
Wanna be
White Willie’s

Inbred seeds
All bleed red…

L-152.lyrics_summary: Ralph Waldo Emerson said it first. Select and collect. Make your own bible. Write your own song.
L-152.lyrics_extract: I read Nietzsche and Sartre with a glass of red, / Hemingway and Camus in my bed.
L-152.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
I searched for God in the Holy Book,
But all I found was a preacher’s hook.
I built my church in my own mind,
No pews, no rules, just words that rhyme.

[Chorus]
Make your own Bible, take your own stand,
A trumpet blast, a marching band!
In the gospel of me, I’ll be my own man,
Dancing alone, but with the whole band.

[Verse 2]
I read Nietzsche and Sartre with a glass of red,
Hemingway and Camus in my bed.
Why follow rules from the days of old?
I’ll craft my truth in stories bold.

[Chorus]
Make your own Bible, write your own song,
Find where you’re right, admit when you’re wrong.
In the gospel of me, I’ll sing my own tune,
Howl at the stars, and laugh at the moon.

[Bridge]
Life’s a cabaret, a cheeky little dance,
Between fate and free will, a game of chance.
No need for a savior, no holy decree,
Just the jazz in my soul, setting me free.

[Chorus]
Make your own Bible, dance with your doubts,
Whisper your secrets, and scream them out loud.
In the gospel of me, I’ll find my own truth,
Lost in the rhythm, defying my youth.

[Outro]
So let’s write our scriptures, line by line,
In the book of our lives, it’s all divine.
No priest, no prophet, just the words that we speak,
In this holy cabaret, the strong and the meek.

Just breathe, in sync, in flow…

[Verse 1]
Making songs like others meditate, flex, or pray
I’m not chasing a corporate crown today
Don’t need algorithms to write my verse
My ego ain’t rehearsing for a popularity curse

[Chorus]
Only here to wonder, to learn, and share
Each song’s a little atheist prayer
In a world gone bananas, I hum for peace
Singing truths that refuse to cease

[Verse 2]
Raised atheist, humble but bold
Turning fears and hopes into stories told
Humming for justice, connecting the dots
Silly as it sounds, it’s all I’ve got

[Chorus]
Only here to wonder, to learn, and share
Each song’s a little atheist prayer
In a world gone bananas, I hum for peace
Singing truths that refuse to cease

[Outro]
(breathing, soft hum) music therapy, poetic play
Just a fool on a path, finding my way

L-156.lyrics_summary: MAGA. MACA. MAMA. Make America Mine Achtung. Like a toddler in a war room with nukes and mommy issues.
L-156.lyrics_extract: MADA, Make America Dumb Again. / Ban the books, burn the facts, shut the libraries.
L-156.lyrics_text:
M-A-G-A
Was that a spell or a scam?
You meant Make America Great Again?
Funny.
It sounds more like
Make America… MINE.

Mama?
Yeah… that tracks.
Make America Mine, Achtung,
Like a toddler in a war room,

Like a Junior with no hug,
Like a grown-ass boy with nukes and mommy issues...
MAMA, Make America Mine Achtung.

Say it louder… but only in English.
(Unless you’re South African and white, then come on in.)

You call it freedom,
But it feels like fear.
You call it order,
But all I see is ruin.

MACA, Make America Christian Again.
But not the poor man’s Christ.
No, the white one,
The one with stock options and a private jet.

MADA, Make America Dumb Again.
Ban the books, burn the facts, shut the libraries.
But hey,
Bible apps come pre-installed.

MADA, Make America Disabled Again.
No healthcare,
No net,
Can’t walk? Can’t pay?
Can’t matter.

MADA (again), Make America Delusional Again.
Who needs truth… when you’ve got vibes?
Who needs votes…
When you’ve got merch?

You call it freedom,
But it feels like fear.
You call it order,
But all I see is ruin.

MAFA, Make America Felons Again.
Insider trades, Wall Street saints,
But God help the kid
Selling water on the corner

MAHA, Make America Hell Again.
Hunger. Hate. Hysteria.
Wrapped in a smile,
A cross,
And a flag pin.

MALA, Make America Loot Again.
Loot the Constitution… loot the consent.
Felons in office,
Children in cages.
You promised greatness.
But you delivered grift.

You promised freedom.
But gave us fear.
And more prisons after the mass deportations.
For who, exactly?

The math don’t add up.
The soul don’t either.

Who wins in this America?
Who’s safer?
Who’s richer?
Who’s freer?

MANA, Make America Nazi Again.
Deport the birthright.
Turn ICE into shadows.
Call that... order.

MAPA, Make America Poor Again.
Cut the wages, raise the rent, kill the food stamps.
Hungry kids?
Too bad! we got deportation budgets to feed.

MARA, Make America Racist Again.
Confederate flags in the halls of Congress.
Ban Black history,
Claim “colorblind”,

But only white walks free.

MAVA, Make America Violent Again.
More cops, less care.
More jails, fewer jobs.
“Protect and serve”?

Nah…
Just patrol and purge.

[Outro]
All I see… is ruin.
And no one’s even asking:
Why rule a country you’ve set on fire?
Unless…
That was the plan all along.

M-A-G-A
Was never a promise.
It was a threat.

And maybe the only thing great that’s coming
is a plane ticket home...

L-136.lyrics_summary: Manu, p'tit roi, grandes ambitions, petite vérité.
L-136.lyrics_extract: Ah, le p’tit Manu, sans âme, sans loi, / Il rigole bien fort, de nous et des droits.
L-136.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Manu, p’tit roi, il monte au sommet,
Avec des rêves de grandeur et des lois à contourner,
La vérité? Oh, il s’en moque bien,
Car pour lui, c’est l’égo qui trace le chemin.

[Chorus]
Ah, le p’tit Manu, sans âme, sans loi,
Il rigole bien fort, de nous et des droits,
La fraternité? Qu’est-ce que ça veut dire?
Quand Jupiter lui-même lui apprend à mentir!

[Verse 2]
Il dit, “l’égalité? C’est pour les faibles d’esprit,”
Sa fierté est si grande qu’elle dévore même la nuit.
Avec des mensonges, il bâtit un palais,
Mais l’écho de sa vanité fait trembler les vallées.

[Chorus]
Ah, le p’tit Manu, sans âme, sans loi,
Il rigole bien fort, de nous et des droits,
La fraternité? Qu’est-ce que ça veut dire?
Quand Jupiter lui-même lui apprend à mentir!

[Bridge]
Et dans ses rêves de pouvoir, il danse dans le vent,
Mais il ne voit pas le monde s’écrouler lentement,
Un jour viendra où l’égo géant tombera,
Et nous, on reprendra la liberté qu’il volera.

[Final Chorus]
Ah, le p’tit Manu, sans âme, sans foi,
La vérité, l’intégrité, tout ça, c’est bien trop bas,
Mais quand le peuple se lèvera, comme un éclair,
Le p’tit Jupiter verra qu’il est bien ordinaire.

L-326.lyrics_summary: Make America Safe? Start with books, not boys in blue. Every dollar spent on school cuts down crime. That's it. That's the whole plan.
L-326.lyrics_extract: Give the kids a safer plan, / Not just guns, but books in hand.
L-326.lyrics_text:
[VERSE 1] 
They cut the schools, then build more walls,
Now prison’s full like study halls.
Three outta four behind those bars,
Never made it far in class or charts.

You want less crime? Here’s the clue:
It starts with books, not boys in blue.

[CHORUS] 
Make America SAFE again!
(Stop the lies spinning the spin!)
Make America BRIGHT again!
(Education’s where we win!)
Give the kids a safer plan,
Not just guns, but books in hand.
Make America SAFE again,
Kids need no jails, they need a pen!

[VERSE 2]
They cut the funding, raise the fear,
But learning is what keeps us clear.
Every dollar spent on school
Cuts down crime. That’s a rule!
Kick out ignorance and hate,
Or fail will be our nation’s fate.

[CHORUS]
Make America SAFE again!
(No more gaslight, no more spin!)
Make America SMART again!
(Read, not bleed… press start again!)
Give the youth a real chance,
Not just cuffs, with no conscience!
Make America SAFE again!
Raise your voice, now take a stand!

[BRIDGE]
Less diplomas, more despair,
Is that really fair and square?
Lift the kids, reduce the crime,
Peace and safety take some time…

[FINAL CHORUS]
Make America SAFE again!
(Not by fear, but thinking men!)
Make America JUST again!
Books, not bars, we must defend!
With unbanned books and a pen,
Let’s teach the truth and heal again?
Make America SAFE again,
And never go back to way back when…

L-389.lyrics_summary: Maslow mapped the needs. War ignored the map. How low we gonna go before someone says no?
L-389.lyrics_extract:
So tell me, how low we really gon’ go?
How long ‘fore we all say no?
L-389.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Maslow mapped the needs, no borders, no lines,
But war don’t care ‘bout logic, just bodies and cries.
Dreams turn to dust when the steel birds fly,
A child screams loud... does heaven reply?

[Pre-Chorus]
Food? Shelter? Nah, just ashes and flames,
While suits push pawns in political games.
Kids droolin’, dogs growlin’, fear in the air,
While godly fools drop death, do they even care?

[Chorus]
A bomb kissed a boy and his bike, broad daylight,
The gods took a hike, guess they outta sight.
Now war got a beat, now war’s the elite,
And big daddies flex while the world just weeps.

[Verse 2]
Ain’t no story can justify this pain,
Ain’t no glory in blood-soaked rain.
We know war only knows how to woe,
Can’t flow, just sows more sorrow.

[Bridge]
So tell me, how low we really gon’ go?
How long ‘fore we all say no?
We stand, we rise, we break that show,
But first, we gotta ask… Why, Bro?

[Outro - Fading Hook]
Why, Bro? Why, Bro? (Oh-oh...)
Why, Bro? Why, Bro? (Tell me so...)

L-157.lyrics_summary: Step right in. Corporate clowns, kids chasing fame, golems lost in glitter. Terrence McKenna saw this coming. So did the duck.
L-157.lyrics_extract: Slaves to trends, they just obey, / Dulled and muted every day.
L-157.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Verse 1]
Kids forgot who they really are,
Chasin’ fame, but they won’t go far.
Whinin’ souls at low tide drown,
While winners walk in a plastic crown.
Golems waddle, bend and fold,
Lost in glitter, sold on gold.

[Chorus]
It’s a mass media freakshow, step right in,
Where the truth is thin, and the lies begin.
Corporate clowns, puppets on strings,
Blind to the light that freedom brings.

[Verse 2]
Junk food thoughts, so lewd and crude,
Trapped in a system, they’re so subdued.
Cryp-toCrooks, actin’ the fool,
Playing the game in a corporate pool.
Life’s dictated by a viral stream,
Cash flow kings in a hollow dream.

[Chorus]
It’s a mass media freakshow, step right in,
Where the truth is thin, and the lies begin.
Corporate clowns, puppets on strings,
Blind to the light that freedom brings.

[Bridge]
Living lives that ain’t their own,
Ghosts on a screen, in a borrowed zone.
Slaves to trends, they just obey,
Dulled and muted every day.

[Chorus]
It’s a mass media freakshow, step right in,
Where the truth is thin, and the lies begin.
Corporate clowns, puppets on strings,
Blind to the light that freedom brings.

--
V2:
They think they’ve found a place to belong
Lost in the noise of the growing throng
Chasing the fleeting, playing the game
Caught in a web, all the same

Figures in shadows, moving so sly
With quiet whispers under the sky
Lives on borrowed time and hope
Treading water, just trying to cope

No need for truth, they look away
From quiet truths in the light of day
Drowned in the tide of endless streams
Chasing illusions, living in dreams

Winners in shadows, hard to find
Endless consumers, numb and blind
On the edge of lies and deceit
Watching their values face defeat

Muted voices, lost in the fray
What’s the price they’ll have to pay?
Giving away the core of the soul
Caught in the loop, losing control

A distant hum, they march in line
Eyes cast down, they cross the line

--
V3:
“Ego parade”

[Verse 1]
Youth ain’t seen beyond their egos,
Parading loud like toothy bozos,
Loony bimbos on the prowl,
Kids forgot the truth, it’s foul.
Waddle, waddle, shallow minds,
Pricks and fools, oh, so blind.

[Chorus]
It’s an ego parade, baby, marchin’ in line,
Blowin’ smoke like they’re feelin’ fine.
But they’re hollow dolls, just a show,
Wallowing in the mud, they don’t know.

[Verse 2]
Whiners drown in their own tide,
While winners puff up, full of pride.
Dark luck wannabes playin’ wise,
But can’t see through their own disguise.
Corporate quackers honk and gloat,
On a sinking, shallow boat.

[Chorus]
It’s an ego parade, baby, marchin’ in line,
Blowin’ smoke like they’re feelin’ fine.
But they’re hollow dolls, just a show,
Wallowing in the mud, they don’t know.

[Bridge]
Obsessed with junk, they can’t be free,
Chained to mass mediocrity.
Blind and dull, they won’t survive,
No deep dive, just stay alive.

[Chorus]
It’s an ego parade, baby, marchin’ in line,
Blowin’ smoke like they’re feelin’ fine.
But they’re hollow dolls, just a show,
Wallowing in the mud, they don’t know.

--
V4:

[Intro] 
Believe they must belong to the crowd
Obsessed with noise, they scream so loud
Trash media, junk food's their style
Fools of politics, just full of bile

[Verse 1] 
Cryp-toCrooks acting so sly
Toxic trolls, under the sky
Living dictated, borrowed lives
Faint heart rhythms, dull as knives

[Chorus] 
Not interested in the truth at all
Bland unawareness, no rise, no fall
Blind to the cash and algorithms

New winners are ghosts, can’t be found

Call it “freedom,” call it “faith,” call it “great,”
/ But it’s capitalism point-blank, checkmate.
L-417.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Question one, class:
What makes a nation great at last?
Is it flags, or guns, or the prayers on blast?
Oh wait… don’t answer fast.

[Chorus : protest-chant bounce]
Masss Shooo… TING!
Bananasutra’s on the mic, truth bleeding in the ink
Masss Shooo… TING!
Freedom rings, but it clinks, clinks, clink.
Masss Shooo… TING!
Murica’s gold medal, let that sink,
Masss Shooo… TING!
Another “thoughts & prayers,” reload, don’t blink.

[Verse 1]
Debate me, baby, mental health or metal shell?
Freedom or the profit when the stock ticks swell?
Second Amendment heaven or domestic hell?
The barrel spins like bigotracy’s carousel.
Breaking-news scroll, fresh blood on a roll,
Ticker-tape confetti for the “lone gun soul.”
NRA bake sale, “donate, reload!”
While the preachers teach lessons in holy holes.

[Verse 2]
Question two: what’s the cure, huh?
More guns? Sure, bruh!
Arm the preacher, arm the nurse,
Arm the toddlers first, make it worse.
Lobbyists laughing like a half-time show,
Debt’s rising, body counts still grow.
Call it “freedom,” call it “faith,” call it “great,”
But it’s capitalism point-blank, checkmate.

[Chorus]
Masss Shooo… TING!
Bananasutra hummin’ truth that sting,
Masss Shooo… TING!
Where “thoughts” are cheap and the bullets bling.
Masss Shooo… TING!
Ranked number one, true-story thing,
Masss Shooo… TING!
Freedom, by any means (cha-ching).

[Bridge]
Pop quiz:
If a bullet flies in a classroom and no law changes,
did it ever make a sound?
Yeah, it did.
It sounded like contempt.

[Outro]
Red, white, and bruise,
Stars and strife,
Murica’s anthem
Shoot… to prove life.

L-376.lyrics_summary: Maupassant: master of the bittersweet short story, painted in French with a wink and a morsure.
L-376.lyrics_extract: Oh Maupassant, charmeur d’ombres, / Tes récits flottent comme des colombes.
L-376.lyrics_text:
[Couplet 1]
Maupassant, ce danseur de mots,
Un sourire en coin, un éclat d’écho.
Il peint la vie d’un pinceau de brume,
Des roses fanées aux parfums d’amertume.

Chaque phrase, un baiser, une morsure,
Sous sa plume, la douceur côtoie l’azur.

[Refrain]
Oh Maupassant, charmeur d’ombres,
Tes récits flottent comme des colombes.
Entre la lumière et le désespoir,
Tu fais danser les âmes dans le noir.

[Couplet 2]
Sous le ciel normand, il écrit l’amour,
Un éclat d’espoir, mais jamais pour toujours.
Des vies brisées, des rires volés,
Dans ses contes, la vérité vient nous hanter.

Boule de Suif, fragile, insoumise,
Un destin cruel, mais sa voix nous grise.

[Refrain]
Oh Maupassant, charmeur d’ombres,
Tes récits flottent comme des colombes.
Entre la lumière et le désespoir,
Tu fais danser les âmes dans le noir.

[Pont]
Dans le vent de minuit, il murmure des regrets,
Des étoiles filantes, des amours en secret.
Le Horla rôde, invisible, insistant,
Un soupir d’éther dans l’air oppressant.

[Couplet 3]
Maupassant, maître des contrastes,
Tu prends l’éphémère et le rends vaste.
Dans une vie, tu distilles la fin,
Chaque mot, une larme, une main dans la main.

Ta mélancolie, douce et mortelle,
Fait de l’obscurité une lumière belle.

[Refrain final]
Oh Maupassant, charmeur d’ombres,
Tes récits flottent comme des colombes.
Entre la lumière et le désespoir,
Tu fais danser les âmes dans le noir.

[Outro]
Et sur un vieux vinyle, ta voix résonne,
Les sillons murmurent ce que ton cœur fredonne.
Un dernier salut, une révérence au vent,
Maupassant, éternel et séduisant.

L-159.lyrics_summary: Taboo for who, exactly? A body politics reckoning on the weaponized silence that costs half the world its dignity.
L-159.lyrics_extract: Why’s it taboo to talk of blood, / When half the world’s got cycles that flood?
L-159.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
They say it’s “too much.”
Too bloody.
Too messy.
Too loud.
Too real.
So I ask…

[Verse 1]
Why’s it taboo to talk of blood,
When half the world’s got cycles that flood?
Why’s it shameful to name a cramp,
But not to wave a warlord’s stamp?

Why is “discharge” more feared than lies?
Why do men squirm while a woman dries,
her tears, her womb, her sleepless nights,
while they debate her basic rights?

[Chorus]
Taboo for who?
Who made the rules?
Who taught us shame
in sterile schools?
It ain’t biology that’s the crime,
It’s silence weaponized through time.

Taboo for who?
'Cause I’m not scared,
I’ll sing what’s real
since they don’t dare.

[Verse 2]
Why is menopause met with a shrug,
while old white men get pills to plug
their shriveled pride with pharma might,
but women sweat through silent nights?

Why is "hormonal" used as a slur,
when the whole damn system *depends* on her?
Why don’t they teach us bone will thin?
Why ain’t that in the doc’s quick spin?

Why is a womb a ticking clock
unless it births, then it’s forgot?
Why is my pain dismissed as flair,
while men’s complaints get urgent care?

[Bridge]
It’s not taboo 'cause it’s grotesque,
it’s taboo 'cause it shows who’s next.
It shows resilience, mess, and might,
and that’s what gives the boys a fright.

[Interlude]
Let’s be honest.
It’s not about health y'all...
It’s about control.
And they’re losing it.

[Final Chorus]
Taboo for who?
I call your bluff.
Your squeamish pride?
Ain’t good enough.
This ain’t shame, it’s sacred truth.
It’s guts and fire and ancient proof.

Taboo for who?
I name the cost,
Of every silence
and line we’ve crossed.
So take your fear and go regroup,
the grown-up talk is in this loop.

[Outro]
If it makes you flinch,
it probably matters.

L-161.lyrics_summary: Mind the gap. Mind the felon. Mind the charm that hides the web.
L-161.lyrics_extract: Says one thing, does another, oh, that double spin, / A loop-de-loop of truth, to keep you caged within.
L-161.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Mind the felon, yeah, the charm so sly,
Crafts a world of webs, while you wonder why.
Says one thing, does another, oh, that double spin,
A loop-de-loop of truth, to keep you caged within.

[Chorus]
Paradoxalize, hypnotize, flip it on its head,
Reality’s a ripple, messing with your cred.
Keepin’ you guessin’, tangled up in dread
Watch out, watch out, that’s a mind-meld fed.

[Verse 2]
Swaps the stories, rewrites the past,
Tells you your version of truth won’t last.
Gaslightin’ bright like neon glow,
Makes you doubt the things you know.

[Bridge]
Oh, here we go, emotions exploited,
Fear ignited, confidence voided.
Got you swayin’, hangin’ on tight,
Twirled in circles, no end in sight.

[Chorus]
Paradoxalize, hypnotize, twistin’ it just so,
Warpin’ up the blame like a magic show.
Sayin’ it’s your fault while dodgin’ their own
Oh, watch out, watch out, they claim that throne.

[Verse 3]
Kind and cruel, a cycle insane,
Keeps you locked in love, then writhin’ in pain.
Tender words? Or threats in disguise,
Keepin’ you hooked on the look in their eyes.

[Outro]
Mind the felon, yeah, tread real light,
Catch the flicker, catch the fight.
When sense slips, and vision blurs,
Mind the felon… beware those words.

L-162.lyrics_summary: Anthony Bourdain knew: the meal is never just a meal.
L-162.lyrics_extract: With knives and wit, he shaped a view, / Of what’s raw, what’s real, and what’s true.
L-162.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
It's not just a meal, man, it’s a path to explore,
He’d pull up a chair, make a stranger's tale his own for sure,
A rebel with a fork, nah, he’s deeper than that,
He’d crack open hearts where most just see the fat.

[Chorus]
From that kitchen heat to foreign streets,
He found the soul where the world would meet,
With knives and wit, he shaped a view,
Of what’s raw, what’s real, and what’s true.

[Verse 2]
He'd laugh at the fame, oh, he'd see through the game,
Never chasing riches, just those faces and names,
Of the ones who gave more than food on a plate,
In each bite, he'd show us our fate.

[Bridge]
Lonely, yet bold, with a heart that sought more,
He'd walk through the dark, but opened new doors,
To flavors, to people, to truths we might miss,
Here's to the man who danced in the abyss.

[Chorus] (repeat)
From that kitchen heat to foreign streets,
He found the soul where the world would meet,
With knives and wit, he shaped a view,
Of what’s raw, what’s real, and what’s true.

[Outro]
Yeah, he carved out what’s real, what’s raw, what’s true,
More than a plate, he gave us a clearer view...
[Soft fade out, with a reflective groove]

L-164.lyrics_title: New Normalcy (Planet Earth to Higher Grounds)
L-164.lyrics_summary: Planet Earth to Higher Grounds. What have we done now? Beautiful things don’t ask for attention...
L-164.lyrics_extract: Planet Earth, callin’ out, / driftin’ on, unknown route.
L-164.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Intro]
Planet Earth, callin’ out,
driftin’ on, unknown route.
Tides of lies, drowned by a snake,
May kind wishes glow us up awake

[Verse 1]
Beautiful things don’t beg to be seen,
Yet they flaunt ‘em, always on screen.
What have they done now? Oh, man,
Golden mirrors, high on quick sand.

[Chorus]
Higher grounds, do you hear my plea?
Through white-dick-static gulfs and seas.
Why so much blow, KNOWsutra untold?
Will dark bleak flaws forever unfold?

[Verse 2]
Sky feels heavy, ground feels thin,
Spinning tales where gods have dimmed.
Swayin’ whispers murmur, say,
“Don’t blink, grace is found in decay.”

[Chorus]
Higher grounds, do you hear my plea?
Through white-dick-static gulfs and seas.
Why so much blow, KNOWsutra untold?
Will dark bleak flaws forever unfold?

[Bridge]
Hold tight to beauty left unseen,
To fleeting sparks in in-betweens.
Those who sit in shadowed gloom,
Know where the wildest flowers bloom.

[Outro]
Planet Earth, still callin’ out,
Silence rings, the void’s devout.
Can you hear me? Can you see?
Please reDefine normalcy?
[end]

--
V2

Planet Earth to Higher Grounds,
We’ve been drifting, lost and unbound.
Check ignition, systems worn and torn,
Tell us, where do we go from here?

This is Planet Earth to Higher Grounds,
What have we done now? Oh no.
We made the world so loud, it drowns the truth,
Yet beautiful things don’t ask for attention—proof.

Can you hear us, Higher Grounds?
Or are we just fading sounds?
Falling stars and broken satellites,
Guide us through these long, cold nights.

Voices whisper in a vacuum sky,
Dreams suspended, futures running dry.
If you’re listening, Higher Grounds, we plead,
Give us roots to hold, and air to breathe.

This is Planet Earth, we’re barely here,
Spinning circles in a sea of fear.
But beauty grows in silence and in shade,
It’s the quiet wonders that will never fade.

Can you feel us, Higher Grounds?
Fingers stretching, arms unbound.
We are fragments, ashes, seeds of light,
Holding on through endless night.

Planet Earth to Higher Grounds,
Beautiful things don’t ask for sound.
What have we done? Oh no, oh no,
We planted echoes, but will they grow?

—
V3:

[Verse 1]
Planet Earth to higher grounds,
Do you read me through the sound?
The sky is heavy, shadows on the land.
Check the signal, take my hand.

[Chorus]
What have we done now, oh no?
Lines we crossed, we’ll never know.
Beautiful things don’t ask for attention,
Fading slow in this dimension.

[Verse 2]
Gravity feels lighter now,
Hold your breath; the air is loud.
Fingers trace the edge of time,
Lost in echoes, chasing signs.

[Chorus]
What have we done now, oh no?
Winds of change, where do they blow?
Beautiful things don’t ask for attention,
Yet they’re the center of our reflection.

[Bridge (Psychedelic Drift)]
The vinyl spins, the needle shakes,
A distant hum is all it takes.
Colors swirl like melting skies,
Through the haze, we see the lies.

[Verse 3]
Planet Earth to higher grounds,
We’re still tethered, though unbound.
Beyond the static, past the storm,
Will we find the new norm?

[Final Chorus (Haunting)]
What have we done now, oh no?
Echoes linger, soft and slow.
Beautiful things don’t ask for attention,
But they’ll survive without redemption.

[Outro (Fading Hypnotically)]
Planet Earth to higher grounds…
The silence hums, the stars resound.
What have we done now, oh no?
What have we done now… oh no…

--
V4:
[intro]  
Planet Earth to higher grounds,  
Do you feel the shift around?  
The quiet hum, a deafening sound,  
It pulls us in, we can’t come down.  

[verse 1]  
Planet Earth to higher grounds,  
What have we done now, oh no?  
Our hands have drawn the sacred lines,  
Yet beauty whispers, never shows.  

[chorus]  
Beautiful things don’t ask for attention,  
They bloom in the shadows, unseen dimensions.  
We search the stars for what we’ve lost,  
But never count the fleeting cost.  

[verse 2]  
Gravity fades, and time unspools,  
A fragile thread, a cosmic rule.  
The echo lingers, the questions stay,  
Do we evolve, or waste away?  

[chorus]  
Beautiful things don’t ask for attention,  
They bloom in the shadows, unseen dimensions.  
We search the stars for what we’ve lost,  
But never count the fleeting cost.  

[bridge]  
Do you hear me, higher grounds?  
Is there purpose, is there sound?  
The signal fades, the truth is bare,  
What’s left behind, and who will care?  

[chorus]  
Beautiful things don’t ask for attention,  
They bloom in the shadows, unseen dimensions.  
We search the stars for what we’ve lost,  
But never count the fleeting cost.  

[outro]  
Planet Earth to higher grounds,  
The silence speaks, it all unwinds.  
What have we done now, oh no?  
Beautiful things… never show.  
[fades into static crackle]

L-165.lyrics_summary: They muddy the water to make it look deep. Nietzsche saw through it.
L-165.lyrics_extract: They muddy the water, to make it seem deep / With words so hollow, the truth they keep.
L-165.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
They muddy the water, to make it seem deep
With words so hollow, the truth they keep
But I see through the veil, the shallow disguise
Nietzsche's wisdom, cutting through the lies

[Chorus subdued, hypnotic, psychedelic]
Oh, the pretense and the show
Where integrity fails to grow
With Nietzsche's gift, I stand tall
Against the false, against it all

[Verse 2 subdued, hypnotic, intimate]
Culture, religion, morality they bend
In the name of power, they pretend
Superficiality, the mask they wear
But the truth in Nietzsche's words, so rare

[Chorus subdued, hypnotic, psychedelic]
Oh, the pretense and the show
Where integrity fails to grow
With Nietzsche's gift, I stand tall
Against the false, against it all

[Bridge hypnotic, deep, acoustic clapping]
Respect and gratitude, for his insight so clear
For cutting through the fog, for showing no fear
In a world so fake, his words remain true
A guiding light, for me and for you

[Chorus subdued, hypnotic, syncopated rhythm, psychedelic]
Oh, the pretense and the show
Where integrity fails to grow
With Nietzsche's gift, I stand tall
Against the false, against it all

[Outro hypnotic, acoustic violin loops, syncopated rhythm, raw psychedelic vibe]

[End]

L-166.lyrics_summary: Freedom means no fear. Nina Simone said it. We're still working on it.
L-166.lyrics_extract: Let artists shine where lies appear, / Hold a mirror against the fear.
L-166.lyrics_text:
[INTRO]
I’ll tell you what freedom means to me…
No fear, my dear, freedom means no fear.
And if my voice should tremble,
Let it ring loud and clear.

[VERSE 1 : “I Had a Dream”]
I had a dream we woke as one,
No hearts undone, no souls outrun.
A world where truths walked side by side,
And no one had to run or hide.

[VERSE 2 : Strong-Women]
My mother said, “Stand tall, my girl,
Don’t bend your fire to fit their world.”
She taught me souls can crack and break,
But dignity’s our own to make.

[HOOK]
No fear, my dear, the light inside us glows.
No fear, my dear, true spirit always knows.
No fear, my dear, freedom grows from our spark.
No fear, my dear, bow out their goddamn dark.

[VERSE 3 : Sound-as-Salvation]
Some pray in halls of dust and stone,
Some kneel where tired saints have gone.
But I find truth in rhythm’s rise,
Where basslines pull the dark to light.

[VERSE 4 : Mirror of the Times]
We watch the days grow mean and cold,
Let’s join our hands, and break that mold.
Let artists shine where lies appear,
Hold a mirror against the fear.

[BRIDGE]
If sorrow’s got you by the throat,
I’ve walked that road, I know that note.
Storm winds can strip us to the bone,
And still we rise, don’t feel alone.

They’ll call the truth a threat, a scar,
They’ll twist the past to dim a star.
But breathe, my love, hold your own mark.
Let freedom burn their toxic snark.

[HOOK]
No fear, my dear, the light inside us glows.
No fear, my dear, true spirit always knows.
No fear, my dear, freedom grows from our spark.
No fear, my dear, bow out their goddamn dark.

[OUTRO]
If your voice should tremble,
Let it tremble to the light.
No fear, my dear,
Let’s sing it through the night…

L-168.lyrics_summary: No, I'm not being political. I'm just awake. (Circa 2025.)
L-168.lyrics_extract: When the gaslight turns perpetual / Choosing silence’s unethical.
L-168.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
You may think I’m emotional,
But I’m just saying what’s real.
This ain’t business as usual,
It’s history turned maniacal!

[Verse 1]
It’s not creeping, it’s exploding!
A convicted rapist’s gloating,
As if felony brings glory,
And silence ain’t a story…

Seventeen million deaths projected,
While folks just scroll and shop.
Taxes funding hell camps,
While no one dares say: STOP.

[Chorus]
No, I’m not being political,
I’m just a conscious caring gal.
No one needs to be spiritual
To know this shit’s immoral.

They call it woke, they ain’t that bright,
But this is basic human rights.
If that offends your appetites,
Well, you are part of what bites…

[Verse 2]
You shrug at abortion laws,
Like “pro-life” addresses female flaws,
Like incest and rape are no problemo,
Like fascists ain’t monsters but Zorros.

Don buried Epstein’s pedo lore,
While caging kids by the score,
And ICE raids echo SS now…
How low can we go before we bow?

[Bridge]
I’m not especially radical,
Hell, I’m barely social.
Just partial to the moral,
And allergic to the brutal.

Evil ain’t just conceptual.
It’s become legal, habitual.
I don’t march like it’s a ritual,
I just care when power’s lethal!

I’m not wise nor exceptional,
Just sensitive, observational.
When the gaslight turns perpetual

L-169.lyrics_summary: No, I'm not being political. I'm just still awake. (Circa 2026.)
L-169.lyrics_extract: No one needs to be spiritual / To know this isn’t right at all.
L-169.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
You may think I’m emotional,
But I’m just awake, and real.
This ain’t business as usual,
It’s history gone surreal.

[Verse 1]
This ain’t sliding, this is exploding,
White men wanking, power brokering,
Acting like cruelty brings them glory,
Like democracy’s just a dumb story.

They renamed defense to war, oh yeah,
No Congress vote, just bomb the way,
Two funded wars we never chose,
While they demand we never oppose.

[Verse 2]
The “Beautiful Bill” is finally here,
Millions lose health, live in fear,
While “SAVE” acts strip the right to vote,
Women are silenced at the throat.

Say “Antifa,” now it’s a crime,
Free speech buried on our dime,
If you think this is debate or fate,
You’re sleeping at the gallows gate.

[Chorus]
No, I’m not being political,
Just a conscious, caring gal.
No one needs to be spiritual
To know this isn’t right at all.

Fascism ain’t some abstract inanity,
It’s violence dressed up as banality,
Human rights aren’t culture war decor,
Wake up, people, this is so much more.

[Verse 3]
You shrug as doctors haul away
Bleeding mothers, grief judged foul play,
They call it “murder” when bellies fail,
Then lock up women inside a jail.

You say “I don’t do politics” with a grin,
Like indifference isn’t a sin,
But tolerance of evil helps it thrive,
Just ask the ghosts who stayed alive…

[Bridge]
I’m not especially radical,
Hell, I’m barely social,
I’m just partial to what’s ethical, 
I’m just aware of what’s brutal. 

Evil isn’t just conceptual,
It’s become normal, habitual,
I don’t march like it’s ritual,
I just care when power’s lethal.

[Chorus]
No, I’m not being political,
Just a conscious, caring gal.
No one needs to be spiritual
To know this isn’t right at all.

Are you under some kind of spell?
But(t) how can you not cry or yell?
I’d rather feel it, heed the sting,
Than hide behind not noticing.

[Outro]
I don’t sing to play a role,
I just can’t ignore the toll,
Silence isn’t self-control,
It’s surrender of the soul.

“I’m not political” you say,
Like that keeps the dark away,
But let’s not forget “never again”…
Or it won’t get better in the end.
