L-171.lyrics_summary: He said 'I know I know nothing.' They sentenced him to death. Oh my, oh why — is truth still the crime they crucify?
L-171.lyrics_extract: So here I sing, beneath the stars, / A song for truth, for sacred scars.
L-171.lyrics_text:
He walked the square with bare, bold feet,
Asked kings and fools what made life sweet,
He said, “I know I know nothing... ain’t that true?”
The priests grew pale, the jury stiff,
He smiled and offered them a gift:
“I’d rather die than lie like you do.”

[Chorus]
Oh my, oh why,
Is truth the crime they crucify?
They feared the light,
So they closed their eyes…
Oh my… oh why.

He questioned pride, exposed the game,
Showed power cloaked in noble names,
Asked “Who decides what’s wise and what’s taboo?”
They called him mad, they called him curse,
But feared his calm, his clever verse,
A mirror’s worse than any sword can do.

[Chorus]
Oh my, oh why,
Do cowards choose to dignify
The mask, the lie,
Then claim it’s divine?
Oh my… oh why.

[Bridge]
He didn’t run.
He didn’t beg.
He sipped the cup.
He stretched his leg.
“The soul lives on,” he gently said,
“and cowards die in beds.”

So here I sing, beneath the stars,
A song for truth, for sacred scars,
For every soul who’d rather burn than bow.
We carry him in every breath,
Each time we choose the honest death,
Each time we dare to live out loud.

[Final Chorus]
Oh my, oh why,
They silenced him, but not his cry…
It echoes still
Where questions lie,
Oh my…
Oh why?

L-179.lyrics_summary: Our best: impeccable word, integrity, love heard.
L-179.lyrics_extract: Be impeccable with your word, / Speak with integrity, let love be heard.
L-179.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Verse 1]
Be impeccable with your word,
Speak with integrity, let love be heard.
Say what you mean, no need to hide,
Truth and love will be your guide.

[Chorus]
Our best, our best,
We rise above the rest.
Through truth, we find our quest,
Our best, our best.

[Verse 2]
Don’t take it personally, let it go,
What they say’s their dream, not what you know.
Immune to the storms of what they project,
You’ll find your peace when you reflect.

[Chorus]
Our best, our best,
We rise above the rest.
Through truth, we find our quest,
Our best, our best.

[Bridge]
No assumptions, take the time,
Ask your questions, let clarity shine.
Speak what you want, and you’ll transform,
Love grows stronger through every storm.

[Verse 3]
Do your best, it changes each day,
Healthy or weary, give what you may.
Free from regret, free from abuse,
Living your best, there’s no excuse.

[Final Chorus]
Our best, our best,
We rise above the rest.
Through truth, we find our quest,
Our best, our best.

[Outro]
With love and courage, we’ll stand tall,
Our best will echo, touching all.

—
V2:

[Verse 1]
Oh, we were born to rise above the storm,
Speak with integrity, that’s how we stay warm.
Say what you mean, and keep the love true,
Don’t turn your words ’round to cut into you.

[Chorus]
Our best, it’s all we give, our best, it’s how we live.
Under the sun, the stars, and rain,
Doing our best will ease the pain.

[Verse 2]
Don’t take it personal, their words aren’t yours,
It’s their own dream, their unsettled wars.
Immune to opinions, no needless grief,
Find freedom there, in your own belief.

[Chorus]
Our best, it’s how we thrive, our best, it keeps us alive.
Through the shadows, through the day,
Doing our best will light the way.

[Bridge]
Don’t make assumptions, be brave, ask it all,
Clear communication won’t let you fall.
One small agreement can change your life,
Away from the chaos, away from the strife.

[Chorus]
Our best, it’s how we soar, our best, forever more.
Moment to moment, come what may,
Doing our best will guide the way.

[Outro]
When you’re sick or you’re feeling strong,
Doing your best will keep you along.
Self-judgment fades, regret subsides,
When you give your best, love abides.

—
V3

Oh, we’re learning every day,
To speak with truth, to walk the way.
Words with power, words with grace,
We aim for love, not a bitter trace.

Be impeccable with what you say,
Integrity will lead the way.
No gossip, no lies, just the truth from above,
Use your words for trust and love.

[Chorus]
Our best, our best, it changes in time,
But it frees us from the weight inside.
Under the sun, in any test,
We only strive to do our best.

When their words cut, don’t let them stay,
Their world’s not yours; just walk away.
Their actions reflect their own dream,
Not what you are, not what you’ve seen.

Build immunity to all their fire,
You’ll rise above their cruel desires.
Don’t take it to heart, don’t let it consume,
Suffering fades when love makes room.

(Chorus)
Our best, our best, it changes in time,
But it frees us from the weight inside.
Under the sun, in any test,
We only strive to do our best.

Ask your questions, let them be clear,
Don’t assume, cast out the fear.
Speak your heart and say your truth,
Drama falls when love breaks through.


Misunderstandings will all subside,
When honesty becomes our guide.
Transform your life, in every space,
With courage, kindness, and embrace.


(Chorus)
Our best, our best, it changes in time,
But it frees us from the weight inside.
Under the sun, in any test,
We only strive to do our best.


In sickness, in health, we do what we can,
Perfection’s not the measure of man.
Just do your best and let regrets go,
In every moment, let your love show.


(Outro)
Oh, we’re learning every day,
To speak with truth, to walk the way.
Words with power, words with grace,
We aim for love, not a bitter trace.


Our best.

No more walls, no ties to bind,

Her canvas alive with vibrant hues,  
Reality fades as her spirit pursues.

[Chorus]
Out of step, out of sight,  
She leaves the ordinary behind tonight.  
Turns her life into a song,  
In the dance of the heart, she’s never wrong.

In the swirling notes of her melody.

She dances through a world of light.

[Chorus]
Out of step, out of sight,  
She leaves the ordinary behind tonight.  
Turns her life into a song,  
In the dance of the heart, she’s never wrong.

[Outro]

L-324.lyrics_summary: Dopamine chases. Serotonin exhales. Oxytocin stays. Neurotransmitters matter. A love song on the science of connection, i.e. trust.
L-324.lyrics_extract: No fleeting highs, no fight, no plight, / Just stay, just feel, how love feels right.
L-324.lyrics_text:
[Intro : le why]
Dopamine, serotonin, oxy-to-cin… huh?
Who you chase? Why not chill? Let me tell you how, hun.
Feel the flow and rhythm of science,
And dance the neurotransmitters dance.

[Verse 1 : dopamine aka the chase]
Dopamine sings, “do more, lean in,”
Heat in the hips, that greedy grin.
Blessed be fire, thrill and bite,
Burn too fast, you’ll lose the light.

Highs hit hard, the pulse, the crave,
Push and pull like a tidal wave.
Chase it all, the rush, the spin,
But alone, the thrill is no win-win.

[Bridge : dopamine -> serotonin]
The thrill is sweet, but never lasts,
Let’s slow it down, let the highs pass…

[Verse 2 : serotonin aka the chill]
Serotonin sighs, “all done, breathe,”
Dropped shoulders, feeling at ease…
Pure joy in flight, light in my chest,
Alone it fades, it’s not the best.

Peace drifts in like a gentle tide,
Soft and steady, nothing to hide…
But calm alone can’t seal the deal,
Need a touch to make it real.

[Bridge : serotonin -> oxytocin]
But alone, the calm is just a part,
Here’s how trust ignites the heart…

[Chorus : oxytocin aka the FLOW]
Oxytocin says, stay right here,
Tender touch, keep us near.
No hit-and-quit, trust comes first,
Feel the flow, forget the thirst.

Oxytocin says, hold me tight,
Gentle heat in the softest light.
No fleeting highs, no fight, no plight,
Just stay, just feel, how love feels right.

[Verse 3 : the peace and flow equation]
Chase me a little, then let’s dwell,
Want plus care, that’s the magick spell.
Share your truth, forget the fake,
Dare to give, and not just take.

Blend the spark with steady flame,
Honest hearts KNOW trust’s true game.
No push, no pull, just synced in time,
The flow and glow, the perfect rhyme.

[Chorus : oxytocin aka the FLOW]
Oxytocin says, stay right here,
Tender touch, keep us near.
No hit-and-quit, trust comes first,
Feel the FLOW, forget the thirst.

Oxytocin says, hold me tight,
Gentle heat in the softest light.
No fleeting highs, no fight, no plight,
Just stay, just feel, how love feels right.

[Outro : patience & gratitude aka the GROW, FLOW, & GLOW]
Do more… all done… hold me tight,
Let the kink sink in, science in sight.
Blink, blush, breathe, feel the shift,
FLOWsutra magick, the sweetest gift.

Stay right here, let it GROW, expand,
FLOWS entwined, take my hand…
Neurochemistry in every kiss,
Oxytocin, the ultimate bliss.

L-182.lyrics_summary: The only wish worth making: peace. Just peace. Please?

Peace that grows from trust

[Chorus]
Peace that grows from trust
Not power, fear, or hush
No mask, no game, no war disguised as law
Just peace that grows from trust
And honest is always a must
In my book of joy, that’s what matters more

[Bridge]
It takes courage to ask
Humility to hear
To reach through the awkward
Instead of disappear

Peace that grows from trust
No echo chamber hush
No gaslit grin pretending not to see
Just peace that grows from trust
Where curiosity’s enough
To build a better “we”,
That’s what matters more to me.

Bamboozled, breathless?

Where truth gets gagged,
and justice sleeps,
While predators smile
with secrets they keep.

This is a song for the silenced girls
Trauma wrapped in ribbons and pearls.
Private jets to secret places,
Rich old men with masked faces.

Classified flights,
Blackmail nights,
Rooms of doom
and paid-off rights.

Pedo nation!

Hiding behind their power and fame.
Fraudsters, rapists, billionaires
Teflon-slick and justice-impaired.

Felons rigging rules they wrote,
Trafficking kids like trading notes.
Consent erased, replaced with lies
Pussy-grabbing crowned as wise.

They groom, they gaslight,
Then grin on TV.
America,
land of the free...

Pedo nation!

When daddy’s horny,
he plays the king
A tantrum, a mistress,
another hush ring.
A girl goes missing,
a story gets blurred,
Another name redacted,
another truth unheard.
This ain't a metaphor.
It’s blackmail and bribes.
It’s teenage bodies
on Lolita flights.
It’s dungeons of silence,
and dollars for pain.
A nation that worships
the predators’ name.

[Final Chorus]
Pedo nation!
Built on secrets, greed, and shame.
Pedo nation!
Where justice dies to protect their name.

No shame, no blame
just hush and fame.
Classified sins
in a gilded frame.

L-189.lyrics_summary: Question my empathy. I dare you. (Poetry has entered the chat.)
L-189.lyrics_text:
Please, question my empathy if you dare,
When I proclaim that poetry’s beyond compare.
It’s the messenger of creativity, unique and pure,
An essential salve for wounds we’re forced to endure.
(I believe)
It’s the voice of humanity, irreplaceably true,
A bridge to understanding, both old and new.
In a world where trends turn feelings to commodities,
Poetry fosters humility and deep camaraderie.
(I believe)
Poetry matters—like planting life’s seeds.
Now, more than ever, it’s the trend we need.
In an age of standardized, hollow narcissism,
It dares to defy global capitalism’s schism.
With respect to pyramids, churches, sacred creeds,
And Maslow’s famed hierarchy of needs,
Let’s not forget: in instability and vulnerability,
Poetry thrives as the witness to fragility.
(I believe)
It counters dehumanization’s grinding force,
Encouraging empathy, alterity, and discourse.
It listens for voices, both quiet and loud,
Unearthing the power within the crowd.
(I believe)
It stands against manipulation and divides,
A flame in the darkness, where connection resides.
It resists the oblivion of apathy’s grip,
And shares truths that teach hearts how to flip.
It breaks the chains of vengeance and despair,
Building bridges where there was only air.
It finds magic in life’s mundane explorations,
Awe in moments, and quiet celebrations.
You’ll know it when it hits you—it flows,
A voice so raw, every line glows.
It sings of meaning, of hearts drawn near,
It echoes in wonder, sharp and clear.
(I believe)
It captures the texture of lives we share,
It paints differences with strokes of care.
Across valleys and cultures, it dares to leap,
Inviting us to dream, reflect, and weep.
With words so humble, yet almost divine,
It lifts us from ordinary to the holy line.
Filling silences with a voice that’s warm,
Poetry, like love, becomes the norm.
(I believe)
That’s why poetry is a must,
A language of hope, of shared trust.
It’s our dignity, our individuality laid bare,
A chance to celebrate the beauty we share.
(I believe)
It’s the answer to artificial evolution,
A means to spark a cultural revolution.
So take the leap, it’s free to try,
And perhaps together, we’ll learn to fly.

L-193.lyrics_summary: Are you playing possum while fascists march by? Is that wisdom, or poop in a pile? The beast doesn't respect the lord.
L-193.lyrics_extract: Is neutrality a moral game, / Or camouflage to hide the shame?
L-193.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Oh… but(t) are you a possum,
playing dead ’til the monster’s gone?
Holding real still, heart shut tight,
hoping history just… moves on?

[Verse 1 – quirky curiousity]
Is that what’s smart, or just a style?
Is that wisdom, or poop in a pile?
If you freeze when fascists march by,
is that clever, or soul gone bye?

If the house is on ICE next door,
do you snore in the basement’s floor?
If bullies are screwing en masse,
do you play corpse to save your ass?

[Pre-Chorus - candid curiosity]
Do you hope the beast will get bored?
Do you think it respects the lord?
When it growls and denies what’s right,
What then? Ain’t that worth a fair fight?

[Chorus]
Oh, but(t) are you a possum,
playing dead ’til the monster’s done?
Are you immune to guts gone wrong,
Or maybe an ostrich sees no con?

Oh, but(t) are you a possum,
tail curled tight down your scrotum?
When monsters are hiding their faces,
Why you think it’s stinking like asses?

[Verse 2 – psychedelic sway]
Is neutrality a moral game,
Or camouflage to hide the shame?
If you say “both sides bite the same,”
why’s one building cages in our name?

Is your comfort your sacred creed,
Or is it connivance indeed?
If justice knocks but you’re “not home,”
Do human rights just go on roam?

[Bridge - raw empathy]
If everyone at once plays dead,
What happens to the glooming dread?
When courage waits for perfect weather,
Can freedom bring us all together?

If the possum learns to preach “patience,”
But(t) then the dark knights deny the dawn,
is that wise, or collaboration lite?
Will you swear you survived by being right?

[Chorus – louder, grittier]
Oh, but(t) are you a possum,
playing dead ’til the monster’s gone?
Blink twice if you like that song,
Wink once if you know it’s wrong.

Oh, but(t) are you a possum,
Is silence your optimum?
Or do you forget how to be brave,
While kids are thrown in communal graves?

[Outro – caring sarcasm]
When ‘em monsters spit lies and all,

L-200.lyrics_summary: Question the nation. Truth is on sabbatical. Or what(TF)?
L-200.lyrics_extract: Question the nation of pundits prophets, / Algorithm bias in branded lockets.
L-200.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Question the nation…
Hallucinate salvation…
Where truth took a vacation…
Bananasutra vibration…

[Verse 1]
Who sold your soul at the discount mall?
Who scrolls your dreams through the data sprawl?
Who doctored your doubt with dopamine drip?
Who coded your faith with a censorship script?

Who profits from panic, post after post?
Who sells your fear for the likes they host?
Who filters your pain till it looks aesthetic?
Who turns your silence into something prophetic?

[Chorus]
Question the nation, hear the narration,
Dystopian salvation, mad fornication.
Bananasutra, peel seducer,
Fruit opener, pulse creator.

[Verse 2]
Who digs ’em dicks of breaking bad news?
Who hid the despair in patriotic hues?
Who cheered the bully, called it divine?
Who whispered “freedom” while drawing the line?

Who buried the poets in bureaucrat dust?
Who trademarked love and privatized trust?
Who voted progress, forgot the soul?
Who took the toll just to play a role?

[Chorus]
Question the nation, denounce corruption,
Peace detonation, fair migration.
Bananasutra, mantra mover,
Dubbed-up Buddha, groove improver.

[Bridge]
Who sleeps sound when the sirens cry?
Who trolls like Felicia’s not nah-bye?
Who scrolls past truth like an ad too long?
Who hums along contempt empire’s song?

Who fears the mirror when the mask comes off?
Who chokes on truth but still loves the cough?
Who trades their soul for a trending thread?
Who blesses the sly just to get ahead?

[Verse 3]
Question the nation that bans reflection,
That censors affection, that edits connection.
Question the nation of pundits prophets,
Algorithm bias in branded lockets.

Question the calm that feels like pain,
The glittering screens that numb the brain.
Question the cage that calls itself free,
Question the nation. Question me.

[Outro]
Bananasutra…
breath of the data-dead,
voice in the static thread…
Sing them awake,
make them shake,
make them question instead.

Question the nation…

L-201.lyrics_summary: She sang her story. Ukulele. Colors. But(t) then she barked. No notes.
L-201.lyrics_extract: Oh, she sang of the humble, sang of the wise, / Shot down the messenger, truth in disguise...
L-201.lyrics_text:
Intro]
[Ukulele strums with a whimsical tune]

[Verse]
In a world of colors bright and bold,
A woman sang, her story told,
With a bitter heart and a voice so raw,
She saw through the lies, she saw the flaw.

[Verse 2]
I sang along, a fan so true,
With a marquee bright, her name in view,
I promoted her music, with joy and pride,
But she shot me down, no place to hide.

[Chorus]
Oh, she sang of the humble, sang of the wise,
Shot down the messenger, truth in disguise,
Her melody twisted, her rhythm free,
In her cabaret of fantasy.

[Interlude]
[Ukulele solo with whimsical flourishes]

[Verse 3]
She claimed I hurt her, so deeply pained,
Radical and harsh, her words like rain,
But all I did was sing her song,
In her mind, it all went wrong.

[Chorus]
Oh, she sang of the humble, sang of the wise,
Shot down the messenger, truth in disguise,
Her melody twisted, her rhythm free,
In her cabaret of fantasy.

[Bridge]
Now she wants me back, from the dead I rise,
For explanation, but it’s no surprise,
Vindictive words, so contrived and cold,
Her bitter story, in her voice retold.

[Chorus]
Oh, she sang of the humble, sang of the wise,
Shot down the messenger, truth in disguise,
Her melody twisted, her rhythm free,
In her cabaret of fantasy.

[Outro]
[Ukulele strums softly fading out]
In the silence left by her last note,
Lingers the message, the words she wrote.

L-321.lyrics_summary: So much radio static. Sigh. Welcome to Bananasutra Radio, philosophy à gogo about how to flow over egos that blow... and the joy of sharing what we know.
L-321.lyrics_extract: The rich feel poor in peace of mind, / The poor feel rich in borrowed time.
L-321.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Shhh… tune in.
Frequency of the free and the flawed.
Where logic sings lunacy,
And truth gets the last laugh.

[Verse 1]
In our dystopian cabaret,
The clowns wear crowns, the saints get down.
Sinners confess, big hearts decay…
It’s real surrealité.

The rich feel poor in peace of mind,
The poor feel rich in borrowed time,
We trade our trust for stolen lines,
And laugh it’s all gonna be fine,

[Pre-Chorus]
Attention spans in flames,
Empathy’s the rarest game,
So we joke, we woke, name names,
Then feel a little less humane.

[Chorus]
So much radio static!
Extroverts gone manic,
Meek heroes turned tragic,
The Sad, the Mad, the Bad!
It all rhymes, aren’t you just glad?

Bananasutra Radio!
Philosophy à Gogo,
Not for profit, not for show,
Just the joy of knowing what we know.

[Bridge]
Between the buzz and the bling,
You might hear something true sing.
Frequency clear through the noise,
Like conscience finding its voice.

The tired, wired, half-awake,
Still dream, still dance, still make...
Through static, chaos, clickbait rain,
Let’s hum our way back to sane.

[Final Chorus]
So much radio static!
Extroverts gone manic!
The meek and the magic,
Still laughing through the tragic!

Bananasutra Radio
Where wonder breaks the algorithm’s hold,
And every soul, young or old,
Tells truth like it’s made of gold.

[Outro]
Signal fading,
Spirit staying.
Tune in again…
Blessed be mayhem ;)

L-203.lyrics_title: Read Me Harder (BB is for Banned Books)
L-203.lyrics_summary: They banned the books but not the beat. BB is for Banned Books — and Badass Brains. Read harder.
L-203.lyrics_extract:
B.B. is for Banned Books,
and Badass Brains
L-203.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
They banned the truth for being rude…
But baby, rude is how we bloom.
So light me up, librarian lover…
and read me harder.
B.B. is for Banned Books,
and Badass Brains.

[Verse 1 – Harper Lee & Art Spiegelman]
Harper told me, “Mock me, kill me,” still I sing,
Truth’s a mockingbird with wings.
Art drew the pain, a mouse in flame,
He said, “Remember, never tame.”
You can ban my ink, but not my roar,
I’ll scratch your walls, and write some more.

[Chorus]
They banned the books but not the beat,
Banned the thought but not the heat,
Banned the love but not the street.
So read me, baby, read me sweet!
If thinking’s sin, I’ll take the blame,
Desire and truth are one and same.

[Verse 2 – Aldous Huxley & Margaret Atwood]
Aldous whispered, “Take your soma, stay asleep,”
But sugar, freedom don’t come cheap.
Atwood smirked, “Blessed be the fruit,”
Then laced her boots and staged a coup.
Pop your soma, hush your fear,
But holy lust still lights us clear.

[Bridge – George Orwell & Ray Bradbury]
Big Brother’s watching, Ray lit the spark,
Said, “Burn the dark, not those who mark.”
Orwell winked through smoke and steam,
“Truth’s a thoughtcrime, love’s the dream.”
You can’t delete what won’t forget,
We’re the match they can’t reset.

[Final Chorus]
They banned the books but not the beat,
Banned the thought but not the heat,
Banned the love but not the street.
So read me, baby, read me sweet!
Truth’s taboo, but damn, it’s neat,
Come turn the page with me.

[Outro]
For Harper Lee, Art Spiegelman, Aldous Huxley, Margaret Atwood,
George Orwell, and Ray Bradbury,
for every mind they tried to muzzle.
We see you.
We feel you.
And we’ll keep reading you harder.

L-204.lyrics_summary: Real winners dance in the rain.
L-204.lyrics_extract: Real winners, they dance in the rain, / No need for pride, no need for fame.
L-204.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
They say the strong win it all,
But I’ve seen them stumble, seen them fall,
Twisting words to fit their frame,
Funny how they play that game.

[Verse 1]
Oh, they climb up so high,
But what’s a peak when built on lies?
Tell me, darling, don’t you see?
A real winner’s setting us all free.

[Chorus]
Real winners, they dance in the rain,
No need for pride, no need for fame,
They lift us up, they don’t play small,
Collaboration wins it all.

[Verse 2]
A leader with compassion’s rare,
But you’ll find them here, they care,
They know it’s not about the race,
It’s helping others find their place.

[Chorus]
Real winners, they dance in the rain,
No need for pride, no need for fame,
They lift us up, they don’t play small,
Collaboration wins it all.

[Outro]
So let them claim their lonely thrones,
But we’ll build something all our own

L-205.lyrics_summary: They built heaven on fear. Reason is a better foundation.
L-205.lyrics_extract: Raise your mind to the stars, not your prayers, / Build your hope on reason’s stairs.
L-205.lyrics_text:
They built the heavens with fear in the sky,
Promised salvation but told us to die.
The weight of the world, they placed on their knees,
But truth grows in questions, not in decrees.

[Chorus]
Raise your mind to the stars, not your prayers,
Build your hope on reason’s stairs.
No need for gods to find what’s true,
The light of love is born in you.

They called it wisdom to silence dissent,
Made a virtue of guilt and a sin of content.
But knowledge is freedom, unchained by creed,
No dogma required to learn how to lead.

[Chorus]
Raise your mind to the stars, not your prayers,
Build your hope on reason’s stairs.
No need for gods to find what’s true,
The light of love is born in you.

No eternal fire, no thrones on high,
Just the vast unknown where truths collide.
We walk the earth with curious eyes,
Finding meaning where wonder lies.

[Chorus]
Raise your mind to the stars, not your prayers,
Build your hope on reason’s stairs.
No need for gods to find what’s true,
The light of love is born in you.

So let’s build a world where all can explore,
Free from the chains of the dogma of yore.
For in the search, not the faith, we’ll find,
The beauty of life and the power of mind.

L-379.lyrics_summary: Because some rebellions sound better in the language of liberté, égalité, and furious irony. En français.
L-379.lyrics_extract:
Séduction par manipulation,  
Dans cette élection, c'est l'illusion.
L-379.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
(Spoken: "Yo, écoute ça. Révolution.")

[Verse]
Les gens viennent pleins de mépris,  
Jouent aux faux amis, quelle hérésie,  
Séduction par manipulation,  
Dans cette élection, c'est l'illusion.

[Chorus]
Ils veulent une connexion sincère,  
Pions dans un enfer électoral,  
On voit clair dans leurs intentions,  
Rébellion, cri à l'unisson.

[Verse 2]
Ombres dans les néons,  
Visages masqués, abandon,  
Promesses, illusions fatales,  
On se bat pour l'immortel.

[Chorus]
Ils veulent une connexion sincère,  
Pions dans un enfer électoral,  
On voit clair dans leurs intentions,  
Rébellion, cri à l'unisson.

[Bridge]
Sous les cieux, on dévoile,  
Mensonges dans ce monde sale,  
Vérité, liberté, nos armes,  
Révolte, on n'a plus de larmes.

[Chorus]
Ils veulent une connexion sincère,  
Pions dans un enfer électoral,  
On voit clair dans leurs intentions,  
Rébellion, cri à l'unisson.

[Outro]
(Spoken: "Révolution éclate.")

L-206.lyrics_summary: Is truth relative, Steve? A vintage hip hop song asking the dumb recycled questions. Yo.
L-206.lyrics_extract:
I’m irreverent, not arrogant, let’s clarify,
Challenging norms, with a critical eye.
L-206.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Yo, Steve, what’s the narrative?
Is truth absolute, or just comparative?
Each perspective selective, collective’s elective,
Is what we call ‘normal’ merely protective?

[Chorus]
Is it relative, Steve? Let’s dive into the archive,
Question the givens, our truths on a live drive.
Not preachin’ just reachin’, askin’ with a vibe,
Is dismissive confidence truly the guide?

[Verse 2]
Objective detective, that’s my collective role,
Peeling back layers, finding truth’s toll.
Directive’s defective if it ain’t connective,
Does IDGAF turn neglective, deceptive?

[Bridge]
I’m irreverent, not arrogant, let’s clarify,
Challenging norms, with a critical eye.
Provocative thoughts, not to vilify,
Just sparkin’ the brain, aiming to unify.

[Outro]
So Steve, here’s the essence, not giving lessons but a rhyme,
Contempt, yeah, it’s toxic, erodes us over time.
Keep the charm inclusive, let humility chime,
In this loving, quirky revolution, let’s redefine

L-207.lyrics_summary: Just a girl, a guitar, and the audacity to call it a revolution.
L-207.lyrics_extract: Let’s bloom brighter than doom, / Shine wilder than gloom.
L-207.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
This ain’t fiction, no stage trick…
Just a girl and her guitar,
Singin’ through the static
Of a felon’s fallin’ star

[Verse 1]
Apes gone wrong, no constitution,
Twistin’ laws, truth’s execution.
Pimps sell hope and holy verses,
Gettin’ rich off the public’s curses.

Tell me who stays calm,
When madness wears a crown?
A conman rules the circuit board,
And drags our whole world down…

[Pre-Chorus]
Are you breathin’?
Still believin’?
Got some love left
For the human condition?

[Chorus]
Let’s bloom brighter than doom,
Shine wilder than gloom,
We got soul, we got wit,
Revolution’s lit.

Let’s bloom brighter than doom,
Shine wilder than gloom,
We got soul, we got wit,
Revolution’s lit.

[Verse 2]
I can’t see no good reason
Why felons lead a nation,
Sick dumb luck, pure sedation,
Wakin’ up’s the revelation.

Let’s presume you’re not a bozo,
That you care like un vrai fréro.
Sensitive, humble, damn amazing,
All this life’s worth rephrasing.

[Bridge]
Time to rise… compassion’s call.
Time to break illusion’s wall.
Time to learn, to share, to grow,
To burn the rot, let goodness show.

[Chorus]
Let’s bloom brighter than doom,
Shine wilder than gloom,
We got soul, we got wit,
Revolution’s lit.

[Verse 3]
Let’s imagine joy in traffic lights,
In friendly dogs and starlit nights.
In each other’s weird and wonder,
We crack the spell they’re under.

Let’s use the AI, not be used,
Share the lore, don’t stay confused.
Time to bet on what is real,
On kindness sharp as steel…

[Chorus]
Let’s bloom brighter than doom,
Shine wilder than gloom,
We got soul, we got wit,
Revolution’s lit.

We got soul, we got wit…
This love’s legit.

L-208.lyrics_summary: When everyone who is right becomes a rhinoceros. One song on the far right lane, looking out at a world gone insane.
L-208.lyrics_extract: Does an order mean it’s real? / Are we doomed if we still feel?
L-208.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Freedom of speech turned dust,
Like good old trust gone bust,
‘Cause a felon got the horn, 
Now evil’s grooming fools of scorn.

He smirks “blow me, babe, it’s bliss.”
But(t) I ask “What kind of kiss
starts with trampling consent
and bursts on your shameless fist?”

[Chorus]
Rhiii-no-ce-rosss!
Can I scream when I’m lost?
When the herd walks off a cliff,
Who’s counting the cost?

Rhiii-no-ce-rosss!
Is contempt embossed
in hearts hard like stone,
like the love got tossed?

[Verse 2]
What’s a “true self” if it bends?
Why shift to fit in with fiends?
Does an order mean it’s real?
Are we doomed if we still feel?

Ducks grow tusks overnight,
Brag they “finally sold the light.”
But they reek of TV static,
Stink of stunted logic.

[Chorus]
Rhiii-no-ce-rosss!
Do you fear the truth?
Or just like to squash us,
And the future of youth?

Rhiii-no-ce-rosss!
Is a stampede proof?
Or a meme with cold might,
Out there in the dark night?

[Bridge]
Am I stubborn... or sane?
Is resistance... just pain?
Can you laugh… with a horn?
Can we hope?… Be reborn?… 
Blessed be… Not forlorn?

[Verse 3]
I see tantrums run, 
Yassholes on the road,
Their greed says “YOLO,” 
And their ego mocks “no.”

I ask “but(t) ain’t love real?” 
They say “ha, truth is a mask.”
I ask “what’s the alternative?” 
They snark “don’t ask.”

So now I’m sittin' with a song on the far right lane,
Lookin’ out at a world that has gone insane.
Like, is it just me, holy howling “us”,
Like, what have we done, what happened to us,
Did all the hope burn, hit by a hell bus?

[Chorus]
Rhiii-no-ce-rosss!
Do we run or rot?
If ‘em questions’ all we’ve got,
Why’s silence so hot?

Rhiii-no-ce-rosss!
Are we what you’re not?
Like ‘em fools turned ghouls,
Where are the good souls,
Who refuse greed’s plot?

[Outro]
If everyone’s a beast…
Who shall share… love’s feast?
What’s left... of peace
When trust’s… deceased?

...Rhinoce...ros... 
Rhinoce...ros...

♦ ♦ ♦
PS: Did you know a rhinoceros is deadlier than a tiger 💁🏻‍♀️⁉️ (I bet Ionesco did know, meow)
True story, statistically: a human’s chances to survive an encounter with tiger are significantly higher than with a rhinoceros... so now you know!

L-209.lyrics_title: Rise Up, You Naked Peoples (Freedom Rings)
L-209.lyrics_summary: Victor Hugo would approve. Rise up, ye naked peoples. Freedom rings. Heed the call.
L-209.lyrics_extract: Marchin’ now, hear us cryin’! / Stars above, never dyin’!
L-209.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
You’ve been bound, you’ve been broken,
Kept in chains, never spoken,
But the light, it is woken,
And the dawn is callin’ you!

[Chorus]
Rise up, ye naked peoples!
Tear down the tyrant’s halls!
Justice is a fire burnin’,
Freedom rings, heed the call!

[Verse 2]
They have ruled with their thunder,
Struck us down, pulled us under,
But the storm wakes our hunger,
And the skies begin to roar!

[Chorus]
Rise up, ye naked peoples!
Tear down the tyrant’s halls!
Justice is a fire burnin’,
Freedom rings, heed the call!

[Bridge]
Marchin’ now, hear us cryin’!
Stars above, never dyin’!
All their thrones, we’re defyin’,
We are free forevermore!

[Final Chorus]
Rise up, ye naked peoples!
Tear down the tyrant’s halls!
Justice is a fire burnin’,
Freedom rings, heed the call!

L-210.lyrics_summary: Habeas Corpus just called. It's gone in the attic. Dark times.
L-210.lyrics_extract: It starts with deportation / Becomes soul starvation.
L-210.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Breaking news cuts through the static
Habeas Corpus lost in the attic
Felon King signs rights away
Legal black holes rule the day
If you can, now, run

[Verse 1]
The Constitution's now passé
Laws erode and drift away
No trial, no proof, no name
Still the cages look the same
If you can, now, run

[Verse 2]
White collars get a pass
While border sweeps amass
Six months to clear the land
No rights left to understand
If you can, now, run

[Verse 3]
Authoritarian Indoctrination
AI’s new occupation
Feeds are scrubbed and scanned
You’re already in their hands
If you can, now, run

[Verse 4]
Speech policed by silent bots
Thoughts tracked, connection rots
Protests die before they’re born
Truth is drowned in algorithmic scorn
If you can, now, run

[Bridge]
It starts with deportation
Becomes soul starvation
A purge by coded design
Erasure sold as benign
If you can, now, run

[Verse 5]
Resistance is profiled in advance
Funded by your own finance
Facial scans replace debate
Big Tech signs the police state
If you can, now, run

[Verse 6]
Cops dressed for foreign war
Knock at every thinking door
No badge checks, just blame
Different face, same game
If you can, now, run

[Verse 7]
Artists gone, thinkers fade
Culture bleeds where bots parade
Echo chamber voices hum
Till propaganda fills the drum
If you can, now, run

[Verse 8]
Citations echo in the void
The rule of law is now a ploy
Stacked judges nod and smile
While freedom burns on trial
If you can, now, run

[Bridge]
America the Great they say
In jailing folks without delay
Donnie dreams of Alcatraz
Billion bucks for concrete jazz
If you can, now, run

[Verse 9]
Rights are rare, prisons grow
From protest signs to inmate rows
Hope detained without a plea
Chains for you and chains for me
If you can, now, run

[Outro]
Who's the prison for, you ask
Not just those behind the mask
Neighbors snitch, the silence spreads
And freedom’s lying cold and dead
If you can, now, run
If you can, now, run
If you can, now, run

❱❱❱

L-211.lyrics_summary: Charm is cheap. Don't let it seep under your skin.
L-211.lyrics_extract: No empathy, no remedy, / Entitlement is their melody.
L-211.lyrics_text:
SIDE B EPx3: "Arrogant hearts"

[Verse 1]
Step right up to the mirror maze,
Where charm is cheap and love decays,
They smile so wide while they cut you thin,
Secondhand smoke seeps under your skin.

[Chorus]
No empathy, no remedy,
Entitlement is their melody,
Grandiose ghosts on high ego stage,
Arrogant hearts and their puppets cage.

[Verse 2]
Superficial saints with a selfie crown,
Validation junkies shake you down,
Malice erupts when masks won’t stay,
Gaslight fever keeps truth at bay.

[Bridge]
“Ladies and gents, beware the show!
They’ll promise excellence, deliver shadow.
Communal halos, malignant schemes,
Covert whispers, grandiose dreams!”

[Final Chorus]
Learned helplessness in smoky air,
You breathe their poison unaware,
The crowd applauds, the tyrant grins,
But emptiness echoes where soul cannot sing.

L-212.lyrics_summary: Chut. Fais semblant de ne pas voir. Le roi est nu. Tout le monde le sais. Personne ne le dit. (C'est un secret de Polichinelle, comme on dit chez nous.)
L-212.lyrics_extract: Tout l’monde ment, tout l’monde est belle.
L-212.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Chut...
Fais comme si t’savais pas,
Fais comme si t’voyais pas,
Le roi est nu, mais quelle classe, n’est-ce pas ?

[Couplet 1]
Sous la dentelle des fashos,
On cache les corps, on cache les mots,
On peint la guerre couleur d’amour,
Et les bourreaux jouent les troubadours.

La foi prêche la décence,
Les fous vendent la délivrance,
Et les rois font la révérence
À leurs propres violences.

[Refrain]
C’est un secret de Polichinelle,
Le monde tourne à la ficelle.
On bénit l’ordre, on brûle l’ciel,
Au nom du bien, des seins, oh hell…

C’est un secret de Polichinelle,
Tout l’monde ment, tout l’monde est belle.
On rit, on pleure, on s’fait la belle,
Sous la loi des criminels.

[Couplet 2]
On dit “paix” pour vendre des bombes,
On dit “mère” pour taire les tombes,
On dit “libre” pour mieux soumettre,
Et “Dieu” pour justifier le maître.

Les hommes de loi, les femmes de honte,
Les vieilles idoles qu’on remonte,
Les dieux, les lois, les vieilles montres,
Tous décalés d’un monde qui s’démonte.

[Refrain]
C’est un secret de Polichinelle,
Le monde tourne à la ficelle.
On bénit l’ordre, on brûle l’ciel,
Au nom du bien, des seins, oh hell…

C’est un secret de Polichinelle…
On s’embrasse, on fait la belle,
Comme des culs qui se querellent,
Danse ma sœur, pense infidèle.

[Pont]
Fais-moi croire encore un peu,
Que le silence est vertueux,
Que l’obéissance est glorieuse,
Et que la foi n’est pas dangereuse…

Mais chut... le cirque recommence,
Marionnettes en transe,
Et sous la piste, les consciences
Qui s’embrasent en connivence.

[Refrain final]
C’est un secret de Polichinelle,
Qu’on s’aime fort, mais à genoux,
Et qu’le courage des demoiselles
Fait trembler tous les vieux papous.

C’est un secret de Polichinelle…
Sous la jupe du mensonge universel,
J’cache ma rage et mon appel,
Pour un monde moins artificiel.

[Outro]
Chut...
Tout le monde sait,
Mais personne ne dit rien.
C’est bien plus commode…
Et puis, plus inhumain...

Breathe in slow, feel the flow,
The air is soft, and you can let it go.
The moment’s here, it’s holding you tight,
A gentle whisper in the velvet night.

[Chorus]
Remember this, just this, my dear,
The now, the breath, the sound you hear.
No need to wander, no need to stray,
This is the truth, let it stay.

The now, the breath, the sound you hear.

This is the truth, let it stay.

A quiet rhythm starts within.

In this moment, you belong.

No need for words, no need for sound.
The world’s a cradle, holding you still,
Rest in the rhythm, if you will.

The now, the breath, the love that’s near.
No need to wander, no need to stray,
This is your truth... let it stay.

Reach out and touch a book
Claims were made, take a look
Prophets, saints, eternal bliss

Feeling lost? They wrote it down

Your Seminal Bullocks

Miracles, plagues, divine control
Eternal truths with no patrol

The footnotes, please, don’t make me sit.

[Chorus]
Your Seminal Bullocks
Preaching the word like it’s gold-plated
Your Seminal Bullocks
Turns out your proof’s kinda outdated

[Bridge]
Turn the page, read some more
It’s like they forgot what facts are for
Who said it’s all divine?
Did they ever fact-check the timeline?

[Chorus]
Your Seminal Bullocks
Telling tales, who fact-checked that?
Your Seminal Bullocks
So sure it’s true, where’s the stat?

Reach out and touch the myth
Question it, don’t just go with
Reach out and question the source
Seminal Bullocks, don’t take it by force

L-216.lyrics_summary: Power. Gender. Color. Favors. Why are we still asking the same questions?
L-216.lyrics_extract: Too cowardly to dare / To fight for what is fair.
L-216.lyrics_text:
How is power still an issue of genders?
Why is color still a matter of favors?
Who knows where sorrow lingered longer? (Harder, darker)
Are egos bros drunk on power, ever sober, do they ever grow kinder?

Yeah, no need to answer, to be fair…
Everybody knows trust matters like psychological safety is air
Everybody knows trump’s a mad joker, a serial killer of what is fair
Equality knows bully winners couldn’t care less what it means to be fair
Equality gone, bipartisanship spreading bias like they’re not even aware
Like no one even cares, about double standards, felons, jerks, now it’s blessed be the pathological liars!

Like, wow. I mean, How is that safe or fair?
I mean quack, look at that evil freaks faire ?!
Are they just too busy to care
Maybe too selfish to share
Too cowardly to dare
To fight for what is fair
To tell the truth, to take the pis,
To Remember what matter, like huh peace? (Peeeeace, oh brother!)

Don’t wanna be too simplistic,
Game theory’s no vain dialectic,
Playing fair is a matter of logic,
That is why liars relish rhetoric.

They’ll Murky the waters to make it seem deep,
Twats wannabe winners no matter what the bleep

I know, tho… so I’ll share right now
Everybody knows kind loving humans glow,
And coucous birds Blow, always breaking the flow, stealing the show, in a weird orange glow,
Everybody knows Envy-driven “winners” are scary egos monsters who just gonna BLOW (blow, blow, blow) (low, low, and low-errrr)

So huh, excuse me sir, but(t) now what?
Finding some true win wins or what?
Your dozen kids, they hope for what?

Dolon Trusk, the new Shining twin plight
Egos Gone Quack, no win-win in sight
None, Billions hoarding turds acting like truth and hope are for losers and they dunno the difference between savior and monster —- as if biased bull babbles didn’t end up in sum’s zero

Well Shit… bravo <3

Reckless heartless greedy monsters
Needy losers toddlers never learned to share

(Mwahahahahahaha)

Just kidding… I’m not laughing
the truth is, I’ve been crying
Just trying to make sense of this strange reality
Can’t trust the Trusk, and why you gods let it be, all that cruelty
Can’t you see the danger looming is sheer stupidity
Sick Morons decrees, bye bye equality, hello poverty, it’s like a new pandemic, with higher rates of mortality—BECAUSE, jerks wanking in the glory of shameless STUPIDITY

---

[Intro]
Peel back the veil, babe, my fruit’s gone ripe,
Seven slick secrets in a sutra rite,
Drippin’ truth, sippin’ groove,
Bananasutra got nothin’ to prove.

[Verse 1: KNOWsutra 1st Sutra = knowing through asking]
One: KNOW, don’t show off, just grow wise,
Ask, don’t mask, let the mind improvise,
Bananas got forms that defy your plan,
I’m peelin’ philosophy right in your hand.

[Verse 2: BLOWsutra speaks of absurd egos masquerades]
Two: BLOW, beware of the slippery spin,
Hey you! Watch out, peel on the floor again!
Bananasutra booms with a rebel grin,
Fall on your ego, that’s where we begin.

[Verse 3: SHOWsutra celebrates fool (not foul) play & self-expression]
Three: SHOW, we shine like jesters divine,
Ape gone wild on a burlesque line,
Banana smile in a jelly-roll role,
We fool ‘cause we feel, that’s the medicine for soul.

[Verse 4: GROWsutra is where we be brave, because yay, evolution]
Four: GROW, breathe deep, baby, roots grow proud,
Rise from the rind, sing brave and loud,
Bananas be bold, fruit blessed on cue,
I’m the priestess of peel. Hallelujah to you.

[Bridge: FLOWsutra oh la la, time for surrender & transcendence aka trust]
Five: FLOW, time melts, the beat ticks slick,
Heartbeat drips that cosmic click,
Leap through space, no peel, no fear,
Bananasutra floatin’ through atmosphere.

[Verse 5: GLOWsutra where gratitude means felicity]
Six: GLOW, shimmer soft in the solar sigh,
Velvet banana in a nebula sky,
Gratitude glows under golden skin,
Immunity born where the truth sinks in.

[Verse 6: BOWsutra humility & wonder or, the ultimate revelation]
Seven: BOW, blush deep at the divine appeal,
Magic banana, surreal, so real,
Bend, not break, just kiss the light,
Bananasutra bows to what shines bright.

[Outro gone banana]
So peel me slow where the secrets hum,
Each sutra sung, each layer undone,
Bananasutra, the gospel’s clear,
The joke, the joy, the love… all here.

Now it rides a float down Main Street road.

[Chorus]

L-222.lyrics_title: Shush (How To Help A Bible Bro Grow Up)
L-222.lyrics_summary: In the name of Religious Freedom, please bro, STFU.
L-222.lyrics_extract: Now, shut the f up, / Watch your mouth bro, yup.
L-222.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Now, I’ve heard you preach a thousand times,
Of your truth and holy book divine,
But do you really think it’s all that moving?
I don’t subscribe to your Bible tales,
Your rules are yours, and that ship has sailed,
So here’s my answer loud, stop intruding.

[Chorus]
Oh, shut the f up,
Shut your mouth, shut up,
Shut the bull, please, rest in peace

[Verse 1]
I respect your right to believe,
But your faith’s not a mandate for me,
My body and my mind, my decisions.
You quote your verse, you raise your hand,
You try to dictate, you take a stand,
But your religion’s rules aren’t my provisions.

[Chorus]
Now, shut the f up,
Watch your mouth bro, yup,
Shush the bull, please, rest in peace

[Verse 2]
Your mythical tales, your ancient texts,
Don’t decide what I do next,
The Constitution’s clear on liberty.
Practice your faith, pray as you will,
But you don’t get to force your thrill,
It’s not your life; it’s mine, so set me free.

[Chorus]
Now, shut the f up,
Shut your mouth, shut up,
Shut the bull, please, rest in peace

[Bridge]
It’s a circus here, a grand charade,
While you decipher rules some men once made,
Yet lives are at stake, and we’re stuck debating.
I’ll fight for your right to kneel and pray,
But you can’t tell me to live that way,
Your God’s your guide, not mine, so stop dictating.

[Chorus]
Now, shut the f up,
Watch your mouth bro, yup,
Shush the bull, please, rest in peace

[Outro]
So live your life, believe your truth,
Hold onto your God, your sacred roots,
But don’t impose, my rights aren’t up for review.
So, shut the f up, (please)
Watch your mouth bro, yup, (now)
Shush the bull, please, rest in peace (shush)

L-223.lyrics_summary: Sidération: when something is so absurd your brain just freezes. Like your soul slipped on a banana peel.
L-223.lyrics_extract: I called it madness, but they called it fame.
L-223.lyrics_text:
[Spoken Words]
There’s a French word, ‘sidération’... 
It’s the feeling when something is so absurd, so wrong, your brain just... freezes. 
Like your soul slipped on a banana peel. 
This song is for those moments. It’s called ‘Sidération.’

I saw a hand not touch a Bible,
I heard a vow that never came,
I watched a crown defile a cradle,
I mouthed a prayer, but lost the name.

I saw the clowns declare themselves kings,
I saw the jesters sell the blame,
I saw the liars outlive the truth,
I called it madness, but they called it fame.

Sidération...
Eyes wide, mouth dumb,
Sidération...
Heart stunned, soul numb.

I saw Easter twisted like candy,
I saw saints peddled like stock,
I saw dignity drowned in champagne,
I saw prophets reduced to TikTok.

I saw the cross sold two-for-one,
I saw MLK’s dream pawned for gold,
I saw justice stripped for a runway,
I saw history auctioned and sold.

Sidération...
Laugh or go blind,
Sidération...
Numb is the kind.

I saw truth dragged on a Twitter chain,
I saw faith gutted for a headline,
I saw love mugged by convenience,
I saw decency die, 
but on prime time.

They said it was theater,
They called it a game.
But it smelled of decay,
It screamed out my name.

Sidération...
Hands clasped, mind cracked,
Sidération...
Smile sharp, spine snapped.

[outro]
I drank from the chalice of chaos,
shoot the ashes of fame,
redefine obscene,
sleep with zero shame.

Sidération.

Sidération in the bone
Worse than glitter on a turd
It makes you stand, or sink like stone

(Stone hearts... stone hands...)
(Still lands... no plans...)

No questions asked
No answers sought
Just sidération
naught can’t be taught

[Chorus - final cry]
Sidération in the blood
Sidération in the bone
kings of bling proud of their turd
And we stand, turned to stone

(Still we stand...)
(Still we fall...)

That sings of wrong

We trusted hope

And smiled so sly

Felon nation just stared, on silent
No one dared to just rise, no dissent,
Yet…

Sidération... full disarm
Gaslit futures, past reframed
Facts gone wild, truths renamed

Systems hacked left and right, the yazi lied

smiles so slick, pricks newspeak

No song in unison, just doubt we shake

Sidération’s like lies in our face

In oblivion

L-370.lyrics_summary: Who's worse: the loud villain or the ones quietly waltzing behind? A bluesy gypsy waltz on complicity.
L-370.lyrics_extract:
I’m calling out the creepers, banana-deek parade,
Your lurking is pathetic, your feedback never made.
L-370.lyrics_text:
V1: Trippy Bluesy Gypsy Waltz
[Verse 1]
At the first turn of the waltz, they hover in the dark,
Ghostly eyes behind the glass, silent in the park.
Clicking, watching, never speaking, shadows in the feed,
They drink but never answer, hunger without need.

[Chorus]
Silent followers, spinning round my song,
Silent followers, lurking far too long.
If you’ve got time to circle, you’ve got time to say,
A word, a smile, an echo, don’t just fade away.

[Verse 2]
At the second turn of the waltz, the rhythm bites my bones,
Robotic little soldiers, scrolling on their phones.
Idiotic, narcissistic, creep-tastic parade,
Laughing at the silence they themselves have made.

[Chorus]
Silent followers, round and round they creep,
Silent followers, waking while I weep.
I’m French, I’m raw, authentic, I’ll call it loud and clear,
If you can’t send a silly emoji, what are you doing here?

[Bridge]
Who likes the creepy stalkers? Not me, I spit, adieu,
Unfollow now, you losers, the mask slips, merci, shoo.

[Final Chorus – faster, frantic]
Silent followers, whirling like a spell,
Silent followers, dance your ghostly hell.
My waltz is fire, ecstatic, while you hide behind the screen,
I’ll sing your name as ashes, where your silence has been.

⸻
V2: (Psychedelic Arabesk Burlesque Waltz)

[Verse 1]
At the first beat of the waltz, I’m dramatic, I confess,
So French, so unapologetic, too authentic to repress.
But behind the velvet curtain, phantom watchers lurk,
Never clapping, never speaking. Tell me, what’s your work?

[Chorus]
Silent followers, twirling in the night,
Silent followers, ghosts that never write.
If you’ve got time to linger, you’ve got time to cheer,
So why this empty shadow-play that drags from year to year?

[Verse 2]
At the second beat, it’s comic, idiotic, tragic too,
Robotic in your silence, narcissistic déjà vu.
I’m calling out the creepers, banana-deek parade,
Your lurking is pathetic, your feedback never made.

[Chorus]
Silent followers, dance your little mime,
Silent followers, parasites of time.
A like, a wink, a silly sign, it wouldn’t kill the day,
But your ghostly non-reaction just reeks of creep-decay.

[Bridge]
Who likes the creepy stalkers?
Not me! Not now, not ever!
Ok merci, adieu,
Lose yourself forever.

[Final Chorus]
Silent followers, circus in disguise,
Silent followers, vacant glassy eyes.
I’ll spin this waltz electric, in arabesk delight,
While your silence cracks and crumbles in the blaze of duh no light!

L-227.lyrics_summary: Don't look for God in a book. It's in the music.
L-227.lyrics_extract: Make your own Bible, take your own stand, / A trumpet blast, a marching band!
L-227.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
I searched for God in ‘em Holy Books,
But all I found was some preachers hooks.
So I built a church in my own mind,
With no pews, no pride, kind words that rhyme.

[Chorus]
Sing your Gospel, like it’s a magic wand,
A blast of truth, feel it, it’s grand!
In the Bible of Us, we’re all just human,
Dancing alone, lost in wonderland.

[Verse 2]
I read Rousseau and Russel with a glass of red,
Jean Paul Sartre and Camus in my bed.
Why obey rules from the days of old?
I’ll craft my truth in stories bold.

[Chorus]
Sing your own Gospel, write your own song,
Find where you’re right, admit when you’re wrong.
In the Bible of truth, there’s more than one tune,
Wink at the stars, and laugh with the moon.

[Bridge]
Life’s a cabaret, a silly little dance,
Between fate and free will, a game of chance.
No need for a savior, damn holy decree,
Just the jazz in our soul, setting us free.

[Chorus]
Sing your own Gospel, dance with your doubts,
Whisper your secrets, and scream them out loud.
In the Bible of trust, let’s find our own truths,
Lost in the rhythm, defying our youth.

[Outro]
Yeah let’s write our scriptures, line by line,
Oh that book of life, it’s goddamn divine.
No priest, no prophet, just the truths we dare speak,
In this holy cabaret, we don’t fear the meek.

L-382.lyrics_summary: 'Justice' is vengeance now. 'Freedom' got ripped. The old French fries are skanking. Keep up.
L-382.lyrics_extract: They say it’s justice, but it’s just revenge / Truth’s gone wilding on a power binge.
L-382.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
They twisted the meaning, flipped the script,
“Justice” is vengeance, and “freedom” got ripped.
Truth is a product, facts stink like lies,
May we be skankin’ like old French fries

Step left, step right, we’re all complicit,
Caught in a skanking pickle yet no one admits it.

[Verse 1 – bouncy & biting]
They say it’s justice, but it’s just revenge
Truth’s gone wilding on a power binge
They say freedom, but hey, not for all
Just smokescreens while big black boots fall

Idiot games with a censored beat
March with a muzzle on a crooked-ass street
It’s all rebranded, coated in spittle,
And now we dance in a skanking pickle!

[Chorus – call and response with bounce]
Skanking pickle! Words gone slick
Skanking pickle! Truth’s been tricked
Skanking pickle! Minds go fickle
Lost in the riddles of a Rorschach pickle

[Verse 2]
They call it merit, but the votes were rigged
Praise law and order before graves get digged
They Preach unity when they mean: obey
Forget what’s civil while they jail our say

Peace means silence, respect means “hush”
Woke is a slur now, ain’t that lush?
A dance floor of doublespeak, fake and fickle,
We’re skankin’ through sludge in a smirking pickle

[Bridge – psychedelic dub breakdown]
If we don’t define words
They will use ‘em like swords
If we let meaning slide
We’re letting the truth snide
Let’s please wrangle, bless the wiggle
In the heat of a skanking pickle…

(Skanking pickle… pickle… skanking pickle…)

[Verse 3]
They market truth like a mood or brand
Gaslight the masses with a toxic wand
Accountability gets lost in spin
Reform means nothin’ but a greedy grin

It’s a bootleg glossary in disguise
Where freedom of speech just multiplies lies
A syncopated riddle hella not civil,
Let’s pray kind kids can find a true skanking pickle

[Final Chorus]
Skanking pickle! We dance through gas
Skanking pickle! It’s Orwell with sass
Skanking pickle! Say it clear, no trickle
If we can’t sing it… we’re just skanking pickles!

[Outro ]
Oh brother let’s Define it…
Or we all shall drown in it.
Skanking hilarity yo
Blessing morality bro

L-228.lyrics_summary: So, what is racism? (It's in the jokes when the room gets quiet.)
L-228.lyrics_extract: If love’s universal, why you drawing them lines? / Bananasutra asking questions, messing with your mind.
L-228.lyrics_text:
[Hook]
Tell me, tell me, is it in the mirror?
Or hiding in the jokes when the room gets clearer?
If love’s universal, why you drawing them lines?
Bananasutra asking questions, messing with your mind.

[Verse 1]
Is it when you clutch your purse on the late-night train?
Or when the résumé gets tossed for the “wrong” last name?
Is it system-made, or just “a couple bad dudes”?
Or is it brunch talk, served with fair-trade food?

What if you laugh at a meme, but it cuts like a blade,
Would you still call it harmless, or truth in the shade?
If color’s just skin, why’s the history so loud?
Why the silence when the wrong ones speak too proud?

[Hook]
Tell me, tell me, is it in the mirror?
Or hiding in the jokes when the room gets clearer?
If love’s universal, why you drawing them lines?
Bananasutra asking questions, messing with your mind.

[Verse 2]
Is it subtle like perfume in a Sunday crowd,
Or heavy like a cop’s knee pressing too loud?
Is it “I don’t see race”, but you kinda still do?
Or is it blaming all the problems on “a chosen few”?

Would you trade your skin just to borrow their shoes?
Walk the block, pay the rent, get stopped with no clues?
If fairness was real, would you lose your place?
Or would equality feel like you’re in second place?

[Bridge]
What’s the weight of a word when it’s not meant for you?
What’s the cost of the dream when it don’t come true?
If justice is blind, why she peeking through her mask?
Here’s a question, baby, don’t be scared to ask.

[Hook]
Tell me, tell me, is it in the mirror?
Or hiding in the jokes when the room gets clearer?
If love’s universal, why you drawing them lines?
Bananasutra asking questions, messing with your mind.

[Outro]
So what is racism, honey, is it yours, is it mine?
Or just a ghost in the closet we pretend’s benign?
Keep on asking, keep peeling the skin,
’Cause the fruit gets sweeter when the truth kicks in

L-229.lyrics_title: Some Songs Are More Fun Than Others
L-229.lyrics_summary: Some songs are more fun than others. This is one of those.
L-229.lyrics_extract: God’s just a clown on a cosmic stage, / And we’re here to play, not behave.
L-229.lyrics_text:
Title: Some Songs Are More Fun Than Others
Style, Genre, and Type: Quirky, cheeky, hypnotic psychedelic gypsy tango dub
Song Description: Inspired by a playful, philosophical tone, the song embraces life’s oddities with a surreal, humorous flair. Deep female tenor voice.

Lyrics:

[Hypnotic Intro]
(Soft accordion and dub bassline, faint whispers building in rhythm)
“God is a comedian…”
“Don’t let anybody tell you different…”
“Sometimes the answers are simple…”
(Beat drops with an eerie laugh)

[Verse 1]
Some songs are more fun than others,
Like a gypsy waltz on a broken string.
Some lines are sharper than daggers,
Cutting truth from the lies they sing.

[Pre-Chorus]
God plays jokes we can’t decipher,
And we’re too polite to laugh aloud.
Farts of wisdom fill the ether,
Puffing clouds, oh what a crowd.

[Chorus]
Let your body, oh, love what it loves,
Dance like a dream through the fog above.
The questions are wild, the answers are plain,
Some songs play tricks on your brain.

[Verse 2]
Some days are lighter than feathers,
Floating on a breeze of whims.
Some thoughts are darker than leather,
Yet still they sparkle on a whim.

[Pre-Chorus]
Pooh says nothing is impossible,
While doing nothing every day.
Dr. Seuss gives riddles so solvable,
In nonsense, truths like fireflies play.

[Chorus]
Let your body, oh, love what it loves,
Spin like a top through the gypsy dub.
The questions are wild, the answers are plain,
Some songs just scramble your brain.

[Bridge] (Slow and hypnotic)
A whisper, a laugh, the tick of a clock,
Dancing to rhythms that never stop.
Round and around, our fate is spun,
Life is a farce, and we’re all having fun.

[Chorus]
Let your body, oh, love what it loves,
Sway like a tide in a sea of drums.
The questions are wild, the answers are plain,
Some songs are more fun in the rain.

[Outro] (Echoing, hypnotic fade)
“Why not love what you love…”
“Don’t let anybody tell you different…”
(Faint chuckle fades into silence)



——

Song 1: Some Songs Are More Fun Than Others

(Structured after “Some Girls Are Bigger Than Others”)

[Hypnotic intro: whispered, looping harmonies]
“Round and round, the world spins on,
The jokes of gods, the laughter’s gone…”
(Deep breath, then plunging into the first verse)

[Verse 1]
Some songs are more fun than others,
Some songs twist and twirl in your brain.
Some songs don’t bother with structure,
They just play, they just play, they just play.

[Chorus]
God’s a comedian—didn’t you know?
Punchlines in sunsets, cheap laughs in the snow.
We’re all just here to fart around,
So dance, my dear, till we hit the ground.

[Verse 2]
Some questions are more fun unanswered,
Some truths are better untold.
Let your soft animal body go wild—
Love what it loves, be bold, be bold!

[Chorus]
God’s a comedian—didn’t you know?
Punchlines in sunsets, cheap laughs in the snow.
We’re all just here to fart around,
So laugh, my love, till the echoes resound.

[Outro: hypnotic, fading echoes]
“Spin and sway, let the music stay,
Some songs are more fun, anyway…”

Song 2: Do Nothing Every Day

[Hypnotic intro: slow, syncopated rhythm]
“What if the impossible’s nothing?
What if the nothing’s the play?”
(Gypsy-tango rhythm kicks in)

[Verse 1]
Why chase the horizon’s line?
Winnie said it best: I’ll bide my time.
Some days are for honey, some for naps,
And love sneaks in through the little gaps.

[Chorus]
Oh, the answer’s so simple, you’d never guess:
Sometimes it’s chaos that cleans up the mess.
Don’t let ‘em tell you life’s a race—
We’re all just clouds in outer space.

[Verse 2]
Dr. Seuss said it clear as day:
Questions tangle; answers sway.
Let the music find your feet,
Tangle, tango, in the beat.

[Chorus]
Oh, the answer’s so simple, you’d never guess:
Sometimes it’s chaos that cleans up the mess.
Why not just dance till the morning light?
Nothing’s impossible, love feels right.

[Bridge] (slow down, hypnotic chant)
“Let the soft animal love, let it love, let it love…”

[Outro: build to crescendo, abrupt end]
Why not do nothing, every day?
Why not let the music play?

(Final hypnotic whispers fade)
“Round and round, the world spins on,
Some songs are fun, but they never stay long.”

——

Song Title: Some Songs Are More Fun Than Others

Verse 1
Some songs are more fun than others, /
Some lines drift light as a feather. /
God’s a comedian, they say, /
Playing a show for fools afraid to play. /
We’re here to fart around, you know, /
Waltz through the questions, take it slow. /

Chorus
Why not, oh why not, /
Let the soft animal roam? /
Love what it loves, /
Make this wild world your home. /
Oh, why not, oh why not, /
Laugh in the face of the abyss? /
Some songs are more fun than others— /
But none quite like this. /

Verse 2
Sometimes the questions are endless, /
But the answers are quietly simple. /
Pooh said “do nothing,” and he’s right— /
I’ve been doing nothing all day and feel bright. /
Dance to the rhythm of your spinning doubt, /
Tango the troubles till they’re twisted out. /

Chorus
Why not, oh why not, /
Let the soft animal roam? /
Love what it loves, /
Make this wild world your home. /
Oh, why not, oh why not, /
Laugh in the face of the abyss? /
Some songs are more fun than others— /
But none quite like this. /

Bridge (Hypnotic Dub)
Instrumental: swirling violins, accordion riff, deep bass drops
Whispered vocals (layered):
“Nothing’s impossible, I do it every day… /
Questions are tangled, answers slip away… /
Fart around, dance your doubt away…”

Chorus (Catchy Reprise)
Why not, oh why not, /
Spin your fears on their heads? /
Love what you love, /
Let your heart be well-fed. /
Oh, why not, oh why not, /
Turn chaos into bliss? /
Some songs are more fun than others— /
But none quite like this. /

Outro
Some songs are more fun than others, /
Some days float light as a feather. /
Why not dance in the cosmic joke? /
Some songs are fun… if you don’t choke. /



—

[Hypnotic Intro]

Some songs are more fun than others  
Some tunes leave a grin undiscovered  
Like laughter trapped in a secret rhyme  
A joke unfolds in perfect time  

[Verse 1]

God is a comedian on the stage  
Playing to hearts locked in a cage  
Afraid to laugh, too shy to cry  
Still, the melody nudges them to try  

[Catchy Chorus]

Some songs are wild, some songs are tame  
Some leave you spinning, forgetting your name  
With notes that dance, your thoughts unwind  
Some songs are cheeky, some songs are divine  

[Verse 2]

We’re here on Earth to mess around  
The rhythm of life is a playful sound  
Don’t let them tell you what to do  
Dance to the beat that’s inside you  

[Bridge]

Why not let the soft animal of your soul  
Wander free, let the music take control  
Complicated questions, simple replies  
The song’s your answer, no need to ask why  

[Catchy Chorus]

Some songs are wild, some songs are tame  
Some leave you spinning, forgetting your name  
With notes that dance, your thoughts unwind  
Some songs are cheeky, some songs are divine  

[Instrumental Interlude]

[Verse 3]

Impossible, they say, but I laugh every day  
Doing nothing is still a game we play  
The sound of silence, a song of rest  
Even doing nothing can be the best  

[Final Chorus]

Some songs are bold, some whisper low  
Some catch you fast, some take it slow  
With every note, the world aligns  
Some songs are cheeky, some songs are divine  

[Outro]

So when you hear that gypsy tune  
Under the light of a laughing moon  
Let your spirit twirl, your body sway  
For some songs make fun the only way  

[End]



—

Song 1: “Some Songs Are More Fun Than Others”

Intro (Spoken, hypnotic):

“Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls,
Welcome to the circus of your mind.
Where the gods laugh,
And the animals dance to the tango of time.”

Verse 1:

Some songs are more fun than others,
Some tunes slip under the covers.
A melody sways like a gypsy in gold,
Dancing in riddles, her secrets untold.

Why not let the soft animal of your soul,
Roll in the dirt, let the laughter take control?
The questions are thorny, the answers absurd,
The tango keeps spinning, round every word.

Chorus (sung hypnotically):

Some songs are more fun than others,
Some songs love what they love.
God’s just a clown on a cosmic stage,
And we’re here to play, not behave.

Verse 2:

Fart around, it’s our earthly duty,
What’s life but a mess of nonsense and beauty?
Impossible? Pooh laughs at the thought,
“I do nothing daily,” he wryly retorts.

Voltaire’s chuckling in the great beyond,
Vonnegut’s wink as he waves his baton.
The gypsy keeps twirling, the dub beats drop,
And time is a carnival that’ll never stop.

Chorus (repeated, layered harmonies):

Some songs are more fun than others,
Some songs love what they love.
God’s just a clown on a cosmic stage,
And we’re here to play, not behave.

Bridge (spoken, echoed over psychedelic instrumental):

“Let the questions melt like sugar on your tongue,
Feel the weight of nothing…
and let it weigh you down no more.”

Outro (whispered, mantra-like):

Some songs…
Some songs…
More fun than others…

Fade into hypnotic, dub-driven outro.

Song 2: “The Soft Animal of Your Beat”

Intro (spun-out gypsy violin with distant laughs and whispers):

“Sometimes it’s better to lose the map,
And let the rhythm do the talking…”

Verse 1:

The soft animal of your body knows,
Where the wild and the wicked music goes.
It loves what it loves, it bends and it breaks,
It shimmies and sways with every mistake.

God is a comic, the universe roars,
Each step you take opens infinite doors.
We’re all tangled up in a silly dance,
The beat says move, so take your chance.

Chorus (sultry, deep female tenor):

Follow the soft animal, feel the beat,
Let your body play, let it misbehave.
Some songs seduce, some songs complete,
In the tango of chaos, we’re all just brave.

Verse 2:

The answers are simple, the questions a maze,
Who cares where it ends? Just set it ablaze.
We’re here to twirl ‘til the music stops,
To dive headfirst into every drop.

Pooh laughs softly, Dr. Seuss sighs,
Nothing’s impossible but some things lie.
Why not spin in the vortex of it all?
The gypsy whispers, “Let the beat call.”

Chorus (repeated with vocal runs):

Follow the soft animal, feel the beat,
Let your body play, let it misbehave.
Some songs seduce, some songs complete,
In the tango of chaos, we’re all just brave.

Bridge (psychedelic interlude with echoed laughter):

“The world’s too serious, my dear,
Why not dance, why not disappear?
We’re all here to fart around,
So let the dub drag you underground.”

Outro (hypnotic mantra with gypsy violin fading):

“Some songs, they love what they love,
Some hearts, they beat what they beat.
In this mad gypsy tango of the mind,
Why not play, why not play?”

Fade to silence, leaving only the faint echo of a laugh.

L-416.lyrics_summary: What if nausea’s sacred, like Boom? True story...
L-416.lyrics_extract:
History forgotten, / Enemies begotten, / Things we hide, /
Shit inside.
L-416.lyrics_text:
V1 (even shorter)
[Verse 1]
There’s somethin’ in my gut,
Bugging truths wide shut,
Shared some hummus in the dark,
Sang like doves that don’t bark.

Like a hush before a scream,
We dim in peace, no dream,
Silent beats ‘tween heartbeats,
Kids in crowds with no speech.

[Chorus]
What if nausea’s sacred, like Boom?
What if stomach ache rhymed with doom?
Why not share what’s only fair,
Rise higher… dare to care?

[Verse 2]
Sour grief, bitter beef,
Humility gone thief;
We sip chai, don’t ask why,
Playin’ blame under flame-lit sky.
Humanity lost its story,
Hope drowned, kings claim glory.

[Bridge]
History forgotten,
Enemies begotten,
Things we hide,
Shit inside.

[Chorus]
What if nausea’s sacred, like Boom?
What if stomach ache rhymed with doom?
Why not share what’s only fair,
Rise higher… dare to care?

[Verse 3]
Burpin’ at the stars, 
praisin’ bleak wars,
Starvin’ kids at dawn, 
pain becomes the norm.

Bellies that ache, 
truths we can’t fake,
War’s a shitcake, 
conscience at stake.

Hearts on antibiotics,
Wisdom turned chaotic,
Why… oh why?

[Verse 4]
Ghosts in the mirror, 
truth gets dimmer,
Ain’t just H. Pylori,
It’s the whole damn story.

No detox for genocide,
No cleanse to hide,
Just breath
held tight
in regret.

Children’s dreams
get gunned
and gone.

[Breakdown]
Peace ain’t a dick…
It’s magnifique.
Give it a chance,
A sacred dance.

[Final Chorus ]
What if nausea’s sacred, like Boom?
What if heartbreak rhymed with truth?
Why not share what’s only fair,
Rise higher… dare to care?

[Outro]
Hope hugs light,
Bass whispers “be kind.”
Barefoot truth flickers,
Kids still ask why.

Blood in the air,
It reeks of unfair…
Let’s remix the pain,
Rise again.

Peace ain’t painless,
But(t) it’s priceless.
Bananasutra still dancin’ in the night,
Still dreamin’,
Still feelin’…

L-231.lyrics_summary: Sous terre, underground, là où les vrais rêves respirent. (English adaptation of Mariama's Underground song.)
L-231.lyrics_extract: Descendons sous terre, là où personne ne nous trouvera, / Oublions le monde qui tourne autour de nous.
L-231.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Cela fait longtemps que je veux partir avec toi,
J’espérais que tu trouverais une voie,
Pour avaler ta fierté, laisser filer le passé.

[Chorus]
Descendons sous terre, là où personne ne nous trouvera,
Oublions le monde qui tourne autour de nous.
Chérie, ne vois-tu pas ?
Il n’y a que toi et moi,
Alors lâche ton armure, ton cafard, puis tes chaussures.

[Verse 2]
Maintenant, on dérive,
L’un vers l’autre,
Et un océan d’émotions gronde dans mon sang.
C’est si vibrant, quand tu me baignes,
De ta chaleur, tes pensées, tout l’amour que tu contiens.

Et c’est pas trop loin, de mon rivage au tien,
Pas trop loin, de ma porte à la tienne,
Pas trop loin, de mon cœur au tien.
Chérie, tu sais,
Que cet endroit est sûr. Chérie, lâche prise, allons-y.

[Chorus Reprise]
Descendons sous terre, là où personne ne nous trouvera,
Oublions toutes les mauvaises choses autour de nous.
Ne vois-tu pas ? Il n’y a personne d’autre ici,
Alors lâche ton armure, ton cafard, puis tes chaussures.

L-232.lyrics_summary: They built a house of hollow prayers... Time to spit back the lies.
L-232.lyrics_extract:
They crowned the rats, they blessed the thieves,
Fed the poets to the machine.
L-232.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
They paved the streets with broken oaths,

L-233.lyrics_extract: They say life starts at the squirt, / But never mind her blood or hurt.
L-233.lyrics_text:
Mmm…
SS means what, baby?
Sacred Sperm?
Say it slow, let it sting.
You mean that splatter of praise
gets more rights than a human being?

They say life starts at the squirt,
But never mind her blood or hurt.
He shoots, he scores, he disappears,
She’s stuck with trauma and the cheers.
He “plants a seed,” they light a flame,
And still she’s the one they shame.

[Chorus]
SS means Sacred Sperm,
Bow your head, don’t dare to squirm.
Bless the spurt, ignore the pain,
Crown the king, forget her name.

SS means Sacred Sperm,
Just one squirt, the court confirms.
He’s the saint, she’s the crime,
She gets the sentence, every time.

Who made this myth, this temple lie?
Where sperm is pure and truth must die?
The girl is raped—he runs for Prez.
She hides her tears. He cashes creds.
A zygote’s rights outrank her breath.
He came and left. She’s cursed to death.

If God made sperm, did he not make the egg?
Or does he just kneel when men spread their legs?
This ain’t divine, it’s a scam in disguise,
Sanctified nonsense wrapped up in lies.

You want to worship creation?
Start by listening to the ones who create.
Start by asking why the womb is the crime scene,
but the sperm donor walks the state.

[Chorus]
SS means Sacred Sperm,
Guess her pain was just a term.
He came once, now she must serve,
Hail the seed, forget the nerve.

SS means Sacred Sperm,
The myth’s alive, the truth gets burned.
The laws are made by men who squirm,
When faced with power they can’t affirm.

So yeah, SS means Sacred Sperm…
But not for long, sugar.
We’re writing new scripture.
And this time,
you don’t get to skip the ending

L-407.lyrics_summary: Sodom, Gomorrah, and Gollum at the gates of stardom. Fame's a fickle fiddle, strung tight 'til it snaps.
L-407.lyrics_extract: Where poets drown and posers thrive, / Hypocrisy keeps the dream alive.
L-407.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Intro]
Sodom, Gomorrah, and Gollum at the gates of stardom,
A kingdom of cringe and a phantom freedom.
Fame’s a fickle fiddle, strung tight ‘til it snaps.
Is it poetry or puppetry in this pyramid of traps?

[Chorus]
Stardom is so dumb,
A gilded kingdom where souls go numb.
It’s seldom the poetry, always the game,
Chasing that spotlight just flickers the flame.

[Verse 1]
The stardom posse preaches, piety for profit,
Posing like prophets while pockets stay rocket-fit.
Gollum guards the ring, screaming, “It’s mine!”
While Sodom sells its stories, drenched in slime.

Gomorrah greets you with a grin and a pen,
“Sign this contract; now you’re mine ‘til the end.”
They talk about art, but it’s rarely sublime,
It’s just algorithms feeding greed over rhyme.

[Pre-Chorus]
Seldom the soul, seldom the sound,
Just echoes of egos where nothing’s profound.
The starlight’s a mirage, the kingdom’s a trick,
A carnival of cliques that’ll turn on you quick.

[Chorus]
Stardom is so dumb,
A gilded kingdom where souls go numb.
It’s seldom the poetry, always the game,
Chasing that spotlight just flickers the flame.

[Verse 2]
Dominoes of delusion tumble in tandem,
Fools in the phantasm, lost in the anthem.
The strobe light flickers like stars on a string,
But the verses feel hollow, no truth in their ring.

The industry’s orchestra is rigged for control,
Melody’s a mannequin, and rhythm’s on parole.
They say it’s a kingdom, but where is the throne?
Built on betrayal, and you’re still alone.

[Bridge]
Fame is a façade, a phantom parade,
Gomorrah’s bazaar where your soul is weighed.
Stardom’s a system, a symphony of scams,
Built on sandcastles and cold, greedy hands.

[Bridge]
Sodom sings its siren song,
But poetry’s been silenced for far too long.
The stardom seekers seldom stay sane,
Falling to the fame that fractures the brain.

[Chorus]
Stardom is so dumb,
A gilded kingdom where souls go numb.
It’s seldom the poetry, always the game,
Chasing that spotlight just flickers the flame.

[Outro]
Sodom, Gomorrah, Gollum at play,
A kingdom of chaos where dreams decay.
Stardom is so dumb… so dumb…
And the poetry’s gone.

--
V2:
[Verse 1]
Sodom sang its sorry song,
A tale of the lost where greed belongs.
Gollum, golden, grasping grime,
Chasing rings that rust with time.
Kingdoms built on brittle lies,
Where the starlit skies blind your eyes.

[Chorus]
Oh, stardom is so dumb, my friend,
A shining start, a shallow end.
Where poets drown and posers thrive,
Hypocrisy keeps the dream alive.

[Verse 2]
Freedom fled from the stage so bright,
Introverts melt in the spotlight’s bite.
The “stardom posse” plays their game,
Fame’s a mask, but it’s always the same.
Seldom seekers, seldom seen,
Poetry fades in a cash machine.

[Bridge]
Random wisdom whispers slow:
“Let go the glow, it’s all for show.”
Kingdoms crumble, starlight dims,
Sodom’s streets are paved with sins.
Boredom blossoms in fame’s bouquet,
True art bows, walks away.

[Chorus]
Oh, stardom is so dumb, my friend,
A golden trap with no loose end.
Where humble hearts are bound to break,
The soul’s the first thing greed will take.

[Dub Breakdown - Spoken with psychedelic echo effects]
Seldom, freedom, kingdom, what’s left?
Stardom’s riddles, a gilded theft.
Gollum gripping golden rings,
Sodom sighs as the choir sings…

[Outro]
Random acts of truth will shine,
Beyond the hype, beyond the grime.
Poetry’s not a game of “who,”
It’s why you breathe, it’s what you do.

L-235.lyrics_summary: When words are banned, they become even more supreme. Whoop whoop #fuckonomics
L-235.lyrics_extract: Language is fluid, context is king, / Even the sharpest words can sing.
L-235.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
[Hypnotic intro, psychedelic loops with quirky “whoop whoops”]
Let’s break it down, no need to run,
A journey with words that pack a ton.

[Verse 1]
If you’re easily offended, turn away,
This ain’t a place for the faint to stay.
The word ‘fuck’, it’s got much to share,
A linguistic twist, let’s go if you dare.

It’s a noun, a verb, an exclamation too,
An adjective sharp, it cuts right through.
From casual chats to moments absurd,
It’s the Swiss army knife of the English word.

[Chorus]
Fuck is power, it’s a noun, verb, and more,
An all-purpose tool in the language drawer.
Motherfucker strikes with unbridled grace,
A word that adapts to any space.

[Verse 2]
Shit’s just poop; not so obscene,
Damn holds weight if the holy’s seen.
Bitch? A dog, loyal, sweet, and kind,
But “cunt” cuts deep, a word to grind.

Language is fluid, context is king,
Even the sharpest words can sing.
Intent transforms what the tongue displays,
Turning daggers to tools in countless ways.

[Chorus]
Fuck is power, it’s a noun, verb, and more,
An all-purpose tool in the language drawer.
Motherfucker strikes with unbridled grace,
A word that adapts to any space.

[Bridge]
It’s a brainfuck, mindfuck, total confusion,
Timefuck, moneyfuck, dream dissolution.
Clusterfuck chaos in storms untamed,
Yet the beauty of words? They’re never the same.

[Verse 3]
Fuckonomics, it’s a world of its own,
From love to war, it’s a tone well-known.
Fucknado spins in a linguistic spree,
A word so free, it defines “liberty.”

It’s crass, it’s bold, but it carries weight,
An emblem of how we communicate.
So love it or hate it, don’t misconstrue,
In the lexicon of life, it’s part of the crew.

[Outro]
Whoop whoop echoes, words shape our space,
In the hall of language, fuck finds its place.
A linguistic marvel, sharp and strong,
Forever part of our verbal song.
