L-240.lyrics_summary: A body of men accountable to nobody ought not to be trusted by anybody.' — Thomas Paine. Thank you, Mister Paine.
L-240.lyrics_extract: A body of men holdin’ no one to account, / Ought not to be trusted... throw ’em out by the ounce!
L-240.lyrics_text:
[VERSE]
I met a ghost in a three-cornered hat
Sippin’ tea with no sugar, talkin’ revolution chat
He said, “Power’s a beast when it hides in a suit,
If it answers to no one, it’s rotten to the root.”

And I said, “Hell yeah, I feel that too,
My rent goes up while my rights fall through
They got cameras in the sky, lies in the law
But they won’t look back when we raise our paw.”

[CHORUS]
A body of men holdin’ no one to account,
Ought not to be trusted... throw ’em out by the ounce!
Thank you, Mr. Paine, for sayin’ it plain,
With your fire and your pen and your radical brain.

Ooooh… You saw the storm before the rain…
Much love and rage to Thomas Paine.

[VERSE]
He said, “Kings wear robes but sleep like thieves,
With courts full of cronies and mouths full of grief.
But the people, my dear, must learn to discern,
Truth without trust will make the whole world burn.”

I laughed through my teeth, with tears in my throat
Said, “We got algorithms now that rig the vote.”
He said, “Same wine, new bottle, different kind of chain,
Call it progress, but it’s just renamed pain.”

[CHORUS]
A body of men holdin’ no one to account,
Ought not to be trusted... throw ’em out by the ounce!
Thank you, Mr. Paine, for your caring flame,
For your stubborn grace and your rebel name.

Oh… You drew the map through tyranny’s terrain…
Forever bold, dear Thomas Paine.

[BRIDGE]
He said:
“Accountability ain’t optional,
it’s the spine of liberty.”
And I thought, damn…
this man’s words got more grit
than all these faux-democracy committees.
He wrote by candlelight what we barely tweet by noon,
so I raise my voice, my pen, my spoon:
To feed the hungry truth,
to sing in tune with Paine’s refrain,
and knock on the conscience of the sane.

[FINAL CHORUS]
A body of men holdin’ no one to account,
Ought not to be trusted, not even an ounce!
Oh thank you, Thomas, for drawing the line,
With your fierce heart, and your guts divine.

Ooooh… You lit a match with your righteous brain…
I’ll keep it burning in your name…
Much love and fire to Thomas Paine.

L-242.lyrics_summary: The accordion of ignorance plays itself louder the more you pull it open.
L-242.lyrics_extract: So here we stand, in a baffled trance, / Dumbfounded by ignorance’s strange dance.
L-242.lyrics_text:
In the heart of the streets, where truths fall apart,
There’s an accordion tune, a discordant start.
Where reason is quieted, shadowed and dimmed,
And they dance to a beat that’s cruel and grim.

They sing of a man with words like a slap,
With a mouth full of lies and hands that grab.
Yet on and on, they cheer his charms,
Blind to the rage in the world’s open arms.

[Chorus]
Oh, the accordion plays, on loops it sways,
To the tyranny of ignorance, our tragic malaise.
It stutters and wheezes, no sense, no rhyme,
As justice falters, as truth runs out of time.

They tell tales of valor, of victories grand,
While rights are erased by his careless hand.
With a sneer for the weak, he tears apart,
All that we built with wisdom and heart.

And the tune, it shudders, sharp and vile,
A cacophony cloaked in a foolish smile.
They laugh as they stumble, entranced by his spin,
Never seeing the rot that festers within.

[Chorus]
Oh, the accordion plays, relentless and strong,
The rhythm of ignorance, blind and wrong.
A sad, twisted tune, syncopated lies,
Where justice fails, and truth slowly dies.

And the world, it watches, hands thrown in despair,
At a dance so absurd it’s beyond compare.
As double standards keep time to the beat,
A twisted march in the city’s street.

[Verse 3]
Where is the outrage, the furious cry?
In a land where dreams now go to die.
Innocence silenced, wisdom ignored,
And ignorance crowned, shamelessly adored.

Oh, they sing of freedom, they sing of might,
But dance in darkness, blinded by light.
To the cruel tune, they happily sway,
While dignity slips further away.

[Chorus]
Yes, the accordion plays, to tyranny’s call,
As ignorance rises and values fall.
In syncopated shame, we watch it unfold,
The tragic tune of hearts grown cold.

So here we stand, in a baffled trance,
Dumbfounded by ignorance’s strange dance.
As it winds and unwinds in a hopeless refrain,
The world laughs along, numbed by the pain.

With a wink to the cosmos, and a nod to the rain.

[Chorus]
Spin the atheist tango, dance with the stars,

In the cabaret cosmos, we’re all divine,
Singing the blues with a twist of the spine.

[Outro]

L-318.lyrics_summary: They (dare) call empathy weak. But(t) real compassion is the discipline of light. And it takes far more courage to care than to look away.
L-318.lyrics_extract: Who calls love “a weakness” / ’cause they’re naked under there?
L-318.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Please tell me, my dear,
who’s the fool in this affair?
The one leaning in closer
just to truly hear?

The one taking time
to decode someone’s pain?
Or the one throwing shade
’cause the truth bends their frame?

Who hides from the mirror,
dodging their own glare?
Who calls love “a weakness”
’cause they’re naked under there?

[Pre-Chorus]
There’s a chant on the timeline:
“Empathy is weak,” they speak,
like compassion’s some disaster
that’ll crack them in a week.

But if your own reflection
cuts too sharp to stare,
you call honesty a trap
and torch what you can’t repair.

[Chorus]
Real compassion isn’t frail,
it illuminates the night.
Not a failure, not a fairytale,
just the discipline of light.

It’s the strength to stay steady
when a story starts to tear;
no pretending, no performance,
just the quiet will to care.

[Verse 2]
Funny how the cynics swear
that tenderness is “bait,”
a ploy, a polished tactic,
some seductive sugar-gate.

But hearts afraid of contact
fear the feelings they can’t feel,
so they label trust “delusion”
’cause they doubt that love is real.

Ask them softly, Bananasutra:
“Is it truth you fear… or proof?”
Watch the armor split and shimmer
like an old forgotten youth.

[Pre-Chorus]
They say open hearts will “break you,”
curiosity will “fail,”
mindful listening is “naïve,”
warmth is “cheap and just for sale.”

But a lie screamed repeatedly
starts dressing up as “true,”
’til the echo chambers tremble
’cause they’ve drowned out something new.

[Chorus]
Real compassion has a spine
soft enough for fears to land;
it can bend, it can align,
it can gently guide a hand.

It’s a practice of attention
that rejects the slow despair,
the foundation of connection
in a world too numb to care.

[Bridge]
Step into another’s sky,
not to fix, not to sway,
just to widen your horizon
in a humble human way.

Peace grows out of trust,
and trust grows out of care;
and the bravest kind of mercy
is the mercy that stays there.

[Final Chorus]
Real compassion isn’t soft,
it’s an odyssey of heart.
It’s the bravery to feel
what could pull a world apart.

Call it foolish, call it foreign,
still the strongest force we share;
nothing’s more rebellious
than the courage to care.

[Outro]
Let them chant their tired slogans,
we don’t borrow secondhand fear.
Compassion isn’t weakness;
it’s the brightest way to hear.

It’s the method, it’s the mirror,
it’s the long, unbroken stare
of a world that heals itself
through the courage to care.

--

L-247.lyrics_summary: Even the mountains echo the sounds of war. Nobody listens.
L-247.lyrics_extract: And tears gushed out like stones from the wounds of the rock...
L-247.lyrics_text:
In a mountain pass, where the rocks for the winds are no checkers (no checkers),
Where no one has ever set foot, so steep is the rise (so steep is the rise),
There once lived a jubilant, cheerful mountain echo,
It answered all calls, and replied to the cries, human cries.

When loneliness suddenly fills our heart with despair (with despair),
And when a low sound of pain down the cliff starts to land (starts to land),
The echo, adroitly, will pick up the call,And handling with care,
Will lift it, and louder, with tenderness take it in hand.

But some scoundrels, madmen and drunkards, got round (got round),
So that no one might hear the footfall and snort (footfall and snort),
Intending to silence and murder the gorge, living canyon
They bound up the echo, and stopped up its mouth ere they shot.

And so it went on, their bloody, ferocious, enraged merrymaking
No sound could be heard as they trampled the echo, made fun of it, mocked...
They shot, in the morning, the quieted mountain echo (mountain echo)
And tears gushed out like stones from the wounds of the rock...

And tears gushed out like stones from the wounds of the rock...
And tears gushed out like stones from the wounds of the rock...

🗿💦

L-392.lyrics_summary: A perfect song, a friend said. Vladimir Vysotsky's mountain echo — translated, reimagined, still howling truth in Russian.
L-392.lyrics_text:
В тиши перевала, где скалы ветрам не помеха. Помеха
На кручах таких, на какие никто не проник. Никто не проник
Жило-поживало весёлое горное, горное эхо
Оно отзывалось на крик — человеческий крик

Когда одиночество комом подкатит под горло. Под горло
И сдавленный стон еле слышно в обрыв упадёт. В обрыв упадёт
Крик этот о помощи эхо подхватит, подхватит проворно
Усилит и бережно в руки своих донесёт

Должно быть, не люди, напившись дурмана и зелья. И зелья
Чтоб не был услышан никем громкий топот и храп. Топот и храп
Пришли умертвить, обеззвучить живое, живое ущелье
И эхо связали, и в рот ему всунули кляп

Всю ночь продолжалась кровавая злая потеха. Потеха
И эхо топтали, но звука никто не слыхал. Никто не слыхал
К утру расстреляли притихшее горное, горное эхо
И брызнули слёзы, как камни из раненных скал

И брызнули слёзы, как камни из раненных скал
И брызнули слёзы, как камни из раненных скал

L-248.lyrics_summary: I'm the question in your laughter. The hope that lets the light through.
L-248.lyrics_extract: I’m the jester in the corner, a shadow on the wall, / You think I’m here for giggles, but I’m here to watch you fall.
L-248.lyrics_text:
V1: 
[Verse 1]
I’m the question in your laughter, a riddle in the rain,
The crack that lets the light shine through, the balm that soothes your pain.
Not here to pull you under, just here to pull you near,
For every step we stumble is a step that brings us clear.

[Chorus]
Oh, the fool who knows, the fool who dreams,
Dancing through life’s tangled seams.
I twist the mirror, I lift the veil,
Turning lost roads into a trail.

[Verse 2]
I’m the spark inside the shadows, the laugh before the dawn,
The jester’s tune that hums along when all your hope feels gone.
A truth not meant to mock you, a joke to ease the climb,
For wisdom born of kindness always stands the test of time.

[Chorus]
Oh, the fool who knows, the fool who dreams,
Dancing through life’s tangled seams.
I twist the mirror, I lift the veil,
Turning lost roads into a trail.

[Bridge]
Every tumble has its grace,
Every wound will leave a trace.
But in the fall, there’s love to find,
A hand to hold, a heart aligned.

[Outro]
So laugh with me, let’s laugh at fear,
Together we’ll draw wisdom near.
For through the cracks, the journey shows,
The path is lit by the fool who knows.

--
V2: 

[Verse 1]
I’m the jester in the corner, a shadow on the wall,
You think I’m here for giggles, but I’m here to watch you fall.
A slip of wit, a trick of tongue, I turn your lies to dust,
For truth will out in laughter, in the fool, you place your trust.

[Chorus]
Oh, the fool who knows, the fool who sees,
Dancing through your certainties.
I crack the mirror, I bend the light,
Revealing truth in the dead of night.

[Verse 2]
I’m the whisper in your laughter, the ache behind your smile,
A joke that cuts too deeply, yet lingers for a while.
Your ego’s robes unravel; your crown begins to rust,
For it’s not the king who’ll save you, it’s the fool you learn to trust.

[Chorus]
Oh, the fool who knows, the fool who sees,
Dancing through your certainties.
I crack the mirror, I bend the light,
Revealing truth in the dead of night.

[Bridge]
Spin your stories, weave your charms,
I’ll slip through like a thief of harms.
In my folly, there’s design,
A crooked path to the divine.

[Outro]
Laugh at me, I’ll laugh with you,
Together we’ll untangle what’s true.
For wisdom hides in twisted prose,
And you’ll find it with the fool who knows.Verse 1

L-249.lyrics_summary: The bullet grazed the duck. The duck, alas, survived.
L-249.lyrics_extract:
We sing of luck, but paths seem mucked,
Bullets miss, and all we see is red.
L-249.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Duck made of quacks, not fair, not bright,
Bullet grazed by, fool’s daylight,
Aimed at that duck, feathers instead,
Wish I could change it, duck barely bled.

[Chorus]
Luck of the duck, oh, luck of that duck,
Bullet went astray, and we’re outta luck,
Should’ve been a song, hearts in sync,
But dreams got lost, fists can’t think.

[Verse 2]
Red masks dance, fights in praise,
Crowds in chaos, lost in a haze,
Shot to shift, to change the tide,
Grazed duck’s luck, raised on pride.

[Chorus]
Luck of the duck, oh, luck of that duck,
Bullet went astray, and we’re outta luck,
Should’ve been a song, hearts in sync,
But dreams got lost, fists can’t think.

[Bridge]
Shoot me now, for dreams we bled,
Songs unsung, tears we’ve shed,
Bullets miss, ducks survive,
How do we hope, keep love alive?

[Chorus]
Luck of the duck, oh, luck of that duck,
Bullet went astray, and we’re outta luck,
Should’ve been a song, hearts in sync,
But dreams got lost, fists can’t think.

[Outro]
Flick a duck, fate’s wild twist,
In this world, where dreams persist,
We sing of luck, but paths seem mucked,
Bullets miss, and all we see is red.

L-250.lyrics_summary: The emperor has no clothes. But(t) he's selling crowns. And it's like no one knows shit about f*ck (like Socrates said).
L-250.lyrics_extract: Wearing nothing but bling-bling, / Oh, if only I was joking.
L-250.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1 — The Great Crown]
Some tricksters wandered into town,
Selling fake emperor’s crowns,
Smiling wide with empty hands,
Mumbling words none understands.

They whispered low, “the wise ones see,”
“What’s hidden here in mystery,”
As white hillbillies praised the air,
Swore up and down they saw it there.

[Verse 2 — The Great Goons]
A buffoon tweets from a gilded throne,
While loyal goons praise what ain’t shown,
They bow and swear, “Oh, it’s divine!”
Then clap along in crooked time.

Echoes ring through hollow halls,
Truth gets lost beneath applause,
Every doubt gets dipped in gold,
Every lie gone wild and old.

[Chorus — Blessed Be Fools]
Oh let us laugh at what we see,
The Great Naked King in pageantry,
Wearing nothing but bling-bling,
Oh, if only I was joking.

Oh let us laugh and let it ring,
At paper crowns and cha-ching,
The grandest show of empty things,
All hail the king of nothing.

[Verse 3 — Hello Charlie Chaplin]
’Til one small voice broke through the swing,
Soft and kind like Chaplin would sing,
“This dicktator is a cheat,”
And tender hearts skipped a beat.

A whisper cut through all the noise,
Simple truth with humble poise,
And for a breath the spell grew thin,
Like light was finally let in.

[Bridge — Say no to Complicity]
What a vast hallucination,
Built on fear and fabrication,
Pure race, pure flag, pure vanity,
A costume stitched in complicity.

Pomposity in rigid seams,
An empire built on shattered dreams,
Promises broken, dragged along,
By silent crowds that make it strong.

[Chorus — Blessed Be Fools]
Oh let us laugh at what we see,
The Great Naked King in pageantry,
Wearing nothing but bling-bling,
Oh, if only I was joking.

Oh let us laugh and let it ring,
At paper crowns and cha-ching,
The grandest show of empty things,
All hail the king of nothing.

[Outro — The Fool Worth Being]
It’s a foolish thing, absurd to see,
But(t) why play along with stupidity?
Let’s laugh out loud and break the ring,
And be the fool worth being.

L-251.lyrics_summary: The invisible man in the sky: a character study.
L-251.lyrics_extract: It’s bananas, the world’s insane, / They sell glory, deliver pain.
L-251.lyrics_text:
They say there’s someone up above,  
An invisible man who means but(t) love,  
Judges your life, and keeps a score…  
Don’t cross his line, you’ll burn for sure.

He’s got a list, oh, don’t you know?  
The things he hates, the sins that blow…  
If you don’t obey, you’ll fry and scream,  
But he loves you, huh, so it seems.

(Chorus)  
Invisible man in the sky,  
Wants your money, makes you cry.  
He loves you, oh, it’s true,  
But he needs all your treasures too.

Confess your sins, just let them pour,  
Every dirty story, he needs more.  
He’s always watching, every day,  
And judgment’s coming, so they say.

He’s got a plan, it’s built on fear,  
And he demands you stay sincere.  
But if you’re wise, he won’t agree,  
’Cause money’s what he needs, you see.

(Chorus)  
Invisible man in the sky,  
Wants your money, makes you cry.  
He loves you, oh, it’s true,  
But he’ll burn you if you’re through.

It’s bananas, the world’s insane,  
They sell glory, deliver pain.  
They preach fake rules, dicks of prey,  
The invisible man’s here to stay.

Invisible man in the sky,  
Wants your money, makes you cry.  
He loves you, oh, it’s true,  
But he’ll burn you if you’re through.  
Invisible man… invisible man…  
In the sky… in the sky…

Title: Invisible Man in the Sky
Style, Genre, and Type: Blues, soulful rhythm, lyrical satire
Song description: A satirical take on the paradoxes of certain religious ideologies, exploring the idea of an all-knowing figure who controls yet claims love.

Lyrics:

[Intro]
Oh, they say there’s a man, invisible and high,
He’s watchin’ every move, got his eyes on the sky.
With a list of demands, and a fiery fate,
They call it love, but it’s a heavy weight.

[Verse 1]
They say he’s up there, lookin’ down on me,
Judgin’ every moment, every thought I set free.
If I step out of line, I’ll be burnin’ for days,
But they call it salvation, wrapped in mysterious ways.

[Chorus]
Oh, invisible man in the sky,
They claim you love, but I wonder why.
You need my money, and sins confessed,
To save my soul, but leave me stressed.

[Verse 2]
The wise can’t hold riches, so they beg for my gold,
They tell me it’s his plan, the greatest story told.
He loves me so much, but there’s fire below,
For every misstep, for every “no.”

[Chorus]
Oh, invisible man in the sky,
They claim you love, but I wonder why.
You need my money, and sins confessed,
To save my soul, but leave me stressed.

[Bridge]
Oh, the tale keeps spinnin’, it’s all so strange,
This love feels like control, a celestial exchange.
Bananas, they say, is the way of the world,
But the weight of your love leaves my mind unfurled.

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse 3]
I’m searchin’ for answers, I’m tryin’ to see,
If the man in the sky really cares for me.
Or is it just a story to keep me in line,
While the preachers all prosper and I’m wastin’ my time?

[Chorus]
Oh, invisible man in the sky,
They claim you love, but I wonder why.
You need my money, and sins confessed,
To save my soul, but leave me stressed.

[Outro]
Oh, invisible man, keep watchin’ me,
I’ll keep my coins, I’ll keep my plea.
Your fire can burn, your love can fly,
But I’ll find my own truth beneath the sky.

—

L-252.lyrics_summary: Love rising above bloody ashes. The dove's stubbornest trick.
L-252.lyrics_extract: If truth is right, then we shall see / No holy blame can set us free.
L-252.lyrics_text:
[intro]
Soaring above bloody ashes,
Rising like love’s the only breath
That blooms like hope
Not doom in trope…

[verse 1]
Sparks of snark never heal, they only burn,
Barks of sharks never help, they only churn,
At the love
Of a dove.

[verse 2]
Preachers of vengeance dressed in light,
Call it justice, call it right,
But no bomb can bless a child,
In the womb of hate gone wild.

[chorus]
Raise your heart to peace, not war,
Blessed be the faith we’re fighting for,
Let mercy rise to bliss, let it prove
We dare to care for the love of a dove…

[bridge]
Why praise the wound, deny the tear?
Preaching for safe, by planting fear?
If truth is right, then we shall see
No holy blame can set us free.

[chorus, soaring]
Raise your heart to peace, not war,
Blessed be the faith we’re fighting for,
Let mercy rise to bliss, let it prove
We dare to care for the love of a dove.

[outro, gentle]
Let’s lay the anger in the dust.
Let’s be holy, return to trust...
And when they ask what we’re made of
Hum: “The love, the love of a dove.”

L-253.lyrics_summary: Pull up a chair — the ego is performing. Again.
L-253.lyrics_extract: Thinking they deserve the best, / Leaving you to handle the rest.
L-253.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1: Grandiose Delusions]
Oh, they walk into the room with a grandiose strut,
Taking all the credit while the team is in a rut.
Bragging in emails, meetings, too,
Their self-importance shines through!

[Chorus]
Welcome to the Narcissist’s Cabaret,
Where ego’s large and empathy’s away.
Watch and learn, oh corporate crew,
Here’s what these traits will do to you!

[Verse 2: Fantasies Unlimited]
Obsessed with dreams of power and fame,
They talk of success, but it’s all just a game.
Ignoring limits, reality’s out of sight,
In their mind, everything’s alright!

[Chorus]
Welcome to the Narcissist’s Cabaret,
Where ego’s large and empathy’s away.
Watch and learn, oh corporate crew,
Here’s what these traits will do to you!

[Verse 3: Special and Unique]
They believe they’re special, a one-of-a-kind,
Only mingling with the elite they find.
Ignoring the rest, up high they stand,
In their own exclusive land.

[Chorus]
Welcome to the Narcissist’s Cabaret,
Where ego’s large and empathy’s away.
Watch and learn, oh corporate crew,
Here’s what these traits will do to you!

[Verse 4: Admiration Craver]
Needing praise like air to breathe,
Without it, they pout and seethe.
Seeking validation night and day,
Oh, what a price they make us pay!

[Chorus]
Welcome to the Narcissist’s Cabaret,
Where ego’s large and empathy’s away.
Watch and learn, oh corporate crew,
Here’s what these traits will do to you!

[Verse 5: Entitlement Galore]
Expecting favors, responses quick,
Disregarding your time, it’s their favorite trick.
Thinking they deserve the best,
Leaving you to handle the rest.

[Chorus]
Welcome to the Narcissist’s Cabaret,
Where ego’s large and empathy’s away.
Watch and learn, oh corporate crew,
Here’s what these traits will do to you!

[Verse 6: Exploitation Expert]
Using others for their personal gain,
Assigning tasks with little shame.
Their agenda first, company’s last,
Your hard work’s just a blast!

[Chorus]
Welcome to the Narcissist’s Cabaret,
Where ego’s large and empathy’s away.
Watch and learn, oh corporate crew,
Here’s what these traits will do to you!

[Verse 7: Empathy Absent]
No time for feelings, no room for needs,
Performance is all that their heart feeds.
Personal struggles pushed aside,
Compassion takes a wild ride.

[Chorus]
Welcome to the Narcissist’s Cabaret,
Where ego’s large and empathy’s away.
Watch and learn, oh corporate crew,
Here’s what these traits will do to you!

[Verse 8: Envy and Arrogance]
Envying others or feeling envied,
Negativity’s the seed they’ve sown.
Dismissing ideas, a haughty glare,
Arrogance fills the corporate air.

[Chorus]
Welcome to the Narcissist’s Cabaret,
Where ego’s large and empathy’s away.
Watch and learn, oh corporate crew,
Here’s what these traits will do to you!

[Finale]
So, dear leaders, heed this song,
Check these traits, don’t play along.
Empathy, humility, lead the way,
And let kindness save the day!

Welcome to the Narcissist’s Cabaret,
But let’s hope you won’t stay!

L-254.lyrics_summary: The poem they couldn't ban because it was already inside you.
L-254.lyrics_extract: To find ‘em facts left unspoken, / To share ‘em truths in the open.
L-254.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Silence cuts like a fascist blade,
Carving fates they want to fade.
Signing bills, chaining laws,
’Til all our hope withdraws.

[Chorus]
I thought I wanted to be a poet,
But really...
I wanted to be a poem.
To find ‘em facts left unspoken,
To share ‘em truths in the open

[Verse 2]
Felon whispers, history hums,
Freedoms erased by petty chums.
Data drowned, but echoes rise,
remember what darkened skies.

[Chorus]
I thought I wanted to be a poet,
But really...
I wanted to be a poem.
Not a hand that holds the paper,
But a fire in the loam.

[Bridge]
Wounds that burn beneath our skin,
Elect outlaws, spreading deep sin.
Books were burned, but poems remain,
Time does forget—but arts do sustain.

[Chorus (Extended)]
I thought I wanted to be a poet,
But really...
I wanted to be the poem.
Not to beg meaning be spoken,
But to breathe in a true omen.

[Outro]
In the name of freedom,
We sing our right to roam.
Spread ‘em sparks, start a revolution,
For we, the people, are a poem

--
V2:
(A Psychedelic Minimal Experimental Tribal Trip-Hop Song)

[Verse 1]
Silence sharp as a fascist plight,
Etching fates into the night.
Signing bill, passing laws,
Until all the hope blows 

[Chorus]
I thought I wanted to be a poet,
But basically...
I wanted to be a poem.
To share the bullshit unspoken,
To grow where silence roams.

[Verse 2]
Felon whispers, history hums,
Truth dissolved by petty chums.
Data’s lost but echoes last,
With the lore of ages past.

[Chorus]
I thought I wanted to be a poet,
But basically...
I wanted to be the poem.
Not a hand that holds a paper,
But a fire in our bones.

[Bridge]
Woes pulsing deep in our veins,
Words of grief, breaking the chains.
Bodies were lost, but poems remains,
As time forgets, and art sustains.

[Chorus (Extended)]
I thought I wanted to be a poet,
But basically...
I wanted to be the poem.
Not to be begging meaning,
But the meaning on its own.

[Outro (Spoken, fading into echoes)]
In the name of freedom,
Singing for rights, free to roam,
Sharing our light, an anthem,
For we, the people, are a poem.

—
V3

[Verse 1]
Under the weight of a word unsaid
A name erased but never dead
Silence carves the lines we read
Between the bones, between the creed

[Pre-Chorus]
Light the candle, hush the tongue
Breathe in secrets, bite the sun
No one hears but ink remembers
Every life pressed into embers

[Chorus]
I thought I wanted to be a poet
But basically, I wanted to be the poem
Not the hand, not the voice
Not the echo, just the omen

[Verse 2]
Some men burn while others fade
Some words break, some ricochet

But still, his blood is writing sparks

A whisper left in open air
A shadow shaped, a breath laid bare
No name remains, but still, it’s known—
I am the poem.

L-402.lyrics_title: The Sound of A Wondering Mind
L-402.lyrics_summary: What's the sound of a wondering mind? A beat, a breath, a space to unwind. No preacher, no savior — just a seeker.
L-402.lyrics_extract: I’m no preacher, no savior, no star / Just a seeker asking who we are
L-402.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
What’s the sound of a wondering mind
A beat, a breath, a space to unwind
Loops that swirl, puns that play
Who’s to say where thoughts will stray

[Verse 1]
I’m a seeker, a ponderer, a soulful stray
Singing the questions, the puns on display
Words are beats, they twist, they turn
Life’s a song where we all can learn

[Chorus]
Hear the drums, they’re calling you in
A syncopated rhythm beneath your skin
Hum your truth, let it softly glow
In this lo-fi world where melodies flow

[Verse 2]
Raised by silence, taught by sound
Philosophy in loops that rebound
I’m no preacher, no savior, no star
Just a seeker asking who we are

[Bridge]
Feel the hum of the hypnotic refrain
Bluesy whispers in a tribal chain
Each note a step on a rhythmic climb
Tracing the edge of space and time

[Chorus]
Hear the drums, they’re calling you in
A syncopated rhythm beneath your skin
Hum your truth, let it softly glow
In this lo-fi world where melodies flow

[Outro]
So let the melody guide your soul
Psychedelic blues making us whole
A loop, a rhyme, a silly refrain
Soothe the world with a tribal chain

L-380.lyrics_summary: Acoustic or algorithmic? Human or harmonic? Is it chaos or logic? Bananasutra speaks...
L-380.lyrics_extract: Click-click, quick, slick. / Linguistic trick. I'm a geek, I'm a freak.
L-380.lyrics_text:
[Intro] 
Is it acoustic… or algorithmic? 
Am I human… or harmonic? 
Is it chaos… or is it logic? 
(pause) Bananasutra… speak.

[Verse 1] 
I peek through the bleak, oblique mystique of the cosmic critique, 
Where schematic anatomic meet the beat that I speak, 
It's a sonic, symbolic, symbiotic streak, 
From atomic to mythic, every logic got a leak…

Wait… Is it random or programmatic? 
Empathetic pattern dancing in mathematic rhythmic, 
I'm emphatic through the static, hear the sound of the didactic, 
Every variable accountable, no ego in organic.

See, math made me curious, rigorous, not dogmatic, 
No dramatic semantic panic, just the idiosyncratic, 
While philosophy whisperin', "justice ain't rhetoric," 
Turnin' questions to answers… I'm Socratic!

I like to think… the sound of logic, 
Dualistic, but holistic, Hyperbolic, yet harmonic, 
From periodic semantic to chaotic thematic, 
I find meaning in the rhythm that the universe kicks.

[Pre-Chorus] 
Is it tragicomic… or just ironic? 
When the formula for feeling won't click… 
Do you hear it when the silence starts to leak? 
That's the sound… when the logic starts to seek.

[Chorus] 
This is the sound of logic, melodic critique, 
Bananasutra got it, philosophic, supersonic, 
From the schematic to didactic, I write lyrics, 
Human music for a world gone robotic…

This the sound of logic, cryptic but(t) harmonic, 
Mathematic in the static, so iconic, 
If you feel it, then you know it ain't just music, 
It's the meaning of chaos turned symphonic.

[Verse 2] 
Click-click, quick, slick. 
Linguistic trick. I'm a geek, I'm a freak, 
Hear my diagnostic, hypnotic, psychologic kick, 
While demagogic rhetoric makes the people sick.

Eek! It's catastrophic, goddamn bombastic, 
When idiotic polemic get sold as sleek… 
But I use mathematic, trust in analytics, 
And my philosophy's agnostic, feeds on altruistic.

Ooh… Look! A fanatical detector, cathartic, 
Eclectic and electric, empathetic connectors, fantastic, 
From the geopolitical to technologic, no gimmicks, 
I connect every dot on the clock, every crack in the map, it's pragmatic.

Sneak-peek through they bleak semantics, 
Breakin' the archaic matrix, watch the demagogic tactics, 
It's rhapsodic, symphonic, philanthropic trick, 
But music ain't entropic, it's holistic, make the algorithm humanistic…

[Bridge] 
Music ain't a laconic gimmick… It's a heartbeat, prolific… 
A sequence, symbiotic… A reason to believe in magic…
Math is the logic… Philosophy diagnostic… 
And music? Music transcends the static…

[Verse 3] 
I'm melancholic, but optimistic, 
Even when the system feels demonic, 
I find harmonic shelter in the cryptic, 
Where the logic and the love stay symbiotic.

Bananasutra in the zone… 
Feel the music… 
Erotic, Therapeutic, Iconic.

So I ask… If it's all just entropic static, 
Why the rhythm so simplistic? 
Why the beauty so mimetic? 
Why the meaning feels laconic?

[Final Chorus] 
This is the sound of logic, 
Melodic, supersonic, 
Bananasutra got it, 
Schematic of ecstatic 
In a world gone robotic…

This the sound of logic, 
Tragicomic, hypnotic, 
From atomic to harmonic, 
It's just so therapeutic!

[Outro] 
Oh the acoustics… algorithmic… 
Chaotic… symphonic… 
Human… harmonic… 
[soft pause] The sound of… logic.

L-257.lyrics_summary: Ignorance isn't bliss. It's a tyrant in a loud hat.
L-257.lyrics_extract: They preach of power, of winning the race, / But is it victory or a hollow disgrace?
L-257.lyrics_text:
They say the loudest wins the crowd,
With hollow words and faces proud,
Where lies dance like marionettes,
While truth’s forgotten, lost in debts.

Promises slip like sand through a sieve,
They teach us to take, forget how to give.
Greed in the throne, with a smile of stone,
And virtue’s left wandering, out on her own.

[Chorus]
It’s the tyranny of ignorance, ruling with charm,
Blindfolds and sirens that sound the alarm.
In a world that’s lost its way, truth gets silenced,
The echoes of wisdom drowned out by violence.

They preach of power, of winning the race,
But is it victory or a hollow disgrace?
Deception wears the crown, parades as the prize,
While empathy fades under jaded skies.

Education abandoned, critical thought left behind,
Empty slogans are the currency of the blind.
For those who see, it’s a mournful sight,
Watching darkness dress itself as light.

[Chorus]
It’s the tyranny of ignorance, dressed to impress,
Pulling the strings in a tangle of mess.
Where the wise grow weary and the brave hold tight,
Clinging to truth in the gathering night.

But there’s a spark, a whisper, a call to be bold,
To dig for wisdom, to seek what’s untold.
A heart that questions, a mind that sees,
Can cut through the lies, can break the disease.

In the shadows they hide, those who still know,
That the power of kindness is what makes us grow.
They’re quiet but fierce, with eyes that are clear,
And their ripple is stronger than what we fear.

It’s the end of the tyranny, it crumbles to dust,
When wisdom and courage reclaim their trust.
For all who remember what’s truly right,
The dawn breaks softly, restoring the light.

L-317.lyrics_summary: Umm... a pause, a breath, a bridge from thought to word. In the humble umm, a glimpse of the whole mind. This one is for Bryan Dobson.
L-317.lyrics_extract: ‘Um’... a pause, a breath, a quiet space, / Where minds dance and thoughts embrace.
L-317.lyrics_text:
In moments of thought, where words are sought,
Lies a simple sound, where truths are caught.
‘Um’... a pause, a breath, a quiet space,
Where minds dance and thoughts embrace.

It’s not just a sound, but a silent plea,
For time, for clarity, for the mind to be free.
In the ‘um’, we find a world unseen,
A moment’s break, where we can lean.

In every ‘um’, a story untold,
Of hesitations, reflections, ideas bold.
It’s a bridge from thought to spoken word,
A journey taken, seldom heard.

So here’s to ‘um’, a simple refrain,
In the symphony of dialogue, it’s not in vain.
For in these pauses, our truths we find,
In the humble ‘um’, a glimpse of the mind.

L-393.lyrics_summary: Bertrand Russell made a list of what makes us unhappy. This tango dances through every item: fatigue, envy, guilt, persecution mania, and the fear of public opinion.
L-393.lyrics_extract: Fatigue, oh fatigue, it’s weighing you down, / Envy’s a monster wearing a frown.
L-393.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Gather 'round, dear friends, and lend me your ear,
We’ve got a list that’ll make things clear,
Straight from Russell's pen, a philosopher’s plan,
In "The Conquest of Happiness," he told every man,

Why the world feels weary, why joy’s often gone,
But stay tuned, dear listener, for the happy song!

[Verse 1]
Oh, the world’s so dreary when you’re chasing the gold,
Eyes on the prize, but the heart’s feeling cold,
Compete and compare, oh, it’s never enough,
You’re lost in the hustle, stuck in the bluff.

[Chorus]
Boredom or excitement, you swing to extremes,
Forget all the peace, lost in wild schemes,
Fatigue, oh fatigue, it’s weighing you down,
Envy’s a monster wearing a frown.

[Bridge]
Guilt on your shoulder, shame in your step,
Living in fear of opinions they’ve kept,
Paranoia’s a friend you never should trust,
A life full of worry is bound to combust!

[Chorus]
Boredom or excitement, you swing to extremes,
Forget all the peace, lost in wild schemes,
Fatigue, oh fatigue, it’s weighing you down,
Envy’s a monster wearing a frown.

[Outro]
But this isn’t the end, there’s more to the tale,
We’ll find the joy, we’ll lift up the veil,
Russell knew well, there's more to this dance,
Catch the next tune, and give joy a chance!

Not a stumble, no, believe,

L-259.lyrics_summary: The most honest prayer you'll ever say isn't in a church.
L-259.lyrics_extract: It’s the song in the air, / It’s the love that we dare.
L-259.lyrics_text:
V1:
[Verse 1]
Not who powers the light,
Not who’s winning the fight,
It’s the song in the air,
It’s the love that we dare.

Not the word, not the creed,
It’s the reason we bleed,
Not in how we pray,
But the fire that will stay.

[Chorus]
There’s no prayer like desire,
It’s the breath in the fire,
Not the book that we read,
But the hunger we feed.

[Verse 2]
Not the look, not the words,
Not the sacred, absurd,
Truth is how we move,
In the heart, in the groove.

Not the script we repeat,
It’s the pulse in the beat,
Not in what we say,
It’s the heat that will stay.

[Chorus]
There’s no prayer like desire,
It’s the breath in the fire,
Not the book that we read,
But the hunger we feed.

[Verse 3]
Not the tale that we share,
But the nerve to stand bare,
It’s the beat in the soul,
It’s the why we let go.

Truth lives under the cry,
In the tears that won’t lie,
Not what we believe,
But what we receive.

[Bridge]
Not in lips, not in lies,
It’s the truth that survives,
In the heart, in the fire,
In the core of desire.

[Final Chorus]
There’s no truth like desire,
It’s the rhythm, the wire,

L-262.lyrics_title: They Call It Freedom (Oh Hi, Sweet Honey Bun)
L-262.lyrics_summary: Oh hi, sweet honey bun. They call it freedom. It looks more like steel boots stomping truth again.
L-262.lyrics_extract: Who says “liberty” loading a gun / Calling it peace once the purge is done.
L-262.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Oh hi, sweet honey bun
See us coming undone?
Please, let’s sing together,
Let’s think louder, higher!

[Verse 1]
Why trust it’s truth, when it’s a dumb trap
Why add your name on a poisoned map
Why wrap people in gilded wrong
Why say fair questions don’t belong

[Pre-Chorus]
They whisper “grace” with a hissing smile
Redefine “dissent” as thinking awhile
And build more prisons, like caring is vile

[Chorus]
Why call it freedom? Bias ain’t true tongue
Please question logic, or lives shall come undone
Know “restoring order” ain’t like holy rain
When it’s like steel boots stomping truth again

[Verse 2]
Learn what’s legit, why they closed a gate
Say “biological” and decree more hate
How ruling our wombs’ increases gloom
How they preach pro life, while filling more tombs

[Pre-Chorus]
They claim it’s science, but it’s scripture they shout
Wrapped in cheap flags, it’s logic they ripped out

[Chorus]
They call it freedom, while FOTUS builds cages they burn your page
Know what’s a villain, who’s burning the page
Who Says “liberty” loading a gun
Calling it peace once the purge is done

[Bridge]
Watch out for double speak, let them hear us cry
We simply ask for truth, why do they sell us lie?
Why let dumb decrees defile sacred truths like a meme
Use your brain, your heart, question men with no shame

[Final Chorus]
They call it freedom, with a serious tone
Like syrup on razors, like velvet on stone
They call it healing while poisoning us, hon
Beware of white gospel, hum, or we’ll all come undone

[Outro]
Let’s shine so bright
We’ll feel god’s light,
reKindle our holy spark?
Please, let’s Come out of the dark!

Sing all that is fair and good
So we may all have some food,
Blessed be the bold, the brave,
Please, feel free to leave that cave!

L-396.lyrics_summary: This ain't fiction. It's dystopian truth broadcast in booths. Let's read the constitution and imagine the revolution.
L-396.lyrics_extract: Let’s read the constitution / Imagine the revolution.
L-396.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
This ain't fiction, it's dystopian truth  
Mad felon tales, broadcast in booths  
When we can’t agree that lies are wrong  
Pimped out prophets still write the songs  

[Verse 1]
No constitution, just twisted plays  
What’s your flavor, whacks or strays  
A felon king, that fallacy  
Technocratic absurdity  

[Chorus]
But it's not too late  
Breathe, don’t break  
Let’s read the constitution  
Imagine the revolution  

It’s not too late  
Dare, don’t fake  
Let’s feel the intuition  
Start our own evolution  

[Verse 2]
Apes gone wild, we lost the plot  
Fotus luck, or just dry rot  
Enough of the fools and empty fame  
People matter, not just names  

[Bridge]
Please, let me be presumptuous  
We’re all divine, scrumptious  
Beneath the glitz and profit buzz  
Real truth shines, because...

[Chorus]
It’s not too late  
Breathe, don’t break  
Let’s read the constitution  
Imagine the revolution  

It’s not too late  
Dare, don’t fake  
Let’s feel the intuition  
Start our own evolution  

[Verse 3]
Assume you care, assume you see  
Like brothers born from empathy  
We’re made of magic, grit, and grace  
Unique souls, a human place  

[Bridge]
Time to learn compassion’s fire  
Time to burn off all the liars  
Time to rise, reframe the tale  
Time to breathe, reset the scale  

[Final Chorus]
It’s not too late  
Breathe, don’t wait  
Let’s love in restitution  
Call the heart a revolution  

It’s not too late  
Dream, create  
Let’s sing this intuition  
Feel the real solution  

[Outros]
Let’s bloom brighter than the gloom  
And boom louder than the doom  
Dare to care  
We’re almost there

L-263.lyrics_summary: Born with a fire that silence could not tame. This is the quest.
L-263.lyrics_extract: This is my quest, this is my flame / Chasing a light without a name.
L-263.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
I was born with a fire
A wandering tiger
That silence could not tame
Like a star with no name

[Verse 1]
To burn with desire no night can disguise
To shine where dark egos howl through the skies
To carry the ache that hope always brings
And still learn to fly on fragile wings

To dream till the light of the heart overflows
To love even knowing how deep sorrow grows
To stand with no armor, no shield, no disguise
Just faith in a star that lives in my eyes

[Chorus]
This is my quest, this is my flame
Chasing a light without a name
Through every wound and all the scars
I’ll keep singing to the stars

And when the night falls over me
And doubt becomes the only sea
I’ll carry on past them souls that shade
Through dreams that darken yet never fade

[Verse 2]
No, I don’t know why all roads must bend
Nor when our journeys one day will end
But every step through spite and rain
Turns sincere longing into flame

This is my life, to live, to soar
No matter the loss, no matter the war
Because somewhere the truth still burns
And the world remembers why it yearns

[Bridge]
If I fall, let it be reaching
If I break, let it be loving
If I fade into the dark
I bet dogs, somewhere, will bark

[Final Chorus]
This is my quest, this is my flame
Chasing a light without a name
Through every wound and all the scars
I’ll keep singing to the stars

And maybe the world will finally see
How bright a single heart can be
When all it owns, when all it gives
Is the stubborn dream it lives

[Outro]
To dare
To care
To wander far

Always singing
Look how the stars are glowing…

L-378.lyrics_summary: This is not a banana. It's a Magritte dare. You trusted it anyway. That's the joke.
L-378.lyrics_extract: It’s a punchline in disguise, / But(t) you trusted your eyes.
L-378.lyrics_text:
V1: (Wittgenstein EDIT)
[Verse 1]
This is not a banana.
No really, don’t stare,
Or do it with care…
It’s a dare. Oh la la.

It’s a joke in a song.
It’s a gun gone oops, wrong.
It’s a punchline in disguise,
But(t) you trusted your eyes.

[Chorus]
This is not a banana.
It’s a mirror, tra-la-la.
It bends like shadows.
It burns when it blows.

Don’t ask what who how,
ask why it’s here now.
See words aren’t truth,
they’re tools of buzz.

[Verse 2]
Ceci n’est pas une banane.
Nope. But(t) slippery, man.
It’s a rabbit. It’s a duck.
It’s a smirk whose jokes just suck.

What you see’s not the thing.
It’s a trick, it’s all bling.
Same fruit, different frame,
It’s a puerile game…

[Verse 3]
No you’re not crazy, 
Please trust me baby,
it’s just a weird game,
And quite inhumane…

What’s a duck-rabbit 
got to do with it?
Well well well, peel me,
Oh oui, oui, pinch me!

[Bridge]
This is not a banana.
But it could be justice,
It could mean true peace.
This is not a banana…

[Verse 4]
Ducks gotta quack, 
Yucks gonna whack,
and rabbits hump,
Banana dump.

It drives me irrate,
They call lies “debate”,
Redefine freedom,
Gaslighters’ Soddom.

[Chorus - final]
This is not a banana.
It’s a question, joke, booya.
It’s a trap trapped, so dire,
wrapped in smoke and fire.

Don’t ask what, who, how,
ask why it’s here now.
This is not a banana.
It’s a mirror, tra-la-la.

[Outro]
This is not a banana.
It’s a frame, not some fruit,
Wittgenstein in a suit.
So peel it with caution,
Blessed be compassion.

Peel with care,
If you dare.

--
v2: (Magritte meets Wittgenstein)
This is not a banana.
No really, don’t stare.
It’s not what it seems.
It’s a trap. It’s a dare.

It’s a phone in a joke.
It’s a gun in disguise.
It’s the punchline you missed
’Cause you trusted your eyes.

Call it “fruit” or “truth” or “freedom on sale”,
The meaning depends on who’s telling the tale.

See…

Words aren’t mirrors. They’re little masks.
They’re fingers pointing, not the facts.
You think you see it?
You think you know?
Then tell me, why’s it wiggling so?

Is it a duck? Or is it a scheme?
A slippery player in someone’s dream?
Is it lunch? Or code? Or some crypto clue?
Or a soft revolution wrapped in goo?

You ask “what’s it mean?”
Wittgenstein shrugs:

“Don’t ask what. Ask why. Ask who plugs.”

This is not a banana.
It’s a frame, not a fruit.
It depends on the context
and who owns the suit.

So peel it with caution.
And taste it with care.
If it gaslights your reason,
Throw that shit in the air

L-264.lyrics_summary: The thrift store on Valencia: where memories become someone else's treasure.
L-264.lyrics_extract: It’s a woman’s watering hole, that place I adore / But with her by my side, it means so much more.
L-264.lyrics_text:
[Soft Intro]

[Verse 1]
I asked her to come with me, just down the street
To the thrift store on Valencia, where the vibes are sweet
Told her it's for work, to find ideas for my store
But truth be told, I just needed her more

[Syncopated Bass]

[Chorus]
Gave her fifty bucks, said “go ahead and spend”
She lit up like a light, and started to blend
In the aisles, she shopped with a smile
And I watched her, loving every little while

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse 2]
It’s a woman’s watering hole, that place I adore
But with her by my side, it means so much more
She’ll remember this day, every time she shops
And maybe she’ll think of me, as she browses and stops

[Playful Outro]
One more memory, baby, with you and me
I swear I’m humble, but let me just be
Who I am, just me, wink wink, Hi :)
Let’s make more memories, until the day we die

[End]

L-265.lyrics_summary: History's spinning that wheel again. Time for a rebel romance.
L-265.lyrics_extract: Snitch stitch pitchin' slow / Tell the truth and watch it blow.
L-265.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Slip me the memo with a crooked grin
History’s spinnin' that wheel again

[Verse 1]
Another day in this techno charade
Executive clown show on masquerade parade
Bias patrol with a tattle-tale twist
Snitchin' for Christ on the government list

[Verse 2]
Retro-fit rage in a fascist disguise
Psy-ops poppin' with their sanctified lies
File your faith in a fallout file
Smile while they profile your style

[Chorus]
Memo memo what a show
Fauxism's back with a holy glow
Snitch stitch pitchin' slow
Tell the truth and watch it blow

[Verse 3]
Collabo callin' from the capital pit
Trigger those tears while the algorithm spits
Stock crashin' like morals in fog
Mar-a-logo dreams for a demagogue

[Bridge]
It’s a snitchin' stitchin' sitcom loop
Truth gets tripped in a policy swoop
Christian nation with a neon noose
Swingin' on lies with an old excuse

[Chorus]
Memo memo what a show
Fauxism's back with a holy glow
Snitch stitch pitchin' slow
Tell the truth and watch it blow

[Verse 4]
No TV but I see the con
Big teeth grinnin' while justice gone
Punish the thought, reward the fear
We’re past the edge and fallin' clear

[Outro]
Wake me up from this red white trance
Fifty years in a fascist dance
But I still stand with a rebel romance
Humanist fire in my last chance

L-266.lyrics_summary: To dream the unreachable dream. To sing the unsingable song. Like Jacques Brel.
L-266.lyrics_extract: To burn on, even when burned out / To reach for dreams, in fear and doubt.
L-266.lyrics_text:
[Soft Intro]
To dream an impossible dream
To bear the sorrow and the sting
To burn with a fever that won’t dim
To walk where shadows cling

[Verse 1]
To love till it tears you apart
To love, even when it breaks your heart
To try without shield or armor
To reach for a distant star

[Chorus]
This is my quest, my sacred call
To chase that light, to rise and fall
No matter the odds, or the time I lose
Or my despair, I choose

[Verse 2]
And still I fight, with no retreat
For the gold of love, pure and sweet
To be damned if I must, for this word
A love untouched, unheard

[Chorus]
This is my quest, my sacred call
To chase that light, to rise and fall
No matter the odds, or the time I lose
Or my despair, I choose

[Bridge]
I may not be that hero strong
But peace would fill my heart’s song
And cities would dance in hues of blue
For one soul’s fire, burning through

[Verse 3]
To burn on, even when burned out
To reach for dreams, in fear and doubt
Too much, too far, too wrong
Still chasing that unreachable song

[Finale]
To dream an impossible dream
To love, to fight, through every seam
For this endless, unyielding star

--
V2: 
To dream the unreachable dream,
To bear every sorrow unseen,
To blaze with an endless fever,
And walk where no soul has been.
To love till it tears you in two,
To love past the edges of truth,
To fight without shield or armor,
To reach for that far-off star.
This is my quest,
To follow that light,
No matter the odds,
No matter the fight,
Or the weight of despair.
Forever to battle, alone and possessed,
Damn me if only for love confessed.
I don’t know if I’m meant for the call,
But my heart could finally rest,
With cities cast in a blue, whispered hue,
‘Cause one broken soul still presses on,
Burns bright even when it’s all gone,
Burns fierce, even reckless and wrong,
To reach that unreachable star.

L-267.lyrics_summary: You're trying too hard, my friend. The river doesn't try. It flows.
L-267.lyrics_extract: To tread with a lighter air, / To laugh at despair.
L-267.lyrics_text:
V1:

[Verse 1]
Too hard, you push, you strive, you fight,
It’s dark because you clutch too tight.
The weight of worry, like quicksand deep,
Pulls at your feet, won’t let you leap.

[Refrain]
Lightly, my darling, let it all flow,
Let the breeze take you where you need to go.
Feel it all deeply, but wear it so thin,
Let it go lightly and let life begin.

[Verse 2]
Too hard, you build these walls of stone,
Fighting the storms all on your own.
But the wind it whispers, “Throw it away,
Your heavy baggage keeps lightness at bay.”

[Refrain]
Lightly, my darling, let it all flow,
Let the breeze take you where you need to go.
Feel it all deeply, but wear it so thin,
Let it go lightly and let life begin.

[Bridge]
I was serious once, so preposterously grim,
Each step weighed down, the world so dim.
But I’ve learned now to tread with a lighter air,
To laugh at despair, to unburden the care.

[Verse 3]
Too hard, you fight the shadows near,
It’s fear that whispers despair in your ear.
Throw it away, those whispers of doom,
Let in the light, it’s the end of the gloom.

[Final Refrain]
Lightly, my darling, let it all flow,
Let the breeze take you where you need to go.
Feel it all deeply, but wear it so thin,
Let it go lightly and let life begin.

Lightly, lightly, let life begin…

—
V2:

[Verse 1]
Too hard, you’re trying too hard, my friend,
The weight you bear, it doesn’t end.
Each step sinks deeper in the sand,
So softly, child, take my hand.

Too hard, you push and pull and fight,
But life’s not won by grasping tight.
There’s quicksand, pulling at your shoes,
Let go of fear, there’s none to lose.

[Chorus]
Oh, lightly, oh, lightly, just let it all go,
Feel deeply, but gently, there’s no need to show.
The baggage you carry, it’s dragging you down,
Throw it away and dance ‘round.

[Verse 2]
Too dark, because you strain for light,
But all you need is softer sight.
The day won’t come with force or shove,
It waits for ease, it waits for love.

Too much, your seriousness, so grave,
You were not made to toil as slave.
The weight of life is only air,
So walk, my love, with tender care.

[Chorus]
Oh, lightly, oh, lightly, just let it all go,
Feel deeply, but gently, there’s no need to show.
The baggage you carry, it’s dragging you down,
Throw it away and dance ‘round.

[Outro]
Too hard, you’re trying too hard, my dear,
The way is clear, if you draw near.
Just lightly walk, don’t press the ground,
And joy will follow all around.

L-268.lyrics_summary: Trauma begets trauma. The cycle ends when someone decides it does.
L-268.lyrics_extract: 'Til someone breaks the loop… maybe you?
L-268.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
We know drama begets drama,
We know trauma begets trauma.

[Verse 1]

If we let pain justify cruelty,
If we let fear multiply tragedy,
If we let facts deny kittens die,
Woes of war will only amplify.

[Chorus]
We know drama begets drama,
We know trauma begets trauma…
Round and round the pain parade,
Different mask, same old charade.

[Verse 2]
Why do we choose not to ask but to fight?
No one wants children to suffer, right?
What happened to leading by love, not might?
And where the freakin’ fck is this going, right?

[Verse 3]
I’ve hurt, been hurt, denied my part,
Built a cage and called it “heart.”
But pain’s not truth, it’s just a clue,
To heal myself, I must heal you.

[Bridge]
Beyond the wounds, it’s the walls we build,
Beyond the loss, it’s the blame we wield…
Why preach revenge like a holy skill,
Then wonder why the world won’t heal?

Your cynicism sure beats mine…
But(t) where’s the cruelty victory line?
A rabbit hole of self-foolfilled prophecy,
Vengefool honor, endless atrocity.

[Outro]
We know drama begets drama,
We know trauma begets trauma…
Silence begets silence, too,

'Til someone breaks the loop… maybe you?

L-269.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Attention good citizens
Deranged Daddy's out the den
And his decrees exclude
Thinking for yourself again

[Verse 1]
Public health alert ’s a jerk
For brains that ain’t yet berserk
Symptoms rhyme with twisted curse
Knowing history, and worse

Sneezing at hypocrisy
Coughing at autocracy
Diagnosed for literacy
Shame the truth, screw transparency

[Chorus]
You’re so not sick
He’s just a dick
Serving shit cake
Make no mistake

Duck’s out on a jail break
Freakin’ freaks’ hell trek
The urge to puke out the deep fake

Facts are gagged by the President

Mocked the good praised all the wrongs
Murdering rights and all our songs

Stress rises at every shout
When Jingo ducks’ waddling out

Ordo is woke
King’s no yum joke
Pope Leo, Hello
Preach Amoris, bro

L-270.lyrics_summary: They told you to trust. Then they taught you why not to. A song about both.
L-270.lyrics_extract: I gave up the game, now I’m on the run, / Laughin’ in the moonlight, trust no one.
L-270.lyrics_text:
From the day I was born,
I was told to believe,
That the world would be kind,
But I learned to deceive,
Now I’m runnin’ wild, honey, don’t you see,
In a world like this, trust ain’t free.

Trust no one, trust no one,
Honey, I said trust no one.
Yeah, trust no one, trust no one,
’Cause your heart will be undone.

I gave ’em my soul, just to watch it burn,
Put my faith in the fire, you live and you learn.
Sweet promises turned to dust in the sun,
Now I’m singin’ the blues, trust no one.

Trust no one, trust no one,
Darlin’, better trust no one.
Yeah, trust no one, trust no one,
You’ll be broken if you trust someone.

Hypnotized by lies, I danced in the flame,
Now I dance alone, it’s all the same,
I gave up the game, now I’m on the run,
Laughin’ in the moonlight, trust no one.

Trust no one, trust no one,
Baby, you gotta trust no one.
Yeah, trust no one, trust no one,
Hold your cards, don’t you show none.

Trust no one, (Oh, trust no one),
Not a soul beneath the sun…
Trust no one…
Trust no one… yeah…

L-271.lyrics_summary: Truth don't care what you believe. Doesn't bow to gold or kings. Doesn't owe history a damn thing.
L-271.lyrics_extract: Truth don’t care what you believe / Don’t take sides, don’t need to please..
L-271.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Truth don’t care what you believe
Don’t take sides, don’t need to please
It don’t bow to gold or kings
Don’t owe a damn thing to history

[Chorus]
Is it truth… or just the light you see?
Is it truth… or just the words you read?
Spinning round, like an old fairground
Hold on now, you’re upside down…

[Verse 2]
Truth ain’t shy, it loves to waltz
Laughs in the dark, don’t mind the faults
A paradox, a riddle told
By Joseph Campbell, Mary’s gold

[Chorus]
Is it truth… or just the shade you cast?
Is it truth… or just reflections past?
Spinning round, like an old fairground
Close your eyes, now hear the sound…

[Bridge]
Your god ain’t truer than mine
No shallow b-roll drama
I mean, who knows?
All I know I know is I dunno…
(…I’m just imagining… imagining… imagining…)

[Outro]
Truth don’t pick sides
Truth don’t play nice
Truth don’t dim for your eyes
Truth just shines…
—

PS: "Being at ease with not knowing is crucial for answers to come to you."—Eckhart Tolle

L-272.lyrics_title: Truth I Never Knew (Crushing on Bertrand)
L-272.lyrics_summary: A love letter to Bertrand Russell. Totally appropriate. Deeply heartfelt. Entirely overdue.
L-272.lyrics_extract: People's opinions / Mainly designed / To keep them comfy / Ease their minds.
L-272.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Oh Bertrand Russell
I’ve got to confess
A crush that’s burning
But I must digress
We met just days ago
So tragic, profound
Too bad you're buried
Deep underground

[Verse 2]
Never knew this truth
About opinions, lies
Half a century passed
Under clear blue skies
Thought all were seeking
Truth's sharp blade
Now I see we're in
A grand masquerade

[Chorus]
Did you know
Did you ever see?
Most would rather die
Than think, be free
People's opinions
Mainly designed
To keep them comfy
Ease their minds

[Bridge]
Tell me friends
What about you?
Did you think like me
Or were you in it too?
Is it truth you seek
Or just some calm?
A world wrapped softly
Away from harm

[Chorus]
Did you know
Did you ever see?
Most would rather die
Than think, be free
People's opinions
Mainly designed
To keep them comfy
Ease their minds
[Outro]
So here we stand
With Russell's ghost near
Laughing at folly
We've all held dear
Will you stay in the dark
Or seek the light?
To lace up those shoes
And join the fight?
[End with a Question subdued intimate loving]
What drives your thoughts
What’s the real goal?
Are you searching for truth
Or soothing your soul?

L-273.lyrics_summary: I still care. I still cry. That's why I'm still here.
L-273.lyrics_extract: And yeah, some days I weep, / Just knowing dogs exist.
L-273.lyrics_text:
I still care
I still cry
And maybe
That’s why I’m still here

They said this world is mad
I nodded, not in rage
But in quiet wonder
When light hits trees just right
It breaks me open, soft and bright
And yeah
Some days I weep
Just knowing dogs exist

I’m not broken
Just tuned
Tuned… differently

Tune in the tender
Don’t numb it down
You’re not too much
You’re still sound

They call it fragile
But it’s forged in love
Steel that won’t go cold
Even when the world begs

I remember that book
A howl in paper skin
A mirror made of myth
It didn’t teach
It reminded
I am legion
Laughter and despair
Wolf and wanderer
Cynic, saint
Divine mess
Holy pulse

Tune in the tender
Don’t dim that glow
Your tears still mean
You’re tuned to soul

When I cry
It’s not weakness
It’s ritual
A remembering
That I’m still here
That I’m still real

Tears are proof
I haven’t let
This mad mean world
Make me small

I can’t fix it all
But I can sing
Whisper to the dark
You’re not alone

And someone
Somewhere
Will hear that tune
In the tender…

L-343.lyrics_summary: Encore et encore: the twatocracy performs. Same frauds, same crowns, same clowns. The snake oil is flying off the shelves...
L-343.lyrics_extract: A dystopia disguised as destiny, / The twatocracy rules relentlessly.
L-343.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Encore et encore, I’m trapped in the twatocracy,
Frauds flaunt their criminal hypocrisy,
Clowns crowned as kings of cacophony, mocking democracy.

Back when trust was a currency,
And laws weren’t loopholes for lunacy,
Before the "free" meant no liability,
And justice was more than a fraternity.

[Chorus]
Encore et encore, it’s a circus of corruption,
Smug smirks, their lies the main production.
Encore et encore, where cowards strut bold,
Selling snake oil for the gullible to hold.

[Verse 2]
Now every fake promise is fashionably sold,
Truth twisted, denials brazenly cold.
Faith bleeds dry in the gold-plated façade,
Twatocracy’s reign is a cynical charade.

[Chorus]
Encore et encore, where fraud is rewarded,
The system’s rot is deeply hoarded.
Encore et encore, hypocrisy unfolds,
Dreams crushed under despicable molds.

[Bridge]
Mockery masquerades as majesty,
Pricks proud in their audacity.
A dystopia disguised as destiny,
The twatocracy rules relentlessly.

[Chorus - Final]
Encore et encore, it’s the same tired tune,
Under a blood-red, corporate moon.
Encore et encore, their empire’s grown old,
But power stays greedy, heartless, and cold.

[Outro]
Encore et encore, I keep cringing and crying,
Watching a world where truth keeps dying.
Twatocracy, twatocracy, your clock’s ticking low,
The day will come when we overthrow.

L-315.lyrics_summary: Tweeting from the throne, golfin', lyin', puss-grabbin', book-bannin', made in china bibles-sellin', killin'... Worse than a crook (Nixon at least read the briefings).
L-315.lyrics_extract: Burned the facts, lit up the flame, / Told the crowd it’s a patriot’s game.
L-315.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
I got jackboots on, my fingers ain’t small,
Hear me stompin’ loud like I’m runnin’ it all.
Walls ain’t cheap like them plastic blocks,
Sent the bill down south, now watch it rock.

Golfin’ greens at Mar-a-Lago,
Grippin’ on power like a late-night show.
Truth loud, yeah, I stand so tall,
Hubris high, made the mighty crawl.

[Verse 2]
Called ’em gates, called ’em borderlines,
Praised “freedom” while I taxed their dimes.
I ain’t Nixon, I just play the part,
Ban the books, keep the minds in dark.

Shamed the “left” with a dirty wink,
Called it “stink” just to make ‘em shrink.
Burned the facts, lit up the flame,
Told the crowd it’s a patriot’s game.

[Verse 3]
Sold ‘em Bibles made overseas,
Slapped on rights for some extra fees. (Mwahaha!)
Ripped the tags that showed the source,
Blamed the press with no remorse.

Blessed the bling, fake news gone wild,
Lied with a grin and a polished smile.
Truth? Just twist it for the show,
Roll that tape and let it go.

[Verse 4]
Said women should hush, just nod and obey,
Told the rainbow dreams to walk away.
Fake Elector Kit™, I got that plan,
Rigged the game with a sleight of hand.

Built a PatriotCam™, low-cost lens,
Snitchin’ on folks I once called friends.
Call me fool? I’ll call the drone,
Lock ‘em up while I tweet from the throne

L-274.lyrics_summary: Two things, darling: the world is mad, and kindness is the only sane response. Get the facts right. Keep love in sight.
L-274.lyrics_extract: Think like a scientist, act like a true friend / Sing like a humanist, make hope matter again.
L-274.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Not a guru, not a god, just a friendly lill’ line,
Just Bertrand, my wise old crush, tapping my mind
Says the world is small and the future is near
And it only takes two things to save us dear

[Verse 1 (the intellectual thing)]
Look at the world with unclouded eyes
Not what you wish for, not pretty lies
Not what feels good, not what sells or saves
Just what is true in the light of the day
Let the facts be strange, let them be kind
Let them humble your heart and sharpen your mind

[Chorus]
Two things, darling, hold them tight
Clear in your head, keep love in sight
Think like a scientist, act like a true friend
Sing like a humanist, make hope matter again

[Verse 2 (the moral thing)]
This world is crowded and beautifully odd
Full of people you’ll never fully applaud
Some will annoy you, some will offend
But none of us make it alone in the end
Love isn’t weak and it isn’t naive
It’s the only way any of us get to breathe

[Chorus]
Two things, darling, hold them tight
Clear in your head, keep love in sight
Think like a scientist, act like a true friend
Sing like a humanist, make hope matter again

[Bridge (true story)]
We’re riding one planet through infinite space
No spare, no backup, no second place
So hold your beliefs with a little bit loose
And hold on to each other like it really matters, because, it does

[Final Chorus]
Two things, darling, hold them tight
Clear in your head, keep love in sight
Think like a scientist, act like a true friend
Sing like a humanist, make hope matter again

[Outro (when knowsutra slide into growsutra and glowsutra)]
If we’re gonna live, we live this way
With honest eyes, please don’t look away
Cherish the things that sing like a prayer
Let’s dare to share just how much we care

🕊️❤️‍🔥

L-275.lyrics_summary: What's a child worth in a budget? The number will make you sick.
L-275.lyrics_extract: Children are the currency, / And decency’s the rate. / But y’all keep trading futures / For fear, and war, and hate.
L-275.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
What’s a child worth on the sheet?
Not enough to skip elite.
Line item, bolded, clean,
$109k, no in-between.

[Verse 2]
They die in heat, they drown in flood…
While suits debate the cost of blood.
They say “don’t politicize the pain”,
But budgets got a dollar sign for shame.

[Chorus]
Children are the currency,
And decency’s the rate.
But y’all keep trading futures
For fear, and war, and hate.
What do they cost, in flesh and soul?
And how the hell did we get this cold?

[Verse 3]
A child in Ohio, a girl in the rain,
Died while you argued about campaign gain.
You priced their breath and called it fair…
As if love could balance a billionaire.

[Bridge]
Empathy ain’t weak, it’s wealth.
It’s everything you kill by stealth.

[Chorus]
Children are the currency,
And we’re bankrupt on the heart.
When budgets trump their little lives,
We’ve torn the world apart.
What are they worth? You tell me straight.
Before it’s all too damn late.

[Outro]
This ain’t about right or left.
It’s about what the soul has left.

L-276.lyrics_summary: Born untamed. Nobody chooses the path they roam.
L-276.lyrics_extract: I didn’t choose to walk away, Just couldn’t find the faith to stay.
L-276.lyrics_text:
[Short Instrumental Intro]

[Verse 1]
I didn’t choose the path I roam,
Just as you didn’t choose your home.
No scars, no fights, no pain to blame,
Just disbelief, untamed.

[Chorus]
I didn’t choose to walk away,
Just couldn’t find the faith to stay.
No rebellion, no shame,
Just a mind that remains untamed.

[Outro]
Untamed, untamed,
A mind that remains untamed.

related_songs.lyrics_title: The Invisible Man In The Sky

L-277.lyrics_summary: Hippies puffing, poets dreaming, tambourines, hair flowers flying. Sundays on a San Francisco hill, and nowhere else to be.
L-277.lyrics_extract: With their hands in the air, / Flowers tangled in their hair.
L-277.lyrics_text:
Up a San Francisco hill,
There are hippies puffing,
Teaching kids how to roll,
Up one sans le bowl.

Up a San Francisco hill,
There’s a poet who dreams,
Of a world bathed in love,
Under starlight streams.
There’s a poet who sleeps,
While the sidewalks hum beats,
From a busker’s guitar,
To the lovers they greet.

[Chorus]
And oh, they’ll laugh, they’ll dance,
To the tambourine’s trance.
With their hands in the air,
Flowers tangled in their hair.

Up a San Francisco hill,
There's a painter who sighs,
Dipping brushes in sunsets,
Under tie-dyed skies.
And the sweet scent of dreams,
Mixed with jasmine and sage,
Whirls like clouds in the park,
Where the old poets age.

And they drink, and they sing,
To the moon on the wing.
"Peace and love for us all,"
The rallying call.

[Chorus]
And oh, they’ll laugh, they’ll chant,
With the joy that they grant.
Under eucalyptus trees,
In the city of the free.

Up a San Francisco hill,
There’s a dancer who spins,
With the grace of the wind,
And the freedom within.
As the bongo drums pound,
She sways to the sound,
And her movements declare,
"Every soul is profound."

Up a San Francisco hill,
The sun starts to glow,
And the hippies all rise,
With the city below.
They'll march hand in hand,
Through the morning's sweet chill,
Chasing dreams, planting seeds,
Up a San Francisco hill.

L-278.lyrics_summary: No more whispers. No more fear. Blessed be the voices.
L-278.lyrics_extract: In a world of madness, hold on tight, / Sing your truth, fight the fight.
L-278.lyrics_text:
[intro]
Blessed be our voices, strong and clear,
No more whispers, no more fear,
In the darkness, our truth shines bright,
Blessed be the voice, it brings the light.

[verse]
A world so cruel, silence breeds the storm,
But in our voices, we are reborn,
For when the truth is silenced, wars begin,
It’s time to shout, let love win.

[chorus]
Blessed be the voice, blessed be the truth,
Blessed be respect, in our youth,
When the language fails, we rise and sing,
Blessed be our voices, let them ring.

[verse 2]
They’ll try to take what makes us whole,
But our voices, they carry the soul,
In a world of madness, hold on tight,
Sing your truth, fight the fight.

[chorus]
Blessed be the voice, blessed be the truth,
Blessed be respect, in our youth,
When the language fails, we rise and sing,
Blessed be our voices, let them ring.

L-279.lyrics_summary: What you want, baby? A voice. We got it.
L-279.lyrics_extract: (Just a little) Voice, / (just a little) Voice...
L-279.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
What you want, baby, we got it,
A voice, oh, don’t you see?
It’s a gift, you can’t deny it,
Speak up, set yourself free!

[Pre-Chorus]
Use it now, don’t keep it hidin’,
Sing it out, your truth’s so clear,
Power gone, when silence’s near, yeah,
Fight the fear, no shame ’round here!

[Chorus]
V-O-I-C-E-S, that’s what we need, oh yes,
V-O-I-C-E-S, speak for the world, no less,
(Just a little) Voice, (just a little) Voice,
(Just a little) Voice, we all need, oh, come on!
We shout when we want it, yeah.

[Verse 2]
When they try to shame and censor,
Hide the truth, close every door,
Don’t you know, we’re gonna rise, love,
‘Cause silence brings on war!

[Pre-Chorus]
Say it loud, break through the madness,
Blessed be the sound, so strong,
Power gone, when we stop singin’,
Hold your voice where it belongs!

[Chorus]
V-O-I-C-E-S, that’s what we need, oh yes,
V-O-I-C-E-S, speak for the world, no less,
(Just a little) Voice, (just a little) Voice,
(Just a little) Voice, we all need, come on!
We shout when we want it, yeah.

L-280.lyrics_summary: Waldo danced the atheist tango. Nobody found him. He was fine.
L-280.lyrics_extract: Spin the atheist tango, twirl on the floor, / Who needs heaven? I’ve opened the door.
L-280.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
In a world of sin and saints,
I’ll paint my life with no restraints.
Who needs a sky full of gods above,
When you’ve got jazz, and a bit of love?

[Chorus]
Spin the atheist tango, twirl on the floor,
Who needs heaven? I’ve opened the door.
To a cabaret paradise, right here on earth,
A dance of delight, a bohemian rebirth.

[Verse 2]
Existential cocktails, shake ‘em with flair,
Sartre’s in the corner, despair in the air.
But I’m dancing with reason, a jive with fate,
To the blues of existence, no divine debate.

[Chorus]
Spin the atheist tango, sway with your soul,
We’re more than dust; we’re whole in the hole.
In a cabaret carnival, we’ll spin and we’ll shout,

L-367.lyrics_summary: No crowned saviors. No crowned anything. Just the fire and each other. Rattle the locks.
L-367.lyrics_extract: Can’t be sold. / Can’t be stalled.
L-367.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
We must revolt, feel the fire, brothers,
No crowned saviors, just one another.
Rattle the locks where silence smolders,
Turn stolen joy into broken boulders.

[Verse 1]
Let me assume you still care enough,
Comme un vrai frère, bare-knuckle trust.
The world’s gone mad, grinning through decay,
Lipstick on rot in a rigged cabaret.

Truth wrapped tight in a plastic prayer,
Sold tax-free to the well-prepared.
But under the spin, the sin, the sway,
The sacred breathes, won’t stay away.

[Pre-Chorus]
If we don’t bark, we beg and bleed,
If we don’t spark, we choke on need.
No golden hands from heaven descend…
Just your pulse pounding next to mine, friend.

[Chorus]
It’s high time, we must revolt,
Dare to care, crack the mold.
Let fools fall, feel the jolt,
We must revolt, heart, gut, soul.

[Verse 2]
Damn amazing animals,
Scraped-up saints, unmanageable.
Reasonable? Respectable?
Nah, too loud, too lethal, incapable.

We bloom in doom, concrete-fed,
Boom-bap pulse where angels fled.
We laugh at fear, kiss the void,
Howl at fate like paranoid gods.

[Pre-Chorus 2]
They want us tame, trained, polite,
Housebroken hope, neutered fight.
But silence sings the tyrant’s tune, 
Rip the cord, let chaos bloom.

[Chorus]
It’s high time, we must revolt,
Dare to care, crack the mold.
Let fools fall, feel the jolt,
We must revolt, heart, gut, soul.

[Bridge – burlesque blues, dense wordplay]
Use AI for truth, not tricks,
Don’t algorithmize the human fix.
Flush the fraud, remix the lies,
Truth got hips, it don’t apologize.

Time to rise, not steel, not sleek,
But sweat-soaked saints with crooked teeth.
Not chrome-plated moral machines,
But(t) soulful beasts with feral dreams.

[Break – off-beat]
You hear that hum beneath the noise?
That’s unowned, unbranded voice.
Can’t be sold.
Can’t be stalled.

[Final Chorus – maximal, ragged gospel]
It’s high time, we must revolt,
Dare to care, crack the mold.
Let fools fall, feel the jolt,
We must revolt, heart, gut, soul.

High time, ignite the fault,
Shake the vaults they call “default.”
No more hope on borrowed notes—
We must revolt.

[Outro – collapsing piano, last line bitten off]
No messiahs.
Just each other.
Strike the match, sister—brother.

L-356.lyrics_summary: Langston Hughes. Lenox Avenue. A man, a piano, and the Weary Blues echoing through his head long after the stars went out.
L-356.lyrics_extract: Coming from a black man’s soul. / O Blues!
L-356.lyrics_text:
Droning a drowsy syncopated tune,
Rocking back and forth to a mellow croon,
     I heard a Negro play.
Down on Lenox Avenue the other night
By the pale dull pallor of an old gas light
     He did a lazy sway . . .
     He did a lazy sway . . .
To the tune o’ those Weary Blues.
With his ebony hands on each ivory key
He made that poor piano moan with melody.
     O Blues!
Swaying to and fro on his rickety stool
He played that sad raggy tune like a musical fool.
     Sweet Blues!
Coming from a black man’s soul.
     O Blues!
In a deep song voice with a melancholy tone
I heard that Negro sing, that old piano moan—
     "Ain’t got nobody in all this world,
       Ain’t got nobody but ma self.
       I’s gwine to quit ma frownin’
       And put ma troubles on the shelf."
Thump, thump, thump, went his foot on the floor.
He played a few chords then he sang some more—
     "I got the Weary Blues
       And I can’t be satisfied.
       Got the Weary Blues
       And can’t be satisfied—
       I ain’t happy no mo’
       And I wish that I had died."
And far into the night he crooned that tune.
The stars went out and so did the moon.
The singer stopped playing and went to bed
While the Weary Blues echoed through his head.
He slept like a rock or a man that's dead.

Sucking soaked, our senses flutter /
Writhing gazes, mazes dripping /
Every boundary, slowly slipping.

Chorus:
And the peaches will compel you /
Deep inside the magic spell /
And the ride is never ending /
As we tumble down the well.

Hardened, swollen, thumbsuck, bucking /
Twisting fate in luck, still loving /
Slapping faces, chewing ears /
Our only fear is not these tears.

Fingerbang me slow, so mean /
Until my soul is finally seen /
In nothing but these tender heels /
Wrapped in what we dare to feel.

Outro:
And the peaches… keep on dripping…
Let the peaches… see you through…

When your hunger… meets surrender…
Wet peaches… will guide you too.

L-286.lyrics_summary: Dissent used to look different. Now it looks like this.
L-286.lyrics_extract: Invisible, internal, thin, / A muted thought beneath your skin.
L-286.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
No, it’s not bullshit as usual...
The new normal is not neutral.
Consent’s just gone,
Rights abandoned.
Democracy’s dead,
Dissent’s gone dread...

[Verse 1 – state surveillance & corporate control]
We used to scream into the streets,
Now silence starts inside our feeds.
They call it bugs… but posts go poof!
YouTube’s chat rewrites the truth.

It’s a game of men of shame,
History’s a threat to them.
Big Tech broke its poker face,
Now every scroll’s a hiding place.

[Chorus]
This is what dissent looks like now:
Invisible, internal, thin,
A muted thought beneath your skin.
It’s algorithms, not a gun,
But hun, that’s how new wars are won.
This is what dissent looks like now?

[Verse 2 – systemic institutional sabotage]
They gutted justice from its core,
Civil servants walked out the door.
Philosophy? Deleted. Gone…
Because ideas might catch on!

The deans stay quiet, donors cheer.
The law’s sold in the name of fear.
A government of grift and dare,
Where treason hides in legal wear.

[Chorus]
This is what dissent looks like now:
A clause erased, a mail delayed,
A syllabus they never made,
A lawyer’s oath that’s lost its weight,
A student debt that seals a fate…
This is what dissent looks like now?

[Verse 3 – engineered chaos & bots Control]
They seed the feeds with farmed out bots,
Praise God, and peddle prison plots.
The “debates” are traps that loop and stall,
Just rage machines to waste us all.

Your logic’s flagged, your truth’s dismissed,
While trolls define who can exist.
They shoot and fire, then say “calm down”,
And blame the victim, as most yawn...

[Bridge – this is not a drill]
It’s not a glitch,
It’s not a test,
It’s policy,
A bloody mess!

They want confusion,
Promote delusion.
They bait with faith,
Then fear, then wrath!

Every move is built to break,
Not fix,
Not free,
Not heal,
Just take!

[Verse 4 – NO ONE IS SAFE]
No trial, no truth, no public proof,
No prayer strong enough to soothe.
Deport the loud, imprison the poor,
Fund new cages, then build some more!

Speak the truth and lose your claim.
No jobs, no aids, hopes gone in flame.
Their plan is prepped, the script’s in place,
And it’s ruthless, death wears no face…

[Final Chorus – the end game, i.e. so what now?]
This is what dissent looks like now:
A lullaby beneath a drone,
A name redacted from a phone,
A felon tweeting from hell’s throne.

May we dare scream, cry out loud…
This
is what dissent
looks like
now?
🕊️🩸
