L-287.lyrics_summary: What if -ism? What if we actually tried fairness, just once?
L-287.lyrics_extract: Oh, humanity, why so blind? / Fooled by lies time after time.
L-287.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Take a moment, take a breath,
Pause a while and think…
What is fair, what is right,
Why does history repeat?

Stalin, Putin, on the rise,
Authoritarians in disguise,
Not about the red or blue,
It’s the ego’s covert truth.

[Chorus]
What if it’s not communism?
What if it’s not capitalism?
Not about racism, sexism, elitism,
All these isms… just masks for narcissism.

[Verse 2]
Oh, humanity, why so blind?
Fooled by lies time after time.
Are we dumbed, or numbed, or dulled?
Like retarded goldfish in a bowl.

Contrarian skies storming high,
Endless loops of endless lies.
Encore, encore, encore,
Repeating wars we’ve seen before.

[Bridge]
Are we furled up in our pride?
Lost in currents of the tide?
Can we learn, can we see,
Can we break this loop and be free?

[Chorus]
What if it’s not communism?
What if it’s not capitalism?
Not about racism, sexism, elitism,
All these isms—just masks for narcissism.

[Verse 3]
Think deep, think slow,
Look within, let your soul glow.
What if freedom’s not outside?
What if it’s the ego we should fight?

[Outro]
Oh why, oh why, oh why,
Do we dance to the same old lie?
Are we foolish, selfish, lost in the mist,
Or just tired souls seeking bliss?

Endless loops, contrarian skies,
Authoritarian storms in disguise.
Encore, encore, why oh why,
Are we still fooled by these endless lies?

L-409.lyrics_summary: What if MeToo and BLM were the same fight? What if humanity faced one root evil? (Spoiler: narcissism, hiding in plain sight.)
L-409.lyrics_extract: History shows, beyond finite divides, / Narcissism’s whisper, where true evil hides.
L-409.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
[Short Instrumental Intro]

[Verse]
What if MeToo and BLM were the same fight?
Battles of sexism and racism, lost in the night.
What if humanity faced one root evil in sight?
Narcissism, hiding in the shadows, taking flight.

[Chorus]
Cop abusing power, pastor’s cruel grasp,
Doctor’s cold distance, teacher’s unholy clasp.
V, Craigy, or Manny, taking advantage of me,
Behind it all, a dark personality.

[Interlude]

[Verse]
Equality’s banner, a mask they wear,
Pretending to care, but truly unaware.
History shows, beyond finite divides,
Narcissism’s whisper, where true evil hides.

[Chorus]
Cop abusing power, pastor’s cruel grasp,
Doctor’s cold distance, teacher’s unholy clasp.
V, Craigy, or Manny, taking advantage of me,
Behind it all, a dark personality.

[Bridge]
Beyond race and gender, deeper we go,
Where narcissism breeds, causing woe.
Root of all evils, on this earthly stage,
A timeless battle, an unending rage.

[Outro]
[Instrumental Outro: Soft fade with acoustic guitar and subtle percussion]
Narcissism’s flame, burning bright,
In every shadow, in every light.
Root of all evils, plain to see,
Narcissism, the enemy of humanity.

L-288.lyrics_summary: It's not about you or me. It's about the wounds nobody named.
L-288.lyrics_extract: It’s about the silence, cold and wide, / Where history’s ghosts are forced to hide.
L-288.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
It’s not ’bout me, it’s not ’bout you,
It’s about the wounds that never heal through.
It’s about pages torn from time,
Truth in exile, buried in rhyme.

It’s about the silence, cold and wide,
Where history’s ghosts are forced to hide.
Not for glory, not for clout,
Just for saying what it’s about.

[Chorus]
What it’s about…
Is the truth they drown.
What it’s about…
Is the breaking down.
What it’s about…
Is the cries unheard.
What it’s about…
Is the weight of words.

[Verse 2]
It’s about a felon crowned in gold,
Feeding lies like they were soul.
It’s about greed with a mask of grace,
Selling fear to stay in place.

It’s about schools that never taught,
And cages built from every “ought.”
It’s about naming what they shout,
Then whispering "that’s what it’s about"…

[Chorus]
What it’s about…
Is the ones they chain.
What it’s about…
Is the hidden pain.
What it’s about…
Is the smoke, the screen.
What it’s about…
Is what freedom means.

[Bridge]
It’s about the cost… of keeping still.
The hush that bends a nation’s will.
It’s not a choice to speak or not,
It’s breath, it’s blood, it’s all we’ve got.

They laugh and call it overblown,
While prisons fill and hearts turn stone.
But kindness cuts the deepest way,
And truth, my love, don’t look away.

[Final Chorus]
What it’s about…
Is the love that stays.
What it’s about…
Is the darker days.
What it’s about…
Is the voice inside.
What it’s about…
Is the will to rise.

[Outro]
So please…
Speak while we still can…
Before the silence
Takes the land.

That’s what it’s about.
Yes…
That’s what it’s about.

[end]

L-314.lyrics_summary: From Stalin to Hiroshima to now: tell me, my dear, what justifies the pain? (Spoiler: vengence is a lose-lose game.)
L-314.lyrics_extract: Oh, they speak of order, speak of gain, / But what justifies the mothers’ pain?
L-314.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
Oh, tell me now, my dear, what justifies the pain?
What on earth makes violence ever seem sane?
Is it the promise of a world more fair,
Or the foolish pride of those who dare
To claim the ends can cleanse the stains,
Of broken hearts and shattered reigns?

[Chorus]
From Stalin’s grip to Mao’s command,
To every inch of stolen land,
Tell me, my friends, what do you see?
Is there a truth that sets us free?
Or do we dance to the same old song,
Believing right can come from wrong?

[Verse 2]
They said the bombs on Hiroshima’s shores
Would end a war, prevent more wars.
But what of lives turned into dust,
The silent screams of broken trust?
Do numbers add up to some great peace,
When history’s wounds have yet to cease?

[Bridge]
Oh, they speak of order, speak of gain,
But what justifies the mothers’ pain?
The fathers lost, the children weep,
As history digs its grave so deep.
What on earth, my friends, justifies
The lies that blind our very eyes?

[Verse 3]
Look at apartheid’s cold divide,
Or the Inquisition’s holy pride,
They claimed a cause, they claimed a need,
But all I see is human greed.
The fools who bamboozle, fools who scheme,
Turning justice into a fevered dream.

[Chorus]
From Stalin’s grip to Mao’s command,
To every inch of stolen land,
Tell me, my friends, what do you see?
Is there a truth that sets us free?
Or do we dance to the same old song,
Believing right can come from wrong?

[Outro]
So tell me now, my dear, what justifies the pain?
Can anything make violence ever seem sane?
Or do we learn from the tales of old,
That love, not power, is what we hold?
Oh, what justifies, what justifies the pain?

L-366.lyrics_summary: History's greatest hits: repeated, again, sans apprentissage. The question has been asked before. Frequently.
L-366.lyrics_extract: What makes us think that ends so bright, / Can ever justify such blight?
L-366.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
What lessons do we forget, my dear?
When history whispers in our ear,
Of kings and priests and tyrants bold,
Who traded souls for dreams of gold?
What makes a man oppress his kin?
What twisted logic lies within?

[Chorus]
From the gulags cold to the gallows high,
From witch hunts to the drones that fly,
Do we learn, or just repeat?
The same dark dance, the same defeat?
What makes us think that ends so bright,
Can ever justify such blight?

[Verse 2]
They said they’d bring salvation near,
Through fear and pain, through death and tears.
The Crusades marched with crosses high,
But tell me, friend, at what cost was that sky?
The blood of millions on the sand,
The folly of a foolish plan.

[Bridge]
Is it the pride of men, the lure of power,
That blinds them in their darkest hour?
Do they believe the lies they tell,
As they create their private hell?
Oh, what makes them think their way is just,
When their means are grounded in mistrust?

[Verse 3]
Look at Vietnam, at fields ablaze,
At governments lost in their own maze.
They thought they’d shape a better world,
With every bomb, every flag unfurled.
But what did they build, what did they gain?
A legacy of endless pain.

[Chorus]
From the gulags cold to the gallows high,
From witch hunts to the drones that fly,
Do we learn, or just repeat?
The same dark dance, the same defeat?
What makes us think that ends so bright,
Can ever justify such blight?

[Outro]
So tell me now, what don’t we see?
In the pages of our own history?
Do we believe the same old lies,
While the truth fades and slowly dies?
Oh, what lessons, what lessons do we forget?
What will it take, for us to learn yet?

Who knows what goes on?
When stars debate the dawn?

Who knows what goes on, under the stars?

Who knows what goes on  
When the stars are all gone

Why trust an old, mean religion?
No, no, no... Hey, hey, hey!
What can I say?

mais le cœur droit, c’est la seule arme qu’on comprend.

karma dub, reverb deep, tu payes ce que t’as joué.
Integrity, no filter, no mask,
Bananasutra ride the truth like a task.

[Bridge]
You can’t fake the peace when the beat drops slow,
justice ain’t revenge, it’s letting the light grow.
We don’t fight to win, we rise to heal,
our softness is strength, our kindness is steel.

[Refrain]
Bananasutra dans la vibe, garde la foi quand le monde s’épuise,
Truth & love, ça brise les murs, ça cicatrise.
Kindness ain’t weakness, it’s holy steel,
you feel me ? That’s the real deal.

[Outro]
Il faut être bien audacieux pour dire vrai dans un monde de bruit,
il faut être bien lumineux pour offrir la paix la nuit.
Bananasutra… spread that light.

L-345.lyrics_summary: After midnight, the only fair game is the one where you both win. Honest wrapped in skin. A gentler no. A deeper yes.
L-345.lyrics_extract: I want lust and conscience, slow and kind, / Body present, a wide open mind.
L-345.lyrics_text:
[Verse 1]
I don’t want tricks, I don’t want chase,
I want slow truth and breathing space,
Talk to me like minds undress,
Curiosity over excess.

I want honest wrapped in skin,
The only fair game we both can win.

[Chorus]
Win-win after midnight, stay,
Fair games only, come what may,
If it’s not glowing, walk away,
Win-win after midnight, stay.

[Verse 2]
Technology’s fast, hope feels thin,
But touch still teaches what’s within,
Justice purrs beneath the beat,
Equality tastes bittersweet.

I want abundance that helps us grow,
A deeper yes, a gentler no.

[Chorus]
Win-win after midnight, stay,
Fair games only, come what may,
If it’s not glowing, walk away,
Win-win after midnight, stay.

[Verse 3]
Warm light spills on messy sheets,
Trust lies closer, no one cheats,
Whispers flow where fear once slept,
Promises we actually kept.

I want lust and conscience, slow and kind,
Body present, a wide open mind.

[Chorus / Outro]
Win-win after midnight, stay,
Fair games only, come what may,
If it’s not glowing, walk away,
Win-win after midnight, stay.

L-309.lyrics_summary: If you're not racist, you're woke. If you're not sexist, you're woke. Super-woke, actually. Stay wide awake, forever woke.

L-309.lyrics_text:
In the wake of Elon-like buffoon,
And the likes of pedantic morons,

If you dare call out bad things, basically.

If you’re not racist, you’re woke,
If you’re not sexist, you’re woke,
If you’re not elitist, you’re woke,
If you’re not capitalist, you’re woke.
If you’re not a narcissist, you’re woke.

Outta wack… a-doodle… fool on bamboozle.

Because fascism is no joke.

If you speak truth, they’ll label you the fool.
But the wise see through the charade,
Question the script, rewrite the rule.

[Chorus]
So, kids, girls, boys, and all in between,
Please be woke, be like… superWOKE.
Woke. Be wide awake, forever woke,
Never weak, and please, call the wack out,
Because fascism is no joke.

Wide awake, forever woke,
Never weak, always bold,
Call out the wack, don’t let it slide,
Truth’s the light, let it be your guide.

L-310.lyrics_summary: Down the rabbit hole of your own assumptions. Welcome to the wonderland of bias.
L-310.lyrics_extract: Oh, definitions matter, baby, they shape the way we live, / In the wonderland of bias, there’s nothing left to give.
L-310.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Down in the wonderland, where nothing’s quite as it seems,
Definitions twist and bend, just like our tangled dreams.
In France, they talk of fraternity, but here in the land of the free,
Equality’s for losers now, where’s the liberty?

[Verse 1]
In the land of stars and stripes, the meanings start to shift,
Liberty’s got no anchor, just a mighty drift.
Equality’s a punchline, not a right to be,
And justice turns to battles, in this warped reality.

[Chorus]
Oh, definitions matter, baby, they shape the way we live,
In the wonderland of bias, there’s nothing left to give.
Freedom turns to chaos, oh, can’t you see,
We’re all just spinning, lost in liberty.

[Verse 2]
Across the pond in Paris, fraternity they cry,
But over here, we question, and we wonder why.
Liberty means no rules now, no one’s accountable,
In the land of freedom, we’re all untouchable.

[Chorus]
Oh, definitions matter, baby, they shape the way we live,
In the wonderland of bias, there’s nothing left to give.
Freedom turns to chaos, oh, can’t you see,
We’re all just spinning, lost in liberty.

[Verse 3]
Cognitive bias paints the world in shades of war,
Justice twisted, turned into what we’re fighting for.
Everyone’s a victim, or so they say,
In the land of freedom, it’s all just a game we play.

[Chorus]
Oh, definitions matter, honey, but now they’re out of sight,
In this psychedelic world, nothing feels quite right.
Equality’s a stranger, liberty’s on the loose,
And justice, darling, wears a bulletproof excuse.

L-311.lyrics_summary: Music is the only religion that delivers the goods. Zappa said it. We believe it.
L-311.lyrics_extract: Jazz ain’t dead, it just smells funny, / Whipped cream giraffes in the land of honey.
L-311.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
A whimsical world, a tune unfurls,
A gipsy dance in a whirl.

[Verse]
Jazz ain’t dead, it just smells funny,
A quirky beat, sweet like honey.
You can’t write a chord ugly enough,
So here’s a giraffe, whipped cream and stuff.

[Chorus]
If you live a boring life,
Listening to strife, mom, dad, and priest,
You missed the beast, in the music feast.

[Verse 2]
Music’s a mirror, society’s call,
In every note, we hear it all.
Philosophies blend in harmonies tight,
Agreeing only if you see the light.

[Chorus]
If you live a boring life,
Listening to strife, mom, dad, and priest,
You missed the beast, in the music feast.

[Bridge]
A tango twist, with Zappa’s flair,
In hypnotic dance, we take the dare.
Quirky, raw, and oh so grand,
Psychedelic, in a gipsy band.

[Instrumental Break]

[Chorus]
If you live a boring life,
Listening to strife, mom, dad, and priest,
You missed the beast, in the music feast.

[Outro]
Jazz ain’t dead, it just smells funny,
Whipped cream giraffes in the land of honey.
Live your life, play your song,
In Zappa’s world, we all belong.

L-312.lyrics_summary: When someone mistakes scarcity for personality... or something strangely suspicious like that.
L-312.lyrics_extract: I didn’t mind zero orgasm / But(t) zero empathy is goddamn shitty.
L-312.lyrics_text:
[Intro]
Zero sum, zero Sean
Zero seen, feeling shunned
By a wannabe punk
With nothing but(t) junk

[Verse 1]
You played a game with no fair end in sight
You brought the shrug, you picked the fight
We praised Camus, and we kissed like Brel
But(t) then you spat on me for a finite spell

[Chorus]
I didn’t mind zero orgasm
But(t) zero empathy is goddamn shitty
I didn’t mind the finite chasm
But(t) zero sum is so darn petty

Zero sum, zero seen
Fool on spite, flatline screen
Zero care, zero face
Proof that bugs got no grace

[Verse 2]
I over-explained, you anti-hugged
I prayed for peace, you just unplugged
I quoted history, you quoted silence
I sought connection, you sought compliance

[Chorus]
I didn’t mind zero orgasm
But(t) zero empathy is goddamn shitty
I didn’t mind the finite chasm
But(t) zero sum is so darn petty

Zero sum, zero seen
Fool on spite, flatline screen
Zero care, zero face
Proof that bugs got no grace

[Verse 3]
You called it subjective, I called it true
I called it cowardly, you called it through
I philosophized, with art and heart
You antagonized, like an absurd fart

[Bridge]
Real punks care, darling
Real trust is daring
Real games are infinite
Not just extractively lit

[Outro]
Two things darling,
Two simple things:
Get the facts right
Keep love in sight

That’s all I need to know
To know that you can’t grow
That’s all I need to flow
To know that you can’t glow

Zero sum
Zero Sean
Infinite game theory
Blessed be the irony

Bye Bye Spanganga
Sing Bananasutra…

🍌♾️
